tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig dang po'i blo can gyis rtogs par sla ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig dang po'i blo can gyis rtogs par sla ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so/

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/21_KHEN/KHEN004_sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig dang po'i blo can gyis rtogs par sla ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so// na ma shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍa raṃ wa gin+d+ra nan+da rat+na maṅga laṃ kirti dhā dza shrī bha drā ya/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal mgon sa skya pa/ /ngag gi dbang po dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag /dam chos dga' ston rtsol ba'i rin chen mchog /bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho ba'i/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'byung gnas de la 'dud/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang rje/ /brgyud par bcas dang dges rdor lha tshogs la/ /thal mo sbyar te snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong zhal mnga' nas/ /legs par bkral ba'i snyan brgyud zab mo mchog /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po la/ /rim par brgyud pa'i 'khrid yig gsal bar bris/ /de la 'dir dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yos te 'dzin ma'i khyon yongs su khyab par gyur pa de nyid dang / de'i thugs kyi sras mchog dam par gyur pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la sogs te yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang / gsung rab la brten nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag gi gzhung shing rgyas pa/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i 'khrid yig gsung rgyun gyi rim pa phyag len la bsre lhad med pa cung zad kyang ma sbas shing gsal bar bkod pa la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa sngags 'chang chen po la sogs pa bla ma dam pa rnams las dngos su ji ltar thob pa'i lugs ma 'khrul bar brjod na/

de la thog ma snang ba gsum gyi bar/ chos gtor mi mdzad/ dpon slob tshang mas shes snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa lan gsum/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma/ chos rnams ma tshar gsum sogs byas tshar ba dang / slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma tshar gcig phul/ de'i rin la bla mas phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /sogs tshar gsum dang / bla mas 'di ltar brjod do/ /dpon slob gnyis kas rlung ltas brtag dgos pas/ rlung g.yas nas rgyu na g.yon du bsgyur gang thub bya/ ma thub na g.yas bkag nas/ g.yon du cung zad bsgyur/ gzhug cing rgyu bar dpon slob gnyis kas bsam dgos/ de yang g.yas nas rgyu ba la chos bstan na ting nge 'dzin skye sla yang yon tan mi skye zhing / mi brtan pa/ bar chad sdang ba dang / bkra mi shis pa 'byung / g.yon nas rgyu dus bstan na/ yon tan thams cad skye zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / bar chad zhi nas ting nge 'dzin brtan pas/ dngos grub myur du thob cing bkra shis par 'gyur bas/ de ltar mkhyen par mdzad dgos so/ /zhes brda' sbyar la/ cung zad rlung ltas brtag de nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gdam pa slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong gis bkral bar gyur pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang / skye rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal gyis nye bar gnas/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gis bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /rim 'gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa mdo rgyud dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar gsung pa bzhin chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa thams cad legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang khams dang / bag la nyal la dgongs nas chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsung pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du zhing / theg pa chen po la yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ dang po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa mgo dang yan lag sbyin par gtong ba la sogs pa dka' spyad dka' thub la sogs pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brlab po che la bslabs nas/ 'bras bu sa bcu gcig pa mngon du 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ gnyis pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ni/ dka' thub dang dka' spyad mi dgos par/ spyod lam bde zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod bzhin par rim gnyis kyi rnam 'byor la brtson 'grus bskyed na tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ba dbang po rnon po yang rab kyi mchog tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i bsod nams dang ldan pa rnams lam 'dir 'jug par bya ba yin kyang / deng sang ni chos 'jig rten gang yang byar ma btub pa zhig gsang sngags pa byed ces za chog re tsam la brten pa'i srol zhig 'dug ste/ de 'dra ma yin par/ skye ba dpag tu med pa nas sbyangs pa byas pa'i 'bras bus tshe 'di nyid du 'jig rten snying po med pa'i chos nyid de 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rang bzhin du shes nas/ de las sems can thams cad bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin par rgyud la skyes pa rnams lam 'dir 'jug pa bya ba yin pas/ de la slob ma dad pa dang snying rjer ldan pa rgyun ring por nas gsol ba btab cing /

bla mas ji skad smras pa la nyan pa/ gtso bor 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las rang gzhan gnyis ka thar 'dod kyi blo gros can gyi slob ma snod ldan la chig brgyud mdzad nas ston pa sngon gyi phyag len yin te/ rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ dam du bcang shing dam du spel/ /zhes snod min rnams la dam du bcang nas/ man ngag cung zad tsam yang mi ston pa dang / skal can snod ldan rnams la/ re re nas brtsol ba bskyed de man ngag spel gang thub bya ba dam du spel/ ces bya ba'i don yin/ de bzhin 'brog mis kyang / rna bzhi pa la chos mi bshad/ /rna ba drug pa chos kyis dben/ /ces slob ma gnyis dang gsum dus gcig la mi bsten par gsung kyang / deng sang lam 'bras zhu mi kha grangs gang mang byung na bzang por rlom zhing / don las sla gtso bor gton nas bshad lo/ thos lo tsam ma gtogs lugs mthun dam dog byas na kun dang mi mthun pas/ 'du ba yul lugs dang bstun nas slob ma du yod nang du sleb dang bstun/ dpon slob tshang mas sher snying dang bdud bzlog mdzad de/ sngags 'chang chen pa'i gsung las/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ sher snying 'don thabs su/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi mdo 'don pa/ rjes bsngo ba dang gsum tshang dgos par gsungs pas na/ skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum/ dngos gzhi ni/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes su/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i sogs mdo tshar gsum/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo sogs bdud bzlog gsum/ bsngo ba ni/ gang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung / /sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang / bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /sogs dang / yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum/ chos rnams ma tshar gsum/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i sras/

/sogs dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skye ba lan bdun du/ /sogs dang / khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /sogs gsung ste/ de'ang rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du dgongs nas mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar nges shes ma skyes bar bla ma so so'i sku bstod 'don dgos na/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi sku bstod 'don dgos pa zhig tu 'gyur bas ha cang thal zhing mang skyon mtha' med du 'gro/ des na sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag len bzhin gong du brjod pa de tsam gyis don tshang pas chog cing legs par mngon no/ /de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ mdo 'don dus/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs shing / de dag thams cad kyi bdud sdig can rnams tshar bcad cing / bdag gi bden pa'i tshig gi mthun gyur mdzad pas/ kho'i sdig sgrib dag nas sangs rgyas par bsam pa dang / rang shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas de bzhin du mos la/ thal mo brdeb pa'i dus g.yon gan rgyal byas pa'i steng du g.yas kyis brdeb pa kho na las/ steng 'og g.yas bsgyur g.yon bsgyur sogs mi rung ste tshur log nyen yod gsung bas de ltar mdzad dgos so/ /bla ma'i sku bstod 'don pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i+i rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan sku dngos lta bu mngon sum du 'od phrom me bzhugs par bsgom te/ de la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos srung nor lha thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos gus drag po dang ldan pas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par/

snying khong rus pa'i gting nas kha zhe mthun par khyed shes khyed mkhyen gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs dgos/ de yang spyir chos byed pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / khyad par lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo bshad cing nyams su len pa'i dpon slob rnams la bar chad mi 'byung bar gsol ba 'debs pa rtse cig tu bsgril te/ dpon slob tshang mas khur bskyed nas ma g.yeng par mdzad dgos so/ /des na 'di lta bu'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa 'di ni/ spyir gsung rab thams cad kyi bcud phyung zhing / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdams pa rnams kyi myung khu zab mo 'di lta bu dang mjal ba bskal ba bzang ba yin pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma thams cad blos btang nas sgo gsum rtse gcig tu 'bung ste da lan snying po rnam par dag pa yong nges pa zhig bya snyam pa'i sems kyis go cha bskyed dgos so/ /de la 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo sde dang / rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong gis bzhed gzhung / mkhas pa rnams bgrod par byed pa'i 'jug ngogs/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs pa dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag1 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag2 gcig shes pas mang po shes pa'i gdams ngag3 skyon yon tan du slong pa'i gdams ngag4 bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag5 ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag6 bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag7

skyon yon tan du slong shes shing bar chad dngos grub tu len shes pa'i gdams ngag8 sde snod gsum gyi de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i gdams ngag9 gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag10 rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gzhung chung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag dang / man ngag tu bcas pa 11'di ni gang bshad pa dang / nyan cing nyams su blang bar bya ba'i chos yin no/ /de la thog mar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di nyid kyi byung tshul dang / dar tshul cung zad brjod na/ thog mar rgya gar du byung tshul/ de nas bod du byung tshul/ tha mar rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po rgya gar du byung tshul ni/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bla med kyi man ngag shin tu zab cing khungs thub pa lam skor dgu zhes bya ba grags te/ de yang slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pas/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis dang / sam+bu ṭa la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten nas/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i bka' bzhin du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gsal bar mdzad/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang / rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu la sogs pa'i man ngag mdzad/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten nas gzhung byang chub sems 'grel dang / de'i don mchod rten kyi drung du sems thag chod pa'i man ngag mdzad/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas/ brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung lhan cig skyes grub dang / de'i don lhan cig skyed pa gsum gyi lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad/ rgyal mtshan in+d+ra bo dhis ye shes thig le'i rgyud la brten nas gzhung dbang yon tan rim pa dang /

de'i don phyag rgya lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad/ slob dpon tog rtse pas sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud la brten nas gzhung bsam mi khyab dang / de'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i/ rdo rje bde kye'i rgyud la brten nas gzhung o la pa ti dang / de'i don gtum mo'i lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas gsang 'dus kyi rgyud dang / brtag gnyis la brten nas bzhi pa snang ba yan lag bdun ldan/ de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba ste gzhung gsum dang / de'i don phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag mdzad/ grub chen nag po u tsi tra 'chi ba med pas ma rgyud mtha' dag gi gzhung dang / de'i don rlung btsan thabs dbu mar 'dzud pa yon po bsrang ba'i man ngag mdzad/ de ltar slob dpon dgus mdzad pa'i lam skor dgu yin la/ lam skor dgu'i nang nas lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag 'di dus ji tsam la byung na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang nyi shu tsam na/ slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong byon par bzhed la/ slob dpon de nyid la/ sprul pa'i sku rje btsun bdag med mas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing snyan brgyud bzhis gdams nas lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang bas sa drug gi rtogs pa brnyes te spyod pa mdzad pas bir+wa par grags so/ /des tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i shar phyogs kyi slob dpon kar+ṇa pa zhes pa nag po chung ba la gdams/ de'i don du rdo rje'i tshig rkang yang gnang / des mu stegs 'dul ba'i phyir smyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i grub chen ḍā ma ru pa la gnang / des bhu su ku'i spyod pa skyong ba gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin slob dpon a wa dhū ti pa la gnang ste/ slob dpon 'di gsum ka sa dang po yan la gnas par rje btsun rin po ches bshad pas 'phags par grub bo/

/a wa dhū ti pas/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra la snyan brgyud bzhis gdams te gnang / rje ga ya dha ra 'di rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can dang gcig par yang bshad/ gang ltar ḍā ma ru bar snang la bzhag pas rang 'khrol du 'byung ba dang / gdugs yu ba med pa nam mkhar bzhag pas rang 'khor du 'byung ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing / phyis ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas bden pa mthong ba yan chad kyi rtogs pa brnyes pa the tshom mi za'o/ /de ltar 'phags yul gyi grub chen de dag gis bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas gsung ngag rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bod du byon tshul ni/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshe rgya shākya gzhon nu dang / se ye shes btson 'grus gnyis kyi slob ma 'brog mi lo tsa ba chen po shākya ye shes kyis rgya gar du byon nas slob dpon shan+ti pa la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po la mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhus shing bsgyur/ khyad par bir+wa pa'i lam 'bras dang / mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lam mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i rdzogs rim/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mchod rten drung thob/ nag po spyod pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs/ nag po u tsi tra'i yon po bsrang ba/ tog rtse pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab rnams dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje dang / rje ga ya dha ra gnyis la rgya gar shar phyogs dang bod du zhus shing / slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag chen yi ge med pa a mo gha badz+ra la bod du zhus/ an+d+ra bodhi'i ye shes kyi thig le/ ḍoṃ bhi ba'i lhan gcig skyes grub/ paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba la bod du zhus shing / mdor na lam skor dgu'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsgyur nas bod du dar ba mdzad pa ni/ rje btsun 'brog mi lo tsā ba kho na yin no/ /gzhan pa tshab lo tsā ba dang 'gos sogs kyi lam skor re tsam bsgyur ba yod do/ /khyad par gsung ngag rin po che ni/

thog mar rje ga ya dha ras srol gtod/ der rjes 'brog mi lo tsā ba dpon slob kyis legs par spel bar mdzad do/ /de yang thog mar srol gtod tshul ni/ rje grub chen ga ya dha ra bod du lan gsum byon pa'i thog mar mang mkhar mu khu lung du byon nas/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba la dbang bskur zhing / snyan brgyud bzhis gdams te/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyis bsdus pa yongs rdzogs/ rgyud 'grel sogs mtha' yas pa gnang / bar du 'gos lo tsā bas spyan drangs nas byon te rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka'/ grub chen mi thub zla ba'i lugs kyi kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs dang / mtsho skyes lugs sogs mang du gnang / lam 'bras ni ma gnang ngo / /tha ma khyin jo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs nas byon dus/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba sku gshegs grub pa nas/ gsung ngag rin po che gnang kyang cher ma 'phel/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'gyur cig kyang mdzad do/ /der rje 'brog mi lo tsā ba dpon slob kyis legs par spel tshul ni/ rje 'brog mi la/ gzhung tshar ba'i slob ma/ man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma/ grub pa thob pa'i slob ma rnams su yod pa las/ gzhung tshar ba'i slob ma ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po sogs so/ /man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma ni/ 'brom des pa ston chung / lha btsun kā li/ rje se mkhar chung ba dang gsum mo/ /des na 'brom des pa ston chung tsaṇ+ḍa ti zhes bya ba/ mdo smad kyi mi chen gcig yin zer ba 'brom lugs pa rang gi lo rgyus la snang zhing / bla ma dmar gyi 'phan yul ba yin gsung / gang ltar rigs dang skye ba shin tu bzang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ gdams pa mang zhing / khyad par ma mo srog tig la mkhas pa zhig yin/ khong gi bla chen gyi snyan pa thos te/ yul nas rta bdun gyi khal sogs yon mang po bkal nas bsam yas rgyud de byon pas/

lam du lha mo'i sgrub thabs zhu ba mang po byung / nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyed pa rnams khyer nas bla chen gyi drung du sleb/ gdams ngag zhu dus chos mthun re la/ gser zho re'i maṇ+ḍal/ dar zab chen kha re phul te/ de dus kyi dar bzang zhing dkon pas da lta'i yug re las kha re rin che/ de bzhin du gtor ma mi gnyis kyis theg tshad re tshogs 'khor du byas/ 'brog mi g.yu zho spungs ma zer ba de yang phul bas mnyes/ zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur shin tu che zhing yun ring du mdzad pas man ngag rdzogs par gnang ste/ gdams ngag rab tu thob pa zer/ de nas 'brom gyis/ la stod lho la phebs dus dpe cha 'gel ba'i rta gcig g.yar po zhus pas bla mas slob ma la 'bul ba byed pa'i srol med gsung nas ma gnang bas 'brom thugs chad de/ mu khu lung rdo rje gdan du song rung / 'brog mi shākya thub par song yang / 'dir yong ba'i gnas lugs mi 'dug gsung nas byon pas/ lho stod di ri nas yar 'brog ma'i slob ma'i mchog yin zer gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas/ 'ga' zhig la yi ge med pa'i byin brlabs mdzad pas zhal nas khrag skyugs shing snyung nad kyis zin te/ 'brom na re/ nga yi bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos yin pas/ snod brtags par 'dug pa la ngas der ma shes pa log lta cig skyes pas lan/ 'on kyang bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa 'dug nga'i dpe cha dang / nor rdzas/ rus pa rnams bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ khyed rang rnams gdams ngag zhu na nga'i dka' las tsam mi dgos par/ bla mas gnang ba 'dug pas zhu gsungs nas mya ngan las 'das/ slob ma tshos spur bzhu nas gdung rus dang / dpe cha/ nor rdzas sogs rta khal bdun khyer/ lam bde bar mu khu lung gi mda' nas yar dung dkar 'bud kyin phyin pas/ bla chen gyis gsan nas/ nga'i snying gton snyam pa byed ltos dang gsung / bltas pas khong tsho slebs nas de dag phul bas rus pa sku pang du blangs nas/

bus pha can bsnyegs sam gsung spyan chab mang du sil/ de nas khyed tsho gdams ngag 'dod pa yod dam gsungs pas sgye bsgom se 'o/ shen bsgom rog po/ stag pa chos gnang gsum gyis zhus pas man ngag rdzogs par gnang ste bsgom pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes/ de la sogs te rgya lho brag pa sogs rim pas brgyud pa kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu/ gdams ngag gi yig chung sogs po ti gcig gnang zhing / gzhan yang gzhung bshad shin tu rgyas pa dang / gsang bcu la sogs pa'i man ngag phra mo po ti shin tu che ba gcig 'dug pas/ zhib mo rdo rje 'brom las/ lam 'bras 'phel gsung ba ni cung ma dag pa 'dra'o/ /des na 'brom des pa ston chung nas brgyud pa lam 'bras 'brom lugs dang / 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma gtso bo dam par gyur pa/ rje se mkhar chung ba chen po de nyid la/ slob ma lam 'bras rab tu thob pa zhang ston sku mched/ 'bring du thob pa zhwa ma lcam sring / tha mar thob pa se bsgom byang ye rnams su yod pa las/ zhwa ma las brgyud pa'i pho brgyud/ mo brgyud/ gnyis ka bsres pa'i brgyud pa ste/ de gsum las brgyud pa la lam 'bras zhwa ma lugs dang / yang rje ko brag pa la smyos rgyal ba lhas snang gis gsan/ de las brgyud pa lam 'bras smyos lugs su grags kyang / don zhwa ma lugs so/ /mdor na jo nang lugs/ lam 'bras phag gru ma la sogs pa'i lo rgyus ji snyed cig yod/ don gtso bor gyur pa rje ga ya dha ra'i slob ma'i mchog rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'brog mi lo tsā ba dpon slob rnams kyi man ngag 'di spel bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gsum pa tha mar rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ mthu stobs kyi sgo nas mu stegs ming med par mdzad de/ bstan pa nyi mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa ni/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa che ba 'di yin zhing / 'dis rgya gar du theng gsum byon te/ dang po la lam 'bras gsung ba'i bir+wa pa che bar grags pa dang / gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor pa si ro pa zhes mtshan dang ldan pa ste glang po che nyi ma 'char ka brtul/ gsum pa bhi me sa ra 'dul ba la byon no/ /bir+wa pa chung ba ni rdo rje gdan pas/ dur khrod rgyu zhing sha chen gsol/ /bir+wa pa zhes bya ba yi/ /sogs gsung pa ltar gyi slob dpon de nyid yin la/ 'di phag mo dbu bcad ma dang / 'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag 'di las brgyud pa yin gsungs/ des na rgya gar du de ltar yin cing / bod du rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa/ rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bsam bzhin du sems can gyi don du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i bdag nyid chen po de nyid byang chub sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa/ dpal gyi sku'i skye ba'ang yin te/ de'i skad dod du dā na shrī zhes yod pas sbyin pa dpal dag pa yin no/ /sa chen gyi ru mtshams su nam mkha' dri med kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye/ zhes pa'i nam mkha' dri med ni/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nas dkyil 'khor che chung gnyis gsungs pa'i che ba nam mkha' dri med yin la/ 'di dang chos dbyings gsung dbang don cig chung ba la 'jam dpal seng ldang zer gsung / des na de lta bu'i bla chen de nyid/ sgyi chu na bzhugs skabs kyi dus cig na/ mdog stod du chos 'khor cig la/ bla ma se byon 'dug ces gleng ba dang / spyir bla chen gzigs mo sogs g.yengs ba'i rigs la mi dgos kyang / bla ma se bzang po yin zer ba dang / chos mtshams kyang yin pa nas sgyi chu ba'i slob ma ban chung 'ga' khrid nas byon te tshogs gral la bzhugs pas/ tshogs dbus na bla ma se bzhugs te 'ud mang po zhig gsung gin/

grogs po bon chung tsho la re re nas jo sras nyid yul ga nas yin/ yon tan ci shes da bshad pa bya'o/ /sgrub pa bya snyam pa ci yod gsung ba la so sos lan phul tshar ba dang / bla chen la jo sras nyid gang pa yin gsungs pa la/ grom pa la stod pha gi ba zhig lags zhus pas/ de ga na yod gsung / sa skya na bdog zhus pas/ de na nga'i bla ma cig bzhugs pa yin te/ de ni sku bshegs 'dug gdan sa bā ri ba bya ba cig gis bzung 'dug zer bas 'gro snying yang ma 'dod/ da de'i shul na ji ltar yod gsungs pa la/ de'i bu'i dod cig ka bdag lags zhus pas/ bla ma na re nyid brdzun ma byed zer/ nga'i bla ma la sras mi mnga' ba yin gsungs pa dang / bla chen thugs 'tsher nas lan 'debs ma nus pa la/ grogs po gcig gis/ rdo rje phyug mo la bu med de/ gu ra ba'i bu sring la mkhar sgo lung na yod pa la/ bla ma gnam gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas/ ma gcig mkhar sgo lung ma zhang mo bya ba la/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu bzhes pa/ chu pho spre'u'i lo la gnam kha 'ub skyed lhas kyi 'og brag skyibs zhig tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs pa'i mtshan la kun dga' snying po zhu ba lags zhus pas/ bla ma se'i zhal nas/ mi shi gson mi 'phrad zer yang / 'phrad pa'i dus byung gsung nas/ bla chen sku pang du blangs spyan chab mang du mdzad de/ rgad po gog po 'di'i nang na chos zab mo yod pa/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bla ma'i sras khyed la sprod pa yin pas zhag ma 'gyang par shog ga le yong snyam na sang phod ni nga 'chi ba yin gsungs/ bla chen gyis der zhag gcig bzhugs te/ de'i bar la bla ma ses/ lam 'bras kyi sa bcad sogs rkang grangs lam pa cig gsungs pas man ngag la thugs yid ches nas/ se'i bka' bzhin 'phral du 'byon dgongs yar sgyi chur byon/ sku chas rnams bsnams nas phyir byon pa dang / thugs dgongs la 'gro sdod bya ba spyod lam ci byed kyang /

bla ma la dgongs pa ma zhus na mi rung snyam nas slar log te sgyi chu ba la zhus pas ci la 'gro/ shes rgyu gang yang med/ nged kyi bla ma mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po'i man ngag gral grul 'dra ma gtogs gzhan yon tan cung zad kyang med/ se lce la re bya ba yin blo sna mang po bar chad yin gsungs te ma grol bar thugs mug bzhin du bzhugs dgos byung / se'i gsung de man ngag la brtsol ba bskyed dgos pa'i dran bskul tsam las de bzhin rang cung mi bden sang phod 'byon dgongs pa la/ ses ji ltar gsung pa bzhin bden te/ sku gshegs nas 'gyod kyang bya thabs ma rnyed/ de nas dus re zhig nas bla ma sgyi chu ba sa skyar spyan drangs te/ chos 'khor chen po zhig mdzad dgongs nas cha rkyen mang du bsgrubs/ slob ma 'ga' yang bsdus tshar mtshams/ sgyi chu ba bsnyung nas bla chen la shog gsung ba byung ste/ byon pas sku gshegs grub nas ma mjal/ khyod rab tu byung la 'khon tsho'i sde 'di skyongs shig gsungs pa'i zhal chem bzhag 'dug pa bzhin/ sgyi chu ba'i gdan sa bla chen la gtad/ de'i sku rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas sa skyar byon te/ bla ma'i zhal chems bzhin rab tu byung dgongs ser chas bsgrubs pa bla ma gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsan nas/ bla chen spyan drangs te/ rab byung gi chas bsgrubs nas ci byed gsungs pa la/ lo rgyus zhus pas/ khyed 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sras su yongs ba'i rten 'brel yang ngas bsgrigs pa yin/ rab tu byung ba las rigs brgyud spel ba bstan 'gro'i don rgya che zhing phan/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde slag tu bsgrub pas khong gshin po'i kha chems 'phar ma las/ nga gson po'i ngag la nyon gsungs ma gnang bas rab byung ni ma mdzad/ 'khon tsho'i dpon ni gnang / de nas sgyi chu ba mal gyis slob ma yin pas/ sgyi chu'i bde mchog gi phyag dpe rnams bsnams nas gung thang na la rtse gnas sar du byon te/

bla ma mal la bde mchog sogs mang du gsan nas phyir phebs/ slar gser srang bcu bdun sa skya nas 'bul du btang pas mnyes te khyod dam tshig can bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dug pa la/ ngas de ltar du cung ma shes/ da nga'i gam du shog chos kyi lhag ma da rung yod pas khyod la ster ba yin gyi gsung ba'i lan byung ba dang / bla chen gyis chos kyi phyir dka' tsheg gang la yang ma 'dzems par byon pas/ sbyong rgyud rab gnas kyi rgyud yan lag brgyad pa la sogs pa'i chos lhag ma rnams gnang / khyad par mgon po'i dbang / sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang / lung man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnang nas/ sku'i rten du bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes la mi la mis lab pa bzhin/ da nga rgas pas khyod mi dgos khyod rang 'khon sa skya pa'i phyir song la/ sa skya pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bka' gang bsgo ba bzhin sgrubs shig ces bka' bsgo dang bcas te gnang / gsung gi rten du dar nag la shā sa na bris pa/ thugs kyi rten du lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ 'phrin las kyi rten du man ngag gi bel 'bum bse'i ga'u 'od 'bar ba rnams gnang nas de rnams bsnams nas phyir byon lho stod du pu rang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ skyu ra a skyabs/ bal po'i slob dpon pad+ma shrī dang / dz+nyā na badz+ra/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa bho ṭa ra hu la rnams las bde mchog gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor sogs chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan te/ thugs rgyud lung gi yon tan gyis phyug par mdzad/ dad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma rnams mnyes par mdzad/ nang du rten 'brel 'grig pas yi dam lha yi zhal mang gzigs/ sku'i bkod pa drug cig char du ston pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon shes la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i bla chen de nyid kyis gsung ngag rin po che ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul ni/ gung thang nas sa skyar phyag phebs pa dang / se'i slob ma su grags dris pas zhang dgon pa ba rtsad chod de sag thag ding du phebs/

de na thag mkhan tsho gcig 'dug pa la/ zhang dgon pa ba la mjal zhus dang gsungs pas pha ki ka yin zer/ gzigs pas mi mang po zhig gi bseb thags mgo na sham thabs cig gsol/ shang 'gag med par ra thul phyi slog tu gyon nas yo ga mdzad cing gtam cal col mang po gsung gin bzhugs 'dug pas/ de'i drung du phyin nas phyag phul bas/ khyed ni ga shed kyi mi chen cig 'dra na/ de las kyang gsar ma ba zhig 'dra na/ nor ba mi nam gsungs ba la/ ma nor lags/ bdag gsung ngag rin po che zhu ba lags zhus/ khrab cig phyag rten du phul bas/ da ci ru nor byas te/ ngas de 'dra tsho mi shes/ de'i ming yang da res min pa ma thos/ nga ni rdzogs rtsa mun+ti dang bram ze'i chos bskor 'dra 'chad pa yin/ de kun nyan pa la khyed gsar ma ba bya ba rtog pa mi byed dam gsungs/ bskyar nas yang yang zhus kyang / de'i gdams pa nga la med gsung ba dang / spyod lam 'di yi mdzad lugs bsam/ nga rang nor ba yin nam/ man ngag rang med pa 'dra snyam nas khrab 'bog la bsgril te log byon pa dang / jo sras 'od mchog gi pha na res/ bla ma zhang pa lags/ 'o skol dpon slob mkhar chung na yod dus/ sgyi chu ba'i gra pa cig la/ nga yi bla ma'i sras yin gsungs/ sku pang du len pa de yin 'dra na slogs pas cang mi mchi'am zhus pas/ 'o na dam tshig gi nyes pa 'gro nyen yod pas bos gsungs nas/ bla chen spyan drangs yar byon te/ lo rgyus zhib tu mdzad pas/ sa skya pa'i jo sras yin par thugs yid ches te/ da ci ngas ngo ma shes par brdzun byas pa yin/ man ngag yod de/ sngar ngas ma bshad pas bsam mno 'dra bya dgos/ spyir yang da lta dor ka mdo bya ba'i smad 'di na/ so ston rdor chung gi paṇa chen/ paṇa chung / lo tsā ba dpon slob mang po la chos 'khor byed pa'i rtsar rnal 'byor pa rgad po gcig gis bshad pa byas kyang mi mdzes pas/ dpyid ka 'dir byon/ gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs par byed gsung /

dpyid ka byon nas phebs pa'i nub mo chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas bla ma shin tu mnyes par byung / de nas rim gyis sngon 'gro'i 'khrid tshugs pa'i nub mo/ rje+e'i ljags bskrangs nas chos gsung ma thub pas/ 'o skol gnyis kyi bar na dam tshig gi nyes pa yod par 'dug pas maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa la brtsol ba bskyed gsungs/ bla chen gyi thugs dgongs la gzhan nyes pa gang yang med/ kha sing gdams ngag rang med pa ka yin nam snyam pa'i log lta cig byung pas de yin dgongs te de la dmigs nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ yig brgya mang du bzlas pas sku khams 'phral du phan nas gsung ngag rdzogs par gnang ba'i dus su/ dka' ba'i gnad 'ga' zhig phyag la rde'u'i zin bris mdzad pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ de tshugs ma mdzad/ thugs dam gnod pas lags gsungs nas 'brir ma gnang / gdams ngag kyang gnad du bsnun te rim gyis gnang ba la/ jo mos khong la gdams ngag myur du byin mdzod zhus pas ci zer/ gdams ngag zab mo rnams khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa bzhin/ ci thod thod du btang ngam gsungs te/ rim gyis lam 'bras gnang nas dbyar thog dgun thog bzhi lhag tsam la gdams ngag rnams rim gyis zhus pas/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po se ston rin po che'i bla ma yin pas/ brgyud pa'i dam tshig la dgongs nas/ gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang / gzhan yang lam bskor phyi ma brgyad sogs kyi 'khrid/ dbang lung / rgyud man ngag sogs yongs su rdzogs par gsan ste/ mdor na lo bzhi'i bar bzhugs nas gdams ngag rnams rdzogs pa dang / sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i skabs su lo bco brgyad kyi bar du chos 'di gzhan la ston pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di 'dra yod pa dang / shes pa'i ming tsam yang ma 'don/ yi ger yang ma 'bri/ de nas gzhan la yang 'chad dam/ yi ger 'bri 'am gang byed kyang nyid rang chos kyi bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsung nas bka' rgyas btab/

spyir khyod kyi sgrub pa byas na tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ bshad pa byas na gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don du 'gyur zhing / khyad par lus ma spangs par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma gsum/ bzod pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad cu tsam 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan yang mdzad do/ /de nas lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bsnyel gyis dogs nas zla ba re la gsung ngag gi bshad pa ma lus pa la bsam mno tshar re/ nyin zhag re la rdo rje'i tshig rkang bdun re 'don pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas sa skyar byon/ bla chen gyi sku tshe'i stod yan la bka' rgya ma thim pas/ yi ge yang med de snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs so/ /de dag ni ring brgyud yin la/ nye brgyud ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa las dngos su gsan cing byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /de nas lo bco brgyad kyi bka' rgya thim pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis nyid la gsung ngag rin po che mnga' bar mchis kyang / bdag la yod pa'i 'phros tsam yang ma gsungs te bdag gis rtsad chod byung pas da lan tshar cig gnang ba dang / yi ge zhig kyang mdzad pa zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / bka' rgya thim pa 'grig pas bla mas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin dgongs nas tshar gcig gsung / de nas lo bzhi ma gsungs/ phyis 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab nas/ gcig dang gsum la sogs pa la rim gyis gsungs so/ /yig cha yang zhu ba po so so'i don du/ gzhung bshad rnam 'grel bcu gcig tsam yang mdzad de/ thog mar byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis zhus pa'i don bsdus ma sh+lau ka nyi shu pa ste gzhung bshad a seng ma dang / snyag ma/ klog skya ma/ zhu byas ma/ yum don ma/ sras don ma/ zla rgyal ma/ bzang ri phug ma/ 'a 'u ma/ 'dan bu ma/ rga theng ma rnams so/ /de dag gi sdom ni/

a snyag klog zhu yum sras dang / /zla bzang 'a ldan rga theng ngo / /zhes so/ /rje dgon pa bas lung bstan pa ltar/ slob ma gtso che ba ni/ sing gha gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ stag byang chub sems dpa'/ sgom pa kyi 'bar te gsum las/ siṅgha gling gi rnal 'byor pa ni/ mkhan po nyan thos dgra bcom pa gcig gis/ bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba yod kyis de can song gsungs/ a tsa ra gnyis yong pa gcig bal po nas log gcig bla chen gung thang na la rtser bzhugs pa'i dus ga gu li zhes pa zab chen gyi bla bre bzang po gcig phul/ dbang zhus/ 'khrid phog nas bsgom pas zla ba gcig tsam la mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa skyes/ bden pa mthong ste dpal gyi ri la byon no/ /stag byang chub sems dpa' ni/ dbang 'khrid zhus nas sgom pas nyams skyon med 'ba' zhig skyes pa thod sgal gyi lam bsgrod nas re zhig lus bor ba las/ phyis lus de nyid du zhugs nas grub pa thob ste mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /sgom pa kyi 'bar gyi yul/ phreng 'og pa ste khong gi gdams ngag zhus nas bsgom pas ting nge 'dzin mang po skyes mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa thob nas/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la gshegs so/ /de gsum ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa sku lus ma spangs par dag pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa grub pa thob pa'i slob ma gsum mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ zhu byas dngos grub/ rga ston/ nags sgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ sgom pa 'od grags/ mang chung ma rnams ni bzod pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdun las/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ sa chen gyi sras gsum pa ste/ 'di ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa/ skam chags med cing yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing bslab pa gsum la nyes pa'i dri mas cung zad tsam gyis kyang ma gos shing sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa chen po/

de nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu'i bar du sngags kyi bshad pa kho na mdzad cing / khyad par gsung ngag rin po che bla ma sa skya pa chen pos bka' rgya lo dgu mdzad pa las bzhis lhag pa bcu gsum gyi bar du ma gsungs/ de nas bdag nyid chen po sa skya pa paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po la gsungs shing dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ste mdor na nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu chos kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / lung bstan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtsod pa dang bral ba nyid do/ /bla ma zhu byas dngos grub ni/ yul la stod lho pa/ zhu ston rog po bya ba phar phyin 'chad shes pa'i mkhas pa gcig gi dbon po yin la/ khong sa skyar byon nas bla chen la dbang dang gdams ngag zhus bsgom pas rkang mgyogs dang rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa la mnga' brnyes/ de nas bod 'di so mi sod gsungs shing lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la gshegs/ lan gcig rje btsun sku mched kyi sgo rum gzim spyil dkar por tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i nub mo byon nas nam zla dgun po yin pa la 'o ma zi 'phreng ba rlon pa tshan gcig dang / 'bras kyi snye ma tshan cig gis phyag brten byas/ da nang gang nas 'ong gsungs pas/ da ci nyi ma zer ba la rdo rje gdan nas 'ong zer/ de nas tshogs mchod mdzad nas a po zhu byas do nub dam tshig gtsang zhing nyung bas rdzu 'phrul gcig ston gsungs pas/ de skad mi gsung ba zhu zer/ rtsab rtsob mdzad cing 'dug pa la/ mi to yis/ ston gsungs pas/ gnas de nyid kyi zhu byas pa rang gi phug par byon nas/ dar gcig na zhu byas pa cig 'thon phyag gsum byas nas gral la sdad/ de bzhin du bdun gyi bar rim pa bzhin 'thon nas phyag dang gral sogs sngar bzhin mdzad/ de nas rim pa bzhin nang du song nas sngar gyi de mdun du 'dug ste/ de tsam du gda' bo zer/

rje btsun sku mched kyi bka' gnang ba la brten/ zhu byas rang la sa chen gyis gnang ba'i gzhung bshad tshar gcig gsungs/ rje btsun rtse mo zin bris mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /sga ston rdo rje grags ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rus pa sga yin cing / 'dis bla ma sa chen dang / rje btsun gnyis ka la dbang dang gdams ngag zhus nas yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba yin no/ /nags bsgom ni yul rta nag pa ste/ bla chen la dbang dang man ngag zhus nas bsgom pas grol ba'i 'bras bu thob pa'o/ /mtshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ dge bshes snyag gi bzang brgyud 'brog pa'i gseb tu byon tsa na/ mgrin pa man chad thig les brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gzigs nas/ su'i slob ma yin dris pas/ bla chen mtshar khar byon dus 'khrid bskyangs pa yin zer/ bla chen gyis gung thang yan chod du byon pa ye med de/ sku'i bkod pa bstan pa yin par 'dug go /sgom pa 'od grags ni/ bla chen la dbang dang gdams pa zhus te bsgom pas/ mthong snang brtan pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /mang chung ma ni/ bla chen la dbang dang gdams ngag zhus nas bsgom pas thog mar dud 'gro'i gnas sbyong kho na byung / phyis yun ring du bsgom pas sdug bsngal gyi rkyen gyis kyang bde ba dpag tu med pa bskyed pa dang / na bza' re ba gon kyang lhag par bde ba'i grogs byed/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu thob pa yin no/ /de dag ni bzod pa thob pa bdun no/ /brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo rje btsun sku mched la sogs pa ste yab sras khu dbon brgyud pa dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsung ngag rin po che nyi ma shar ba ltar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong bir+wa pa'i zhal mnga' nas bkral bar gyur pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'di 'chad par byed pa la don gsum ste/

bshad thams kyi man ngag gang gis 'chad pa/ des bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs ba'i tshul/ nyams su blangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcus rgyas gdab cing skal ldan gyi slob ma phan par gdams pa'o/ /dang po bshad thabs kyi man ngag gang gis 'chad pa la/ bshad bya/ 'chad byed/ ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul las/ bshad bya ni/ zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag nyid do/ /'chad byed ni/ a seng mar/ tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yi spros pa bcad/ /ces gsung pas/ tshad ma bzhis gsung ngag gi dbu zhabs thams cad dang / snyan brgyud bzhis bye brag rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad kyi don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa yin no/ /de'ang tshad ma bzhi ni/ bla ma tshad ma ni/ gdams ngag ston pa la mi bslu bas tshad ma/ nyams myong rang gi nyams su myong ba la mi bslu bas tshad ma/ bstan chos ni lung gi dgongs pa 'grel ba la mi bslu bas tshad ma/ lung ni rang gi brten bya'i don la mi bslu bas tshad ma ste bzhi'o/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ni/ nyams su len rgyu'i chos 'di'i tshig don/ brda' lag len dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par yod pa'i sgo nas dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin gyi rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim par nus pa'o/ /zhes gsung pas bzhi dang ldan pa brgyud pa bar ma chad pa zhig dgos so/ /spyi don gnyis pa/ des bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gzhung shing chen po bzhi las/ gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri bar 'dod na/ thog mar snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas bkri/ de nas gzhung thams cad rgyud gsum du bsdu bas rgyud gsum gyi bkri zhes lam gyi sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi ste/ don tshan gnyis su bsdus nas nyams su len par gsungs pas/ 'dir yang de ltar bshad na sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas bkri ba'i 'khrid ni/

sems kun gzhi lam zab mo 'dis 'bras bu sangs rgyas gyi sar 'khrid par byed pas na 'khrid ces pa bshad pa'i gzhir bzhag gang 'khrid par byed na/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi de bzhin nyid 'khrid par byed pa yin no/ /gang du 'khrid ce na/ dag pa'i snang bas rab 'byams tshad med pa mnga' ba/ ston pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sar 'khrid par byed cing / thabs gang gis 'khrid par byed na/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'dis 'khrid par byed pa yin no/ /de la 'khrid ston pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ 'khrid dang dbang thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol zhing / byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing man ngag la brdar sha legs par chod pa zhig dgos so/ /gang gis nyan pa po'i slob ma ni/ bla mas ji skad smras pa la nyan cing / chos dang bla ma la dad pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ chos spyod bcu'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las kyang / slob mas gus pas blangs nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /des na gang dag ma dad pa rnams dad par bya ba dang / dad pa rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po brtan par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i rnam thar nyan la mos gus bsgom pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par bya dgos pas/ de la gsol 'debs kyi tshig 'phags pas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi lung bklags te/ de ltar lung thob pa ltar phyag mchod byed dgos pas/ rang gi gnas khang yid du 'ong bar/ bla ma dkon mchog gi rten gang 'byor bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod lnga tshar du bsgrigs pa/

rgyu dang gtong phod dang bstun rgya gang che bsod nams gsog pa'i brten du 'bul/ de'i mdun du srab mo'i stan la rang nyid 'dug ste/ lam 'bras phyag mchod rgyas pa'i sgo nas/ phyag mchod gsol 'debs la brtson par byas la/ de nas dmigs rim rnams/ kun tshang rgyas pa lung bzhag 'bring / /lung bshad gnyis bzhag bsdus pa ste/ /gsung ba ltar las/ rang ngos blo rmongs pa dang / shes rab dman pas/ rang gi brjed tho dang / rang dang bskal ba mnyam pa rnams la go bde ba'i phyir/ lung bshad gnyis bzhag bsdus pa ste gsung ba ltar/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang chen po la sogs rje bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i yang snying bsdus te/ rang re'i nyams su blang ba'i rim pa tho tsam bkod pa la/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba gdab/ /dngos gzhi rang rang dmigs pa nyams su blang / /rjes ni dge ba bsngo zhing dran shes brten/ /zhes gsung pa'o/ /dang po dang / tha ma gnyis ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i thun thams cad kyi thog mtha' kun la sbyar ba yin yang / 'dir skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid kyi tshe/ sbyor ba dngos gzhir bya dgos pas/ de la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ yul/ dus/ tshul/ phan yon/ bslab bya dang drug tu yod pa las/ dang po rgyu ni/ 'jigs dad snying rje gsum las/ dang po 'jigs pa ni/ rang gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa dad pa la/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jigs pa de dag las bskyob par nus pa'i skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan la sems dang ba ni dang ba'i dad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs yul de dag gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa ni 'dod pa'i dad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mos mi bslu ba la yid ches pa ni yid ches kyi dad pa'o/ /gsum pa snying rje ni/ theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig

rang gi sdug bsngal la rjes su spags nas/ gzhan sdug bsngal gyis nyan pa la mi bzod pa'i snying rjes kun nas blangs te de dag yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ seng ge'i btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas sa mnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing / mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / des byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku can du gsal btabs te bzhugs pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog de'i rgyab tu lung gi chos sde snod gsum mam gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa'i chos/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs brgyud la mnga' ba'i chos kyi ngo bo/ rnam pa po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu dar zab kyi na bza' sna tshogs dang / gdong dar khra chab kyi yod par bsam pa ni/ chos dkon mchog mtha' bskor du byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa dang / so so skye bo'i dge 'dun rang las bslab pa bgres pa'i gang zag rnams kyis bskor ba/ pad+ma'i rtsa bar chos srung nor lha rnams dngos su bzhugs par bsam pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar rang la zab lam dngos su ston par mdzad pa'i bla ma la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam pa ni bla ma dkon mchog ste de ltar skyabs yul gsal btab pa'o/ /gsum pa dus ni/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du'o/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ bshad ma dag pa'i skyabs yul de dag gi spyan sngar/

'jam po'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/ rang gi pha ma gnyis kyis thog drangs rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'khod nas/ lus kyis thal mo sbyar/ ngag gis skyabs 'gro byed/ yid kyis dad shugs drag po'i sgo nas gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro bar bsam la/ ngag tu bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor ma brgya rtsa stong rtsa la sogs pa yid dang 'dres nges shes byas rjes/ bla ma rin po che dang sogs nas/ bdag gi blo la chos ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i bar bla mchod bzhin dang / de'i rjes su byams pa dang / snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul rnams rang la thim pas/ de rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs/ mdzad pa'i 'phris kyis bskyong ba/ skyob pa'i nus mthus bsrung ba dang / skyobs pa dang / rgyud byin gyis rlobs par mdzad pa yin snyam du mos la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /rjes dge ba bsngo zhing dran shes brten pa ni/ bdag gi de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas pha mas gtso byas sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs ji ltar rigs pas bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes btab bo/ /dran shes brten pa ni/ thun mtshams thams cad du dkon mchog gi yon tan yid la dran pa dang / de'i rjes su slob par 'dod pa'i dran shes bzhin dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya rnams dang ma 'gal bar bya'o/ /lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon ni/ sdom pa thams cad skye ba'i rgyu sogs mtha' yas gsung ste/

mdo las/ skyabs gsol bsod nams 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' bar snang 'di yang snod du chung / /zhes gsung pa ltar ro/ /drug pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya ni/ spyi'i bslab bya skyes bu dam pa rnams dang 'grogs pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa la sogs pa dang / so so'i bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song bas sems can la gnod mtshe spongs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa la bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de ltar phyag mchod kyi rim pa dang / skyabs 'gro 'di rab thun drug gam bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ tha ma thun gnyis la sogs pa la 'bad dgos so/ /de lta bu'i gsol 'debs phyag mchod kyi rim pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba 'di la do nub kyi thugs dam mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs/ 'di la thun cig byed pa nyi ma dang po'o/ ༈ /nyi ma gnyis pa nas brtsams te/ snang gsum ma grol bar/ mdo dang yon tan rgya mtsho ma 'don pa/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing / bla mas 'dren mchog ma gsung ba sogs 'dra ba mdzad/ rlung bltas brtag mi dgos/ de nas sems bskyed dang / chos gsan pa'i kun spyod gsal btab nas/ chos gsan pa la yang thog mar lus ngag yid gsum ma gus pa'i skyon spangs nas/ gus pa chen pos rtse gcig tu chos la gtan nas gsan par bya dgos/ de la yang lus kyi skyon ni/ spyod 'jug gi shes bzhin bsrung bar byed pa'i le'u lnga pa las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo dkris dang / /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang / /mgo bo g.yogs pa dag la min/ /zhes dang / kha bkang ba dang sgra bcas dang / /kha gdang nas ni bza' mi bya/ /rkang pa brkyang nas mi 'dug cing / /lag pa mnyam par mi bsnye 'o/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ mi na bzhin du mgo dkris shing gos la sogs pas g.yogs te phur ba dang rkang pa brkyang pa dang /

nyal ba dang / bsnyes pa dang / thor gtsug bcings shing zhwa gyon pa/ gdugs dang / 'khar ba dang / mtshon cha thogs shing lus la gzer ba sogs ma gus par rgyags pa'i spyod pas brnyas bcos dang / gnyid log pa lta bu'i khyad sod kyi rnam pa sogs/ lus kyi skyon spangs nas tsog pur 'dug thal mo sbyar te dad cing gus pa dang ldan pas/ sems chos la gtad nas nyan dgos so/ /ngag gi skyon zla grogs ngan pa la long gtam smra ba dang / sngags dang gzhung sogs gshib bur 'don pa/ bzhad gad dang / brda' dang brda'i lan byed pa/ rtse 'jo bag med kyi spyod pa ngag gi skyon spangs te/ smra ba bcad de sems ma yengs par nyan pa'o/ /sems kyi skyon 'di skad ces gsungs te/ sems ni legs par nyon/ rab tu nyon la/ yid la zungs shig ces bka' brtsal to/ /de'i don 'di yin te/ sems ni legs par nyon zhes bya ba snod kha bub kyi skyon spangs dgos te/ ma spangs na snod kha bub tu chu la sogs pa rdzas gang yang mi chags pa bzhin/ gti mug gi sgo nas mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa'i rnam pas blang dor tshul bzhin ma go bar/ nyan pa'i dus su chos la rna ba mi gtod par sems rgya yan du btang na chos kyis phan mi thogs te/ bag chags tsam yang mi 'byung zhing / mi chags pas de bzhin gyi skyon spangs nas/ chos la sems rtse gcig tu gtad dgos so/ /rab tu nyon la zhes bya ba ni/ snod dri ma can gyi skyon spangs dgos te/ ma spangs na snod dri ma can du zas ro brgya dang ldan pa lta bu blugs na phan mi thogs pa'i khar chud zos 'gro ba bzhin/ bla ma 'dis ji 'dra zhig smra'am snyam pa'i skyon sgug pa dang / 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / phra dog 'gran sems sogs nyon mongs pa'i kun slong gi bsam pas chos nyan na phan cung zad tsam yang mi thogs shing / chos chud gsan nas ngan song du 'gro bas de'i skyon spangs te/ dad pa dang sems can la snying brtse zhing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/

gzhan la phan sems dang bcas pas nyan pa'o/ /yid la zungs shig ces pa ni/ snod zhabs brdol gyi skyon spangs dgos te/ ma spangs na snod zhabs brdol du 'bru la sogs pa gang blugs kyang / cung zad tsam yang mi gnas pa zags 'gro ba bzhin/ sems la dran skor ma byas par/ mnyam par ma bzhag na yid la mi gnas par zags te chos shes par mi 'gyur/ des na de'i skyon spangs te dran shes bzhin bsten pa'i sgo nas yid skad cig tsam yang ma yengs par shes pa bsgrims nas nyan pa sogs yid kyi kun tu spyod pa ste/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi skyon spangs te nyan dgos so/ /de la 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo zhes pa nas/ 'di ni gang zhes pa dang / nyan cing nyams su blangs par bya ba'i chos yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig brjod la de lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo 'chad par byed pa la/ thog mar rje btsun bir+wa pa la sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la mos gus bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ rnam thar gyi lung sbyin dgos pa zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar rje btsun gyis mdzad pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus rgyas pa dmar gyis mdzad pa/ rje sa chen gyi rnam thar che chung gnyis/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa rnams kyi lung bklags la/ de ltar bla ma brgyud pa bcas pa thams cad kyang rnam thar dang mthun pa'i yon tan 'di lta bu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bla ma 'di rnams dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin/ bdag la ni sangs rgyas las kyang bla ma bka' drin che/ sangs rgyas la dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba med/ bla ma la dngos su chos kyi bka' drin nod cing / rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas mgon skyabs dang phan pa mdzad cing / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma mchog dam pa yin te/

slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i rim lngar/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung ba yin/ /'khor lo sdom pa sbas pa yis/ /byin rlabs rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gsang 'dus rim lngar/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / dpal brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan gcig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas yon tan thams cad bla ma las bshad pas na bla ma la mos gus bcos min/ snying gi dkyil/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas skyes pa zhig byung na/ des bstan pa'i lam thams cad tshad mar 'gyur la/ de rang gi nyams su blang pas rang rgyud la nyams myong khyad par can tshad ma skye/ de gzhan la bstan na'ang phan thogs pa zhig 'byung ba yin/ de ma yin pa'i bla ma la ci yin med par ras chod dang / de bas yon tan sogs sgor ma nas nga rang lhag bsam pa'i nga rgyal skyes na byin rlabs mi 'jug cing yon tan cung zad tsam yang mi skye bas/ 'phags pa nor bzang gi rnam thar bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas yon tan kun rang gi bla ma las 'byung ba yin snyam pa'i mos gus khyad par can skye ba'i phyir du/ bla ma'i rnam thar rnams nyan dgos pa yin no zhes dang / dad pa dgos tshul sogs gong bzhin ji ltar rigs par brjod/ de nas dad pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag des sngar bshad pa ltar gyi gnas yid du 'ong bar nyams su len par byed pa la sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi rang rang gi dmigs pa nyams su blang ba/ rjes dge ba bsngo zhing dran shes bsten pa'o/ /de la sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

skyabs 'gro'i rgyu sogs nas/ gsol ba btab ste bstim pa rnams shar tsam gyis gsal 'debs byas la/ gnyis pa rang gi dmigs pa rnams nyams su blang ba la/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba/ zhes gsung bas de la ma dag pa'i snang ba'i 'khrid/ nyams kyi snang ba'i 'khrid/ dag pa'i snang ba'i 'khrid gsum las/ dang po ma dag par snang ba'i 'khrid la gsum/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa'o/ /dang po la rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sems can la nyon mongs pa la dag pa'i snang ba/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la gzhi'i rten ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams sna gcig kyang rgyud la ma skyes pa'i gang zag rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa yin kyang / ting nge 'dzin gang yang rung ba cig rgyud la ma skyes pa'i tshe/ snang ba thams cad ma dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ro/ /de'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa dug gsum mo/ /snang ba rang gi ngo bo ni ma dag pa'i snang ba ste/ snod bcud thams cad tha mal par snang ba'o/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba ni/ de'i steng du nying 'khrul du 'gyur ba dang / las kyi snang ba ni/ rigs drug gi snang mkhan so so'i ngo bo/ chu phor pa gang lta bu la dmyal ba pas khro chu khol mar snang / yi dwags kyis snag khrag dur 'gros gnas khang / mis chu/ lha ma yin gyis go mtshon/ lhas bdud rtsir snang mod/ de dag thams cad 'khrul snang kho na yin pas/ de nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ gzhung las/ sems can la/ zhes pas bstan te/ sems can gyi khams la brtags na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das par shes pa 'byung bas so/ /des na 'khor ba las gtan du thar pa'i thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis 'khor ba la zhen pa ldog dgos/

'khor ba la zhen pa spongs ba'i phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran dgos/ nyes dmigs dran pa la bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes dgos so/ /de skad du/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsungs las/ mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/ /khams gsum gyi zhen pa spang yang 'tshal/ /khams gsum gyi zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran yang 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /mdo las kyang / 'dod pa'i khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa ste/ /gzugs kyi khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin gzugs med khams kyang skyon dang bcas/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig skyon med mthong / /zhes dang / mgon po byams pas kyang / mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin/ /'gro lnga dag la bde ba med/ /de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu med/ /mtshon rgya tsha la sogs rig bskyed bzhin/ /zhes so/ /'o na 'khor ba na sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod ce na/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung pas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag gi don bsam pa la gsum/ sdug sngal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung las/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin/ /de legs par bsams na skyi sha 'bung / /thog tu bab na sran thabs med/ /spong ba'i dge ba mi byed par/ /ngan song gi so nams byed byed po/ /de ga na 'dug kyang the le le/ /zhes dang / pras ston zhus lan las kyang / sdug bsngal sdug bsngal ngan song gsum gyi gnas/ /'dze nad shu ba'i steng du rma 'bras bzhin/

/legs par bsam na sran par ga la nus/ /de bsam mi dge'i las la ldog par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag gtan la dbab pa la/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po la grang dmyal/ tsha dmyal/ nye 'khor nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chu bur chu bur brdol pa can/ /a chu kyi hud so tham tham/ /ut+pal pad+ma pad cher gas/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ de dag gi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ de re re la'ang gnas/ lus rten/ rkyen/ sdug bsngal/ tshe tshad/ rgyu sogs drug drug go /grang dmyal brgyad po 'di dag tsha dmyal gyi lho phyogs kyi thad na yod cing / des na chu bur can gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ de la dang po gnas ni/ mtha' thams cad gangs ri chen pos yongs su bskor ba'i ljong / chab rom gyi thang chen po 'jigs zhing ya nga ba'i ngam grog dang / kha ba bu yug gi reg bya rnon pos nyen par/ snang ba'i cha skar ma'i 'od tsam la yang rten rgyu med pa mun pa'i gling chen po/ dro ba'i rten gos gyon pa/ khang pa/ ra ba'i skyibs/ me nyi ma sogs la sdod pa'i skal ba ga la yod/ lhan pa tshal pa tsam la yang brten rgyu med par rang gi sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu thog tu smin pa'i gnas ni de lta bu/ gnyis pa lus rten ni/ lus bong che zhing / gzhon sha can/ bzod sran sha'u las kyang chung ba zhig rang nyid gcig pu rdzus skyes su dkrong gi skye bar 'gyur ba ni lus so/ /gsum pa rkyen ni/ rlung sogs grang ba'i reg bya shin tu grang bas lus la btab pa'o/ /bzhi pa sdug bsngal ni/ de lta bu'i rkyen gyis lus phyi nang thams cad 'khyags te/ nang gi gsher rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'thon nas lus thams cad chu bur gyi tshogs grangs med rog ste mthon nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong dgos so/ /lnga pa tshe tshad ni/ mdzod las/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing /

/til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ yul ma ga ta'i bre bo che'i til khal brgyad cu 'gro ba'i bang ba lta bu zhig phyur bur bkang ba de la/ til sbyangs ba gcig zer/ de nas mi lo brgya brgya na til rdog po re re phyir phyung pas til de zad par gyur pa ni/ chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/ 'og ma rnams ni 'di las nyi shus 'gyur te/ dper na chu bur brdol pa can la ting sbyangs pa nyi shu yin gyi nyi shus 'gyur zhes pa ni ma yin no/ /gang ltar gong ma gong ma las 'og ma 'og ma nyi shu'i 'gyur gyi tshe de dag kyang rag pa tsam yin la/ zhib par ni/ de bas kyang ches ring ba zhig yod pa mdo las gsungs so/ /drug pa der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang drag po'i kun nas blang ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi na bza' sogs dang / dge 'dun gyi na bza' bshus pa/ mar me'i rgyu dang 'od la longs spyod pa/ sems can gyi gos lham khang khyim phrog pa la sogs pa mi dge ba tshab chen bsags pa ni de lta bur skye bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu'o/ /gnyis pa chu bor rdol pa can ni/ gnas phal cher snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ sdug bsngal ni grang ba'i reg bya nyi shu 'gyur gyi che bas chu bur rnams kyang brdol te khrag dang chu ser sogs 'dzags cing / de dag kyang chab rom gyi phung por gyur te shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /gsum pa a chu zer ba ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyi shus 'gyur gyi che bas a chu zhes ngu mo'i sgra lhang lhang sgrog pa'o/ /bzhi pa kyi hud zer ba ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyi shu 'gyur gyi che bas a chu zer ba'i nus pa'ang med par/ mgrin pa'i phug nas kyi hud shib bur 'don pa'o/ /lnga pa so tham tham pa ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyi shus 'gyur gyis ches bas/

lus kyi spags pa rlung gi reg byas dbad pa la brten nas ut+pal ltar sngon por gyur pa yang tshal pa bzhi dang / brgyad dang / bcu drug la sogs pa gas shing / de yang lus bong shin tu che bas/ gas pa de rnams kyang ri chen po'i grog ral lta bur song nas nang khrol rnams kyang gas te/ de dag nas khrag dang chu ser 'dzag pa yang 'khyags te chab rom gyi phung po chen por gyur te sdug bsngal ba'o/ /bdun pa pad+ma ltar gas pa ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyi shus 'gyur gyi ches bas/ phyi'i lpags pa sngon po de yang / kha ba'i bu yug dang / rlung gi reg bya che ba'i stobs kyis shus nas khyer te/ lus sha'u gso ma ltar dmar brjen brjen pa de nyid tshal pa so gnyis dang / brgya la sogs pa lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gas te/ de rnams kyi nang nas lugs kyi srin bu mchu brno ba mtshon dang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung nas/ des lus kyi phyi nang thams cad phug cing / rkang mar dang rgyus pa dang nang khrom thams cad 'jibs pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /brgyad pa pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyi shus 'gyur gyi che bas/ lus snga ma ltar dmar brjen brjen pa 'dra ba la/ tshal pa brgya dang stong la sogs par gas pa'i stobs kyis nang khrol rnams kyang phyir mthon zhing gas/ lcags kyi srin bu rnams kyis 'bigs pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /de dag thams cad kyang gong ma gong ma las/ 'og ma 'og ma rnams tshe dang lus bong / sdug bsngal nyi shu 'gyur gyi che ba'o/ /gnas kyang chu bur can gyi 'og na mar rim pas brtsegs nas gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i don nyams su len pa la/ rang re rnams sngon bskal pa grangs med pa nas da ltar gyi bar du sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig myong bar gyur cing / slar sdug bsngal de lta bu zhig mi 'byung ba zhig yin na legs mod kyi/

da dung gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul 'khor 'di ma zhig gi bar du rigs drug gi skyes gnas rnams su rang dbang med par skye zhing / sdug bsngal drag po myong dgos byung na ji ltar bya/ khyad par grang dmyal brgyad por skyes na/ gnas/ lus/ rkyen/ sdug bsngal/ tshe tshad/ rgyu sogs ni de lta bu/ de dag bdag la mi 'byung ba'i gdeng ni med/ 'byung ba'i rgyu khong khro ni nyin zhag re la yang grangs med pa zhig skyes yod pas der skye ba ni thag chod/ sdug bsngal de thog tu bab na bzod par ni mi 'dug bdag gis bgyi ba ji ltar bgyid/ de bas na de'i gnyan pa dam pa'i chos rnal ma zhig bya dgos/ de'i nang nas kyang da res gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'di zhus la sgo gsum rtse gcig tu dril nas nyams su myong nges zhig bya/ de ltar du 'gyur ba bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes kha zhe med par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bsgom/ de ltar chos bsgrub pa'i blo tsam skyes pa la yang phan yon dpag med yod na lam zab mo nyams su blang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas de thams cad gzhan don du bsngo snyam pas ngag tu bdag gi gsung sngags rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dmigs rim zab mo nyams su blang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces dang / dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /sogs tshig bcad kyi sgo nas kyang bsngo ba dang smon lam btab/ spyod lam thams cad du yang dge ba'i bya ba la brtson pas dus 'da' ba'o/ /de yang dmigs pa snga ma la nyams ma skyes par/ phyi ma mi spo gsungs kyang / ding sang dmigs pa mang po nyin re bzhin ston pa'i phyag srol 'di ni/ sgom tshul gyi gnad dang / dmigs rim gyi lung thob par byas nas/ slar dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi dang g.yengs ba thams cad spangs nas/

mthar ma phyin bar bsgom pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /de ltar rab thun drug sogs gong dang 'gre'o/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma gsum pa la/ thog mar sems bskyed gsal btab/ zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig sogs gong bzhin/ mtshams sbyar la/ lung rje btsun rtse mo'i rnam thar chen mo khyod nyid ma/ tshangs spyod ma rnams rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar mnal lam ma dang / sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsan yig chen mo lho pa rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa dang / 'phags pas mdzad pa rnams kyi lung bklags/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ gong gi dmigs pa rnams shar tsam byas la/ do nub kyi dmigs pa ni/ tsha dmyal brgyad las/ yang sos thig nag bdud 'dzoms dang / /ngu 'bod ngu 'bod chen po dang / /tsha ba rab tsha mnar med brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'di rnams la yang gnas sogs drug gi dang po gnas ni/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ rdo rje gdan nas 'og tu dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na mnar med pa'i gnas yod/ de'i steng na yar rab tu tsha ba sogs bdun mtho brtsags su gnas so/ /dang po yang sos pa'i gnas ni/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me rab tu 'bar zhing / mya ngan gyi thang 'jigs shing ya nga ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa lus ni/ sems can dmyal ba pa de lus bong che ba/ tsha sran dang 'jigs sran chung ba/ gzhon sha can zhig tu rdzus skyes su skye ba'o/ /gsum pa rkyen ni/ skyes ma thag yid mi dga' ba'i dbang gis/ kye ma bdag 'di lta bu'i gnas su skyes pa la/ gzhan dag gi 'tshe ba ma byung na legs te snyam nas phyogs kun tu bltas pas/ las kyi dbang gis phyogs mtshams thams cad nas dgra mi sha bo'i rnam pas/ gang 'thong ma thag zhe sdang drag po skyes nas rtsod par bsam pa dang / lag tu blang tshad thams cad mtshon cha rno ngar dang ldan par gyur nas/

phan tshun 'thabs pa'o/ /bzhi pa sdug bsngal ni/ de ltar mtshon cha rnams bshan pas srog chags la ji ltar byed pa bzhin/ cig car lus la rdeg pa dang gcod pa dang / 'bigs pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pos bzod pa dka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong zhing / mthar lus brgya stong du btubs pa la brten nas/ cung zad cig shi ba'am brgyal bar gyur kyang / de ma thag nam mkha' nas las kyi dbang gi yang sos par rgyur cig ces pa'i sgra dang bcas pas rlung ser bu zhig lus la phog pa'i rkyen gyis lus sngar bzhin du gyur ma thag dgra mi sha bos mtshon cha bsnun pa sogs sngar bzhin sdug sngal gyi tshor ba rgyun mi chad par nyams su myong ba'o/ /lnga pa tshe tshad ni/ mi lo lnga bcu la zhag gcig zhag sum cu la zla gcig zla ba bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i lo lnga brgya rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i thub/ de zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya yang sos pa'i tshe tshad do/ /drug pa der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ zhe sdang drag pos srog bcad pa la brten nas 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa thig nag pa ni/ gnas ni yang sos pa'i 'og na/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi sngar bas tsha zhing mi sdug pa'o/ /lus kyang sngar ma las nyis 'gyur gyi bong che zhing sran chung ba sogs so/ /rkyen ni lus la thig nag gdab cing / de steng sog les bshog pa sogs/ sdug bsngal ni/ dmyal srung a wa glang mgo dang / sdig pa sbrul mgo la sogs pa/ lus shin tu che ba/ ngam gnag pa/ bzhin khros shing rngam pa/ kha mig nas me stag khro ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis snying 'gas pa lta bu'i gshin rje'i pho nya sna tshogs pa'i mtshon sna tshogs thogs nas 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'ong ste/ rgyobs shig sod cig la sogs pas nga ro 'brug stong ltar sgrog pa'i sgo nas sems can dmyal ba pa de bzung nas gan rkyal du byas te/ lus la shing mkhan gyis byed pa bzhin/ thig nag po brgyad dang /

bcu drug la sogs pa btabs te/ de rnams kyi steng nas gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis sog le rnon po me 'bar bas 'dral bar byed cing / lus kyi stod gshog pa'i tshe smad kyi rma rnams sos shing / smad gshog pa dang stod kyi rma rnams sos par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang sta re la sogs pa rnon pos gzhogs cing btubs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo stong / sum cu rtsa sum pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo stong thub bo/ /rgyu ni gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa bdud 'jom pa ni/ thig nag pa'i 'og tu/ gnas ni gong bzhin las nyis 'gyur gyi tsha zhing mi sdug pa/ lus kyang gong bzhin las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba/ rkyen ni/ tsha ba'i reg bya ma bzod de 'gros pa'i bsam pas phyogs kun tu bltas pas sdug bsngal ni/ brag ri che zhing mtho ba/ ngam za ba/ g.yag ma he/ ra lug rta sogs 'tshe ba gang byas pa de'i gdong pa can du 'byung ba'o/ /de lta bu'i brag ri gnyis kyis ded pas shin tu 'jigs shing gros kyang ma thar bar/ ri gnyis kyi bar du lus btsir zhing phye mar byas nas khrag gi rgyun mi zad par 'bab pa'o/ /yang brag ri gnyis phyir cung zad gyed pa dang / las ngan dbang gis lus sngon bzhin grub ma thag sngar bzhin btsir ba sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo nyis brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i/ rang lo nyis stong mtha' bral ba'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong thub bo/ /rgyu ni gong bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ngu 'bod pa ni/ bdud 'jom pa'i 'og tu gnas ni gzhan snga ma bzhin las/ nyis 'gyur gyi nyams nga ba/ lus ni nyis 'gyur gyi che ba/ rkyen ni shin tu 'jigs pas phyogs kun tu bltas pas/ pha tshad zhig na/ khang pa dkar po bad dang bcas pa yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong ste/

der 'gro 'dod kyi bsam pas/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng la/ stab stab por tsha reg du ma myong bzhin phyin pas/ mthar khang pa de'i sgo rang phye la song nas sdug bsngal ni/ nang du sleb pa dang / sgo rang bcad la song ste/ phyogs kun tu me 'bar ba'i lcags bsregs kyi khang pa sgo med du gyur nas/ lus sdong bu snum ldan la me 'bar ba ltar/ sha rus rkang mar gyi bar tshig cing sdug bsngal drag po myong ba la brten nas ngu mo'i sgra snying gi dkyil nas phyung ba bzhin lhang lhang sgrog pa las gzhan thabs med pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo bzhi brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo bzhi stong dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo bzhi stong thub bo/ /rgyu ni/ spyir gong dang 'dra la/ khyad par sdom ldan rnams kyi khyad gsod kyi kun nas slang ste chang 'thung pa rnams so/ /lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ ngu 'bod kyi 'og tu gnas rkyen sogs nyis 'gyur rnams gong dang 'dra/ lus gong las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba/ sdug bsngal ni lcags bsregs kyi khang pa nyis rim du tshud de bsregs pa'i sdug bsngal nyis 'gyur gyi che bas ngu mo'i sgra yang snga ma bas kyang cher sgrog pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo brgyad brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong 'khrul dga' ba'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong thub bo/ /rgyu ni gong bzhin no/ /drug pa tsha ba pa ni/ ngu 'bod chen po'i 'og tu/ gnas nyis 'gyur ma gtogs 'dra/ lus kyang snga ma bas nyis 'gyur gyi che ba/ rkyen ni sems can dmyal ba pa de nyid 'jigs te phyogs kun tu bltas pas/ dmyal srung 'jigs pa rnams mthong ma thag 'di dag gi 'tshe ba byed dam snyam pa blo la shar 'phral de rnams kyis rgyobs sod sogs 'jigs pa'i nga ro drag po sgrogacing mtshon cha du ma thogs pas bdas nas bzung ste sdug bsngal ni/

lcags bsregs kyi gsal shing rtse gcig pa me 'bar ba bshang lam nas spyi bo'i bar thal byung du bsnun te phug pas kha sna nas me lce lhab kyis byung zhing 'tshad pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo stong drug brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig du byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong thub bo/ /rgyu ni zhe sdang drag pos dmag gi las la dga' zhing srog gcod pa la brtson pa rnams so/ /bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ tsha ba'i 'og tu gnas dang / rkyen dang / rgyu rnams nyis 'gyur ma gtogs gong dang 'dra'o/ /lus bong gong las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba/ sdug bsngal ni/ dmyal srung rnams kyi lcags bsregs kyi gsal shing me rab tu 'bar ba/ ral gri ltar rno ba'i rtse gsum pa zhig thogs nas/ bshang lam dang 'phong tshos gnyis nas bsnun te/ phrag gong gnyis dang / spyi gtsug gi bar du phug la lus kyi nang khrol thams cad tshig cing / gzhob tu byas te/ kha sna sogs lus kyi bu kha thams cad nas khrag zhag 'dzags pa dang / du ba dang me lce 'thul cing 'bar nas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni bar skal phyed thub pa'o/ /brgyad pa mnar med kyi gnas ni/ thams cad kyi 'og na lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi rab tu 'bar ba shin tu me 'bar ba mi sdug pa/ rgya che zhing g.yang sa dang ngam grog can/ phyogs bzhir lcags bsregs kyi thab rgya dang dpang dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu yod pa'i nang du dmyal ba de lus snga ma las gzhon sha sogs nyis 'gyur gyi che ba bzod sran chung ba ni lus/ rkyen ni lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi thab dang bcas pa las me rang 'bar du song nas rab tu tsha bas bsnun pa'o/ /sdug bsngal ni/ dmyal ba pa de'i lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me rab tu 'bar te lus me dang tha mi dad par gyur nas/ lus mgar me'i sol nang na lcags kyi gong bu rab tu tshig pa ltar me stag phrom phrom bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos rtag tu mnar ba ste nyams thag pa'i sgra la brten nas/

'di na sems can dmyal ba pa zhig yod pa 'dra snyam du rtogs pa las/ lus dang me dbyer mi phyed pas sdug bsngal lo/ /mnar med ni srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams kyi nang nas mthar thug pa yin no/ /tshe tshad ni bar skal gcig go /rgyu ni khyad par du bla ma las dam tshig nyams pa'i rtsa ltung phog pa dang / btsun pas dmag dpon byas pa sogs sde gzar slong mkhan rnams so/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre'o/ /'di rnams kyi don sgom pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyin bzhi pa la/ sems bskyed zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig sogs gong bzhin/ lung 'phags pa'i rnam thar shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lung bklags/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la nye 'khor nye tshe ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ mdzod las/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam/ /spu gri lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes dngos su smros pa bzhi yin te/ mtshon cha la ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal dang / shal ma li'i sdong bu gnyis phye bas drug po 'di dag tsha dmyal brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi na gnas te/ sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul ni tsha dmyal dngos gzhi'i sdug bsngal las thar ba dang / da ni bdag bde ba'i gnas gzhan zhig tu bros nas 'gro snyam du sems zhing ring pa ring par shar phyogs su phyin pas/ thog mar me ma mur gyi 'obs 'jigs su rung ba yod pa la/ 'di na thang bde mo zhig 'dug go snyam nas tsham tshom med par phyin pas lus pus mo man nub pa dang / sha thams cad tshig nas rus pa skya khrol te 'gro/ rkang pa g.yas btegs pa dang / sngar ltar g.yon tshig yang btegs pa na sos/ skabs su 'phrang ma tshugs par 'gyel bas/ lus kyi sha lpags thams cad tshig ste rus pa la thug par gyur pa'i shin tu sdug bsngal bskyed par byed do/ /de'i las zad nas thar pa na/ ro myags kyi 'damachu snyog ma can lta bu zhig mthong ste/

sngon shin tu tsha bas gdung pa la brten nas bsil bar 'dod pa dang / skom pas der zhugs pas lus thams cad nub te/ dri nga zhing rang gtsog pa'i ro myags kyi 'dam zhes pa/ mi ro rta ro sogs cher rul drags sngo dmar nur nur por 'dug pa dang / gzhan yang phyi sa dang / gtsog pa'i zhu ba thams cad pa'i 'ob shin tu dri nga zhing yid du mi 'ong pa/ da lta'i dus su dri tshor ba tsam gyis srog 'phrog pa/ de lta bu'i nang du srin bu lus ser zhing mgo gnag pa/ lcags kyi mchu rno ngar dang ldan pa dag gi lus phan tshun du 'bigs shing / rkang gi bar du za ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bar byed do/ /de'i las zad nas thar pa na/ spu gri brdal ba'i thang ni/ ne'u bsing lta bu yid du 'ong ba'i gnas zhig mthong ste/ der song bas spu gri brgyang shing tsam kha gyen du bstan pas gtam pa'i lam po cher gyur te/ rkang pa gang dang gang bzhag pa de dang de dum bur btubs pa la brten nas/ tsha ba'i reg bya ma bzod pa'i rtab shor te 'gyel ba las lus thams cad dum bu brgya stong du byas pas sdug bsngal de nyid/ las ma zad bar myong ba'o/ /yang de las thar ba dang / ral gri lo mo'i nags tshal ni/ rgyang ring po zhig na nags tshal yid du 'ong ba stug po zhig 'dug pa mthong ste/ 'bad brtsol drag po'i sgo nas phyin te sleb nas ljon shing gi bsil grib la cung zad cig ngal gso ba'i rnam pas 'dug pa la/ las kyi dbang gis rlung drag po langs pas nags tshal drag tu g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis lo ma rnams chad cing 'ong pa ral gri so gnyis rno ngar dang ldan pa'i char du gyur nas dum bur btubs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bas shin tu bskrag te/ phyogs kun tu bros kyang las ma zad bar thar ba'i go skabs med do/ /yang de las thar pa na shal ma li'i sdong po ni/ nags kyi gseb nas stag dang / dom dang / spyang ki la sogs pa'i gcan zan gdug pa can 'jigs su rung ba lcags kyi mche rder yod pa du mas ded cing brdas pa na/

ri yid du 'ong ba chen po zhig mthong ste/ rtab rtab po myur rab bros pas/ ri de'i rtsar sleb pa'i tshe mi zad pa'i cho nge drag pos bos kyang skyob par byed pa su yang med pas mthar gcan gzan de rnams kyis dbang med du sgyel nas sha rus dang / nang khrol gyi bar za zhing sdug bsngal lo/ /de'i tshe ri'i rtse mo nas sngar rang gi chags yul du gyur pa'i skyes pho mo gang rung gis rang gi ming nas brjod cing nga 'di na yod ces 'bod pa'i snang ba cig byung ba dang / de don du gnyer te/ ri la 'dzegs pa na/ ri shin tu gzar ba/ ngos thams cad shal ma li'i sdong po zhes bya ba lcags kyi tsher ma rab tu rno ba/ sor brgyad dang / bcu drug la sogs pa thur du gzings pa dag gis lus thal phyung du phug cing / sha thams cad zad par byas te lus rgyus pa shad pa ltar/ sdug bsngal bzhin du ri'i rtser sleb pa dang chags yul du gyur pa de ni mi snang la/ dmyal ba'i bya shin tu 'jigs su rung ba lcags kyi mchu sder can gyi kaṃ ka dang / khwa ta dang / bya rgod dang / bya dkar sogs mang pos gan skyal du bsgyel te snying khar lcags kyi sder mos gdab/ lcags kyi mchu rnon pos klad pa sbru ba/ mig 'don pa/ lce 'byin pa/ lto ba dbral te don snying nang khrol rnams za ba/ sha 'thog pas nyams thag pa'i nga ro 'byin bzhin pa'i sdug bsngal ba myong bzhin pa las/ slar chags yul des ri'i rtsa ba nas sngar bzhin 'bod pa snyam byed pa thos nas/ las kyi dbang gis 'bad pa drag pos bya'i tshogs de dag las kyang 'bros par bsams te/ phyir log te thur du bab pa ni/ tsher ma thams cad rtse mo gyen du bstan pa dag gis lus phug cing 'dral te snga ma bzhin du sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'o/ /ri'i rtsar bslebs kyang chags yul du gyur pa de ni mi snang la/ sngar gyi gcan gzan 'jigs pa de dag gis za zhing brad pas/
