bslab pa khas ma blangs pa'i khyim pas byas na stobs chung ngo / /de yang mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i rten can gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rtsi mar gyis bkangs pa'i mar me de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phul ba bas byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bas sdong bu 'ga' zhig snum gyis sbags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten bzhug pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo them snang ba tsam byas na de snga ma bas bsod nams che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du rab tu byung ba la 'byung nye zhing stobs che ba ngan song du mda' 'phang pa ltar 'gro ba'i chos bzhi/ myur du 'gro ba'i chos bzhi/ song nas thar dus med pa'i chos bzhi ste/ bzhi tshan gsum las/ dang po ni/ byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las 'byung ba'i don/ bslab pa nyams pas dad rdzas la spyod pa/ ltung ba byung ba shes bzhin bshags pa mi byed par khyad gsod byed pa/ nyes ltung byung ba la bshags sdom mi byed par zhag tu 'grogs pa gzhan gyi phun tshogs la phrag dog gi sdang ba ste bzhi ni/ dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin 'gro ba'i chos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyod 'jug la sogs pa nas gsung pa'i don/ bsnyen pa dang bkur sti mang bas khengs pa dang / thos pa mang bas nga rgyal te khengs dregs byed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs la mchog tu 'dzin pa khengs pa dang / bsod snyoms sogs de rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa ster ba dang / mdza' bshes mang pos zhabs tog rgya chen pos khengs pa ste/ bzhi ni dmyal bar myur du 'gro ba'i chos so/ /gsum pa ni/ ltung ba sde lnga'i lci yang bstan pa'i mdo sogs kyi don no/ /rtsa ltung gi nyes pas gos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la bkur pa btab pa dang / dam pa'i chos la dmod cing brnyas pa dang / log par lta ba ste/ dmyal ba nas thar dus med pa'i chos bzhi'o/ /kun slong gi sgo nas zhe sdang gis kun nas blangs ba'i las rnams mi dge ba gzhan las stobs che ste/

nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa 'bum du 'dod chags kyi kun tu spyod pa spyad pa las yul sems can su yang rung ba zhig la khro ba'i sems theng gcig skyes pa sdig che'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du yul khyad par can la khong khro'i sems skad cig ma skyes na'ang / bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dus gcig la 'dzoms par gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /ces dang / dgos byed kyi sgo nas dge sdig gang byed kyang / gzhan don du byed la stobs che la/ rang gcig pu'i don du byed pa stobs chung la/ des na gang zag gzhan gyi ched du sdig pa byas kyang / rnam smin byed po rang la 'byung gi gzhan dag gi skal ba mi len pa'o/ /mdor na las dge sdig du 'jog pa phal cher/ las rang gi ngo bo las kun slong gtso che ba yin te/ dper na ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa lta bu/ las rang ngos nas mi dge ba ltar snang yang / kun slong shin tu bzang bas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs zlum pa'i dge bar gsung pa bzhin no/ /de skad du chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ gzhan gyi don gyi sems ldan pas/ /pham pa bzhi po spyad na yang / /nyan thos rnams kyi sdig pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge chen yin/ /zhes dang / mang po skyabs phyir gsod pa sogs/ /las nag rnam smin dkar na bya/ /zhes sogs/ de bzhin du rang gi kun spyod la gzhan yid ches nas/ bsnyen bkur 'byung ba'i ched du/ sgo gsum dge ba ltar snang du bsgrub pa ni mtshan ma'i rnam g.yengs zhes bya ba mi dge ba 'ba' zhig yin te/ rngon pas ngur smṛg gi gos gyon nas ri dwags gsod pa dang / g.yo can gyis ri dwags kyi rnga ma bstan nas bong sha btsong ba dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/

/de skad du chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ ri dwags rnga ma ma bstan na/ /bong sha 'tshong bar mi nus ltar/ /de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na/ /log pa'i chos kyis bslu mi nus/ /zhes so/ /des na dge sdig thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems dge mi dge las rag las pa'i phyir/ rtag tu sems dge ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa la/ lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa/ de la 'bras bu med par bsam pa/ de dge bar 'gyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lung ma bstan zhes bya ba/ dge ba yang ma yin/ sdig pa yang ma yin pa'i/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa 'phral gyi spyod lam btang snyoms pa rnams te/ de dag ni gong du smos pa'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang / dug gsum med pa gang gis kyang ma bskyed pa'i sgo gsum gyi las yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de 'bras bu med par bsam pa ni/ de dag gi ni 'bras bu bde sdug ci'ang bskyed par mi nus te/ lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du rje sa paṇa gyis/ btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin pas/ /rnam par smin pa'ang gnyis ka min/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa de dge bar kha lo bsgyur ba ni/ las de dag gi sdug bsngal mi bskyed pa'i cha nas bzang mod kyang / bde ba mi bskyed pa'i cha nas byas pa don med kho na yin pas thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis dge bar 'gyur dgos pa'o/ /ji ltar na dbang po'i spyod yul du gang dang gang snang ba de la rung mthun gyi tshig sbyar te/ de yang rgyal sras lam bzang las gsungs pa ltar/ khyim gyi nang du 'dug pa'i tshe thar pa chen po'i grong khyer thob par gyur cig de bzhin sbyar ste/ nyal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par gyur cig rmi lam byung na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs par gyur cig gnyid sad pa'i tshe ma rig pa las sad par࿁ ldang ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs thob par gyur cig gos gyon pa'i tshe khrel yod kyi gos gyon࿁

ske rags 'ching ba'i tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar gyur cig stan la 'dug pa'i tshe byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje'i gdan thob par࿁ rgyab bsten pa'i tshe byang chub kyi shing thob par࿁ me gtong tshe sdig pa'i bud shing bsregs par࿁ 'bar ba'i tshe ye shes kyi me 'bar bar࿁ g.yos zin pa'i tshe ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thob par࿁ zas za ba'i tshe bsam gtan gyi zas thob par࿁ phyi rol du 'gro ba'i tshe 'khor ba'i grong khyer las thar bar࿁ skas la 'bab pa'i tshe sems can gyi don du 'khor bar 'jug par࿁ sgo 'byed pa'i tshe thar pa'i grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed par࿁ sgo gcod pa'i tshe ngan song gsum gyi sgo gcod par࿁ lam du 'jug pa'i tshe 'phags pa'i lam du 'jug par࿁ gyen la 'gro ba'i tshe sems can thams cad mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god par࿁ 'thur la 'bab pa'i tshe ngan song gsum rgyun gcod par࿁ sems can dang 'phrad pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'isangs rgyas dang mjal bar࿁ rkang pa 'jog pa'i tshe sems can gyi don ston par࿁ rkang pa 'degs pa'i tshe sems can thams cad 'khor ba las 'don par࿁ rgyan dang ldan par mthong na sbyang pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyan thob par࿁ rgyan med par mthong na sbyang pa'i yon tan dang ldan࿁ snod gang bar mthong na yon tan gyi gang bar࿁ stong par mthong na skyon gyis stong par࿁ sems can dga' ba mang po mthong na chos la dga' bar࿁ mi dga' bar mthong na 'dus byas kyi dngos po la mi dga' bar/ sems can bde ba mthong na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba'i yo byad thob par࿁ sems can sdug bsngal ba mthong na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar࿁ nad pa mthong na sems can thams cad nad thams cad las grol bar࿁ sems cad yid du 'ong bar mthong na sems can thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid du 'ong bar thob par࿁ gzugs mi sdug par mthong na sems can thams cad mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mi mos par࿁

drin du bzo ba mthong na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la drin lan len par࿁ drin mi bzo ba mthong na lta ba log pa la drin du mi bzo bar࿁ rab tu byung ba mthong na 'phags pa'i chos la 'jug par࿁ dka' ba spyod par mthong na dam pa'i chos la dka' spyod nus par࿁ go gyon par mthong na mi dge ba'i chos la go cha mi gyon par࿁ rgol ba'i sems can mthong na phas rgol gyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod par࿁ sems can bstod pa mthong na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstod par࿁ grong khyer mthong na thar pa'i grong khyer mthong bar࿁ nags tshal mthong na lha dang bcas pa'i bsti gnas su gyur cig chos ston pa mthong na sangs rgyas kyi chos la spob pa zad mi shes par࿁ chu la brgal ba'i tshe 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar࿁ khrus byed pa'i tshe lus dang sems dri ma med par࿁ tshad pa tsha ba'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba bsil bar࿁ grang ba'i tshe mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsil ba thob par࿁ chos kyi gtam byed pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par࿁ sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong ba'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad lta ba la sgrib pa med pa'i mig thob par࿁ mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe 'gro ba thams cad mchod pa'i rten du࿁ lta ba'i tshe lha dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad lta ba'i 'os su࿁ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi spyi gtsug ltar mi mngon par thob par࿁ bskor ba byed pa'i tshe thams cad mkhyen pa'i don dang mthun pa thob par࿁ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i tshe yon tan zad mi shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin par࿁ de bzhin rung mthun rtsis la 'tshong byed pa mthong na 'phags pa'i nor bdun thob par࿁ zhing la chu lud 'grems pa'i tshe byang chub kyi sems kyi lo tog rgyas par࿁ sa bon 'debs pa'i dus su sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyi sa bon skye bar࿁ glang dor du sdebs pa'i tshe thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel bar࿁

rmos byed pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i thal ba brlog par࿁ yur ma 'don pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i yur ma 'don pa࿁ rtsas rnga ba'i dus su ye shes kyi lo tog bsdud par࿁ g.yul byed pa'i dus su sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'don par࿁ nas 'thu ba'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par࿁ skas la 'dzags pa'i tshe sa bcu rim gyis mthar phyin par࿁ khang par sleb pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin par gyur cig ces bya ba la sogs pa bya ba ci byed pa thams cad de dang cha mthun par shes par bya'o/ /'di dag ni blo dman pa rnams kyi gzung bla ba'i phyir bstan pa yin no/ /rgyas par ni spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo nyid du lta bar bya'o/ /des na dug gsum med pa'i dge las ni de lta bu/ de las kyang lus ngag yid gsum gyi las mi dge ba bcu las log te/ dge ba bcu bsgrub pa ni/ de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ mtho ris kyi lus rten thob pa/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ tshe ring ba la sogs pa mtho ris kyi phun sum tshogs pa rnams 'byung ba/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ tshe rabs gtan du bde ba'i rgyu dge ba bsgrub pa/ bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzil mdangs sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na dge ba'i las zhes bya ba ni/ rang la phan bde sgrub pa'i ming du 'dug pas/ bdag gi sngar dge ba byas pa dang / gzhan byed du bcug pa dang / byas pa la rjes su yi rang bgyis pa de rnams legs 'dug da dung bdag gi dge ba phran bu tsam yang khyad du mi gsod par gus pas bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de yang le lo dang phyi shol gyi dbang du ma song bar byas te/ da lta nyid nas bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /myur ba nyid du bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du snying thag pa nas bsam/ de bzhin du bdag gi 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa'i 'phral gyi spyod lam 'di dag phal cher lung ma bstan zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'bras bu med pa'i las su 'dug pas/

'di rnams kyang thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i las la ci 'gyur zhig la 'bad par bya'o/ /des na dge sdig blang dor sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin du spang blang ma byas na de bas blun pa su zhig yod snyam du bsam zhing blang dor la brtson par bya'o/ /gal te mi dge ba'i sdig pa stobs chen byed pa kha gcig la 'dir snang gi bde skyid kha che dbang thang gzhan las che ba 'byung ba ni/ skye ba phyi mar myong 'gyur gyi bde skyid thams cad tshe 'dir sdig pa stobs chen byas pa'i mthus tshe 'di'i bde ba kho na la zad nas/ phyi ma phan chad ngan song gi sdug bsngal myongs dgos pa'i rtags su gsung zhing / dge ba stobs chen byed pa 'ga' zhig la sdug bsngal gzhan las che ba 'byung ba ni/ tshe phyi ma phan chad du ngan song sogs myong 'gyur gyi las rnams dge ba stobs can byas pa'i mthus tshe 'di yi sdug bsngal tsam du zad par byas nas/ de phan chad sdug bsngal myong mi dgos shing byang chub kyi lam thob par gsungs so/ /des na chos snying nas byed pa rnams la na tsha sogs de lta bu byung na/ 'di 'dra 'ong ma thang ba la byung bas bla ma dkon mchog la thugs rje med cing las 'bras mi bden pa 'dug snyam du bgyid lugs mi byed par/ chos kyi 'bras bu sdig pa dag cing dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba las lhag pa ci yod/ bla ma'i thugs rje yin snyam du dga' ba bsgom par rigs te/ mdo las/ na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin/ /zhes gsung pa'o/ /de lta bu'i las 'bras la yid ches nas blang dor tshul bzhin du spyod na ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba'i gdeng thob pa yin no/ /de yan chad kyi nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi bkri ba bstan zin to/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ 'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bco lnga pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar/

de'i kha bskong dang bcas pa/ sa los mdzad pa'i lung bklags/ dmigs pa/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ spyi don gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba'i 'khrid ni/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba zhes pas bstan te/ de la gnyis las/ rnal 'byor pa la zhes pas thun mong gi rnal 'byor pas thun mong gi nyams rnams rgyud la skyes skyes bsgom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pas thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams rnams sngags lam du skye 'gyur gyi nyams la nges shes skyes skyes su bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ nye ba la byams pa bsgom pa/ dgra la byams pa bsgom pa/ de thams cad bsre ba'o/ /dang po nye ba la byams pa bsgom pa ni/ rtsa ba'i ma la bsgom pa la/ thog ma med pa nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma drin can rnams yal bar dor nas/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde'i don du gnyer ba ni mi rigs te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ bdag gcig pu thar pas phan pa med/ /khams gsum gyi sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar rtsa ba'i ma de shi 'am gson yang rung / bzhin kha dog dbyibs sogs zhib tu bsam la/ ma 'di'i zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal du chud ma zos par bskyangs/ phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten/ gnod pa'i zas dang spyod lam spangs nas dal 'byor gyi lus 'di bskyangs pa yin pas drin che/ phyir btsas nas kyang shir ma bcug par srol bskyong gi sgo nas srog skyabs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i tshig gis bos so/ /kha zas bsnyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ lus kyi drod kyis bsros/ nu zhos bskyong zhing / skad cig kyang 'bral mi phod par gces spras kyis bskyang pa'i drin can gyi ma yin snyam du bsam/

gzhan yang za lugs/ mthung lugs slab/ smra ba dang brjod pa slab/ blang dor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan/ mthar ma rang yal bar dor nas/ bdag na'i dogs/ shi yi dogs/ rim gro byed pa sogs brjod kyis mi lang ba byas/ bdag gi ched du nyin dal rgyu med/ mtshan gnyid rgyu med/ srog la yang ma 'dzems par bsgrub pa'i zas nor 'phang med du byin/ bsam rgyu/ sgom rgyu bdag min par med par rang las gces par bskyangs/ der ma zad 'jig rten gyi khams na/ dkon mchog gi sgra tsam thos pa yang dkon pa la/ rnam pa thams cad du rang gi byung na/ bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba'i dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas pa 'di shin tu bka' drin che snyam du bsam/ de na ma 'di la drin lan gcig glan dgos pa la ma 'di bde ba la 'khod na drin lan pas gnas skabs su lha mi'i bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam du bsam la/ bdag gi ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig de la bdag gi 'god par bya'o/ /drin can gyi ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes pa yang dang yang du lan brgya la sogs par grangs bzung la bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas ma la byams pa bcos min skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du pha la sogs nye 'brel gzhan rnams la yang da lta phan gang btags pa bsam pa dang / tshe rabs gzhan du pha ma yang yang du byas pas phan btags/ gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin can sha stag yin snyams du bsam/ de la drin lan mjal 'dod la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du sbyar nas/ rtsa ba'i ma dang khyad par med pa'i byams pa ma skyes gyi bar du grangs gzung la bsgom pa 'dra/ tha mal pa dang bsre ba ni/ yul mi khyim tshes la sogs pa rang dang zas kha lag gi 'brel pa yod pa rnams yid yul du bsam la/ dngos su 'di lta bu'i 'brel pa'i sgo nas phan btags/ brgyud nas tshe rabs mang por pha ma byas nas phan btags tshul sogs snga ma bzhin sbyar zhing byams pa ma skyes kyi bar du grangs gzung la bsgom pa 'dra/

gnyis pa dgra la byams pa bsgom pa ni/ rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra'am gdon la sogs pa zhe sdang skye ba'i yul du gyur pa de yid yul du bsam/ 'di yang bdag gi thog ma med pa nas kyi ma yin pa la/ da lta bdag bur ma shes pa'i gnod pa bskyel kyang / tshe rabs mang po'i ma yin/ ma byas res kyis phan btags shing gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin bsam pa sogs snga ma bzhin sbyar zhing byams pa ma skyes kyi bar du grangs gzung la bsgom pa 'dra/ gsum pa de thams cad dang bsre ba ni/ bzang spyod las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du/ sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyang rang gi ma ma byas pa med de/ ma yi thog mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bur byas kyang sa yi lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar ma yang lan grangs du ma'i bar du byas/ byas res kyis phan btags shing gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin can yin yang / las nyon gyis sems bsgribs/ skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa la brten nas mar ma shes pa gzhan du bzung ba de ma legs/ des na ma rgan sems can 'di dag gnas skabs su lha mi'i bde skyid sogs/ gong snga ma ltar bsam nas sbyar zhing / byams pa ma skyes kyi bar grangs gzung la bsgom pa 'dra/ sems can thams cad ces spom yor byas pas bsam pa dka' na/ rigs drug so sor 'phral nas dmyal ba'i sems can 'di rnams kyis kyang ma lan grangs du ma byas pa sogs bsgom tshul gong dang 'dra ba so sor 'phral nas bsgom mo/ /de ltar bsgom pas sems can thams cad la phan 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa skyes na byams pa 'byong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa snying rje bsgom pa ni/ sems can la dmigs pa/ chos la dmigs pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi ma yid yul du byas te/

drin yod tshul/ tshe rabs mang por ma byas tshul sogs sngar bzhin bsam la/ de ltar ma 'dis bdag gi don byed byed nas 'khor bar khyams shing sdug bsngal du mas mnar ba 'di nyid snying re rje/ 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba cig byung na ci ma rung / bral ba la 'god par bya'o/ /bral bar gyur cig de ltar 'gyur ba bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes yang yang bgrang bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du pha la sogs pa'i gnyen dang / sems can tha mal pa rnams dang / rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra sogs la gong bzhin snying rje sgom par 'dra bar bsam mo/ /der ma zad sems la rang dbang ma thob par gzhan la gnod par byas pas 'bras bu mnar med kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa snying re rje snyam du bsam pa'o/ /de bzhin du rigs drug so so nas ma byas shing drin gyis bskyangs tshul/ drin lan mjal 'dod sogs snga ma'i rigs 'gros sbyar te/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na dga' ba'i blo bcos min bskyed do/ /gnyis pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ dmigs pa sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ma rig pa dang bral bar 'dod pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ma rig pa ma spangs na 'bras bu sdug bsngal spong mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sdug bsngal de yang / rgyu las dang / nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa la brten nas 'byung bar 'dug pa na/ 'di rnams ma rig pa dang bcas pa snying re rje snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ni/ dmigs pa/ sems can ngo bo nyid kyi ma grub kyang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bdag tu 'dzin pa dam pos bcings pa rnams la dmigs nas/ rnam pa sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bral bar 'dod pa'o/ /des na sems can thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pa la/

de ltar ma shes par sems can bdag tu 'dzin pa dam pos bcings pa 'di rnams snying re rje zhes bsam pa'o/ /ji srid du ngar 'dzin yod pa de srid du/ 'khor bar las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba len dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ 'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu drug pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung sa lo'i rnam thar phyed lhag tsam bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ gsum pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ smon pa dang / 'jug pa dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan don gyi ched du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la smon pa'i sems te/ byang chub kyi sems de rgyu gang las skye na/ snying rje chen po las skye ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub tu mngon par mos pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni/ snying rje chen po yin no zhes so/ /des na rgyu snying rje med na/ 'bras bu byang chub kyi sems mi 'byung zhing / snying rje'ang byams pa'i rtsa ba can yin pas/ byams snying rje gnyis bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyed de/ pha ma drin can 'di rnams sdug bsngal las 'don pa bdag la babs cing de ltar spro yang / da lta bdag la de lta bu'i nus pa med/ bdag las lhag pa'i tshang pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa chen po rnams la'ang med/ nyan rang sogs 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa rnams la'ang med/ su la yod na/ sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa dang sangs rgyas thob nas kyang / sems can thams cad so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par rigs can gsum gyi byang chub la 'god par byas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las dbugs phyung nas rigs can gsum ka rim gyi sbyangs la/

mthar sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o/ /snyam pa'i blo bcos min ma skyes bar bsgom pa ste/ smon sems dmigs 'khrid du byas nas nyams su len pa ni brgyud pa 'di kho na'i lugs yin no/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i don du gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa'i snying rje'i kun nas blang ste/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos so/ /'o na rdzogs byang thob pa'i thabs ci lta bur yin na/ rang don dor nas gzhan don bsgrub pa yin no/ /'o skol rnams 'khor ba las ma thar ba'ang pha ma yal bar dor/ rang nyid zhi bde don du gnyer te rang don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas lan pa yin/ rang bde bar 'dod na gzhan la gnod pa skyel ba sogs mi dge ba'i bya bas sdug bsngal myong ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /des na bdag 'dzin la dgrar ltas/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad gzhan don du ci 'gyur bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /de nyams su len pa la/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom pa/ brje ba bsgom pa/ de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las dang po pa rnams thog ma nyid nas bdag gzhan brje ba sgom mi nus pas dang po mnyam pa tsam la blo sbyang te/ gom nas brje ba la rim gyis 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas te/ de la bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i don ni/ bdag bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ltar ma rgan sems can rnams kyang bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pas/ da phan chad bdag gi sdug bsngal spong ba ltar sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yang spangs/ bdag gi bde ba bsgrub pa ltar sems can gzhan yang bde ba la 'god par bya'o/ /snyam du yang bsam zhing / de'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /gal te bdag gis sems can gyi sdug bsngal sel bar dang / bde ba bsgrub pa dam bcas kyang / de ltar bsgrub par mi nus so snyams na/

las dang po pas dngos su ma nus kyang snying thag pa nas bsam pa de lta bu dang ma bral bar byas te/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas rang gi nus tshod kyi gzhan la phan pa ci nus bsgrubs pas/ rim gyis gzhan don rgya chen po 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs bgre/ 'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu bdun pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung sa lo'i rnam thar ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'phros rdzogs par bklegs la/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ gnyis pa brje ba bsgom pa ni/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gal te bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i sems tsam la brten nas sangs rgyas 'grub par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu mtshan sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas drin can yin pa'i sgo nas drin che/ de'i phyir sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ bdag gi bde bas de kun bde thob shog snyam du bsam dgos/ bsam sbyor de las log te/ rang bde ba'i ched du gzhan sdug bsngal la sbyar na sangs rgyas thob pa lta zhog 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /rang gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'di dran 'dzin drag pos 'phral du ma brtul na sangs rgyas thob pa smos ci 'tshal/ 'dir snang gi bya ba'ang mi 'grub ste/ dpon slob grogs mched nye 'brel sogs/ su dang 'grogs kyang / dgos med kyi gral la rtsod/ gdan la rtsod/ zas la rtsod/ tha na tshig mtho sman tsam yang mi bzod par/ 'thab rtsod kho na'i dus 'da'/ mi tshe tshang ma 'dod pa ma 'grub cing / mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i ngang la 'gro/ rang sdug pa ma gtogs gzhan gyis gang du'ang mi brtsi ba zhig las mi 'ong ngo / /mdor na nyes pa thams cad bdag gces 'dzin las byung ba yin pas/

gces 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas bdag 'dzin 'dul ba dang / phan bde thams cad gzhan don byas pa las 'byung ba yin pas/ bde dge thams cad ma rigs drug gi phyogs su btang ba'i blo skyes na/ tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / thos bsam bsgom gsum sogs dge ba'i bya ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro bas chos byed kun gyi gnad 'di nges pa shin tu gal che'o/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang la blangs pas gnod dogs nas bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom mi nus so snyam na/ skyon med de/ de ltar bsgom pa'i phan sems kyis gzhan la cung zad phan zhing / rang la mi smin par ma zad/ goms pa'i stobs kyis rang la gces 'dzin gyi blo log ste/ de la brten nas sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba yin la don sangs rgyas la brdzun mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ gzhan don bsgrubs pa nyid kyis rang don bsgrub pa yin no/ de'i ched du da res kyi tshe thung 'di la bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po brtul nas/ drin can gyi ma rigs drug gi sems can 'di rnams la/ drin lan chos kyis 'jal thub pa zhig bya/ ma rigs drug gi brgyud kyi sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing ma rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa rnams ko skyi gris gzhar ba bzhin nag nyil gyis phyung ste/ rang gi snying khar thim par bsgom/ des thag khra la sbrul du 'khrul pa ngo shes pa ltar bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po gzhi med rtsa bral du song bar bsam/ bdag brgyud kyi bde dge rnams sems can la smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing / rang gi bde dge thams cad snying kha nas nyi ma shar ba bzhin gsal lam ste/ ma rigs drug la byin pas/ bde dge phun sum tshogs pa thob par bsam ste/ de ltar gtong len gnyis snying thag pa nas bsgom zhing / sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog

/ces yang yang brjod/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba sems can gyi don du ci 'gyur gyi thabs la brtson par bya/ slar bdag gces 'dzin gyi blo skyes na/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi dbang du ma song bar bya'o/ /gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu na tsha dang / sdug bsngal drag pos bzod blag med pa byung na 'di ltar bsam ste+e/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag ltar du na tsha'am/ sdug bsngal drag pos nyams thag mang po yod nges/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gi 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig ces sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du dmyal ba tsha grang sogs rigs drug gi gnas gang na sdug bsngal yod pa de thams cad/ bdag gi 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig ces sngar bzhin bsgom/ yang dgra 'dre yi gnod pa byung na/ de gnyis kyi tshe rabs mang por bdag gi ma byas phan btags/ gnod pa las skyabs pa'i drin can yin yang / da lta sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis bdag la gnod pa byed pa snying re rje snyam du bsam la gtong len bsgom/ de ltar byas na rkyen ngan nyid byang chub kyi lam du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa la/ byang sems spyi'i bslab bya ni/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po thams cad pha ma sems can rnams la btang bas/ rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes 'byung bar gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing / dngos su rang gi sems can gzhan la yo byad sogs sbyin pa phra mo re gtong ba la bslab/ rim gyis je cher btang / de ltar bsgom pa'i dbang gi mthar rang gi lus srog kyang gtong nus pa sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /mdor na bdag gis kyang sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa brlab po che rnams tshul bzhin du spyod pa bslab po che rnams tshul bzhin du spyod pa dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang /

snod ldan gyi 'khor bsdus nas dam pa'i chos bstan te don nyams su len du 'jug pa dang / rang nyid kyang gzhan phan bya ba'i phyir chos nyams su len par spro'o snyam du bsam mo/ /rang smin par byed pa phar phyin drug la bslab dgos pas/ de la mtshan nyid ni/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu phyin par byed pa'i thabs gang zhig ces pa drug ka la spyir sbyar nas/ rang gi dngos po gzhan la gtong ba sbyin pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnod pa spangs te phan 'dogs pa tshul khrims kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa la sems mi 'khrug par khro ba spangs pa bzod pa/ dge ba bsgrub pa la spro zhing / brtsol ba bskyel pa brtson 'grus/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba bsam gtan/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa shes rab kyi mtshan nyid do/ /de dag bsgrub pa la/ mthun phyogs kyi yon tan bzhi ni/ ser sna dang khrims 'chal la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs drug spong ba/ drug po re re bzhin mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi 'dod pa rdzogs pa/ byed las theg pa gsum gyi sgo nas sems can smin par byed pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnams gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshul khrims sogs gzhan lnga la'ang sbyor/ mi mthun phyogs kyi chags pa bdun ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin la/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /zhes sogs drug char la sbyar nas gsung ba'i don spang bya mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang / khrims 'chal sogs drug la chags pa/ de bzhin du phyi shol dang / chog 'dzin dang / lan dang / mi mthun phyogs kyi bag la nyal dang / g.yeng ba la chags pa rnams spangs te/ ma chags pa bdun la slob pa'o/

/de dag kyang / spang bya phyi shol chog par 'dzin/ /lan dang rnam smin bag la nyal/ /rnam par g.yengs la chags pa ste/ /bdun po 'di dag mkhas pas spang / /zhes rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bslab pa'i phan yon ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sbyin pas longs spyod tshul khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ /snying brtse ba yis don kun 'grub/ /ces gsung pa ltar don la gnas pa'o/ /gzhan don bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bslab pa ni/ sbyin pa gtong ba'i kun slong ma dag pa rang nyid tshe 'di'i che thabs dang / lan dang rnam par smin pa la re ba sogs kyis ster ba dang / yul ma dag pa dman pa bor nas/ phyug po dang rgyal po dang / smad 'tshong ma la ster ba dang / dngos po ma dag pa sha chang dang / gsod sar phyugs ma ster ba sogs ma dag pa'i sbyin pa rnams spangs te/ dag pa'i sbyin pa'i 'khor bsdus nas/ ngag snyan pa smra zhing las 'bras kyi chos ston pa'o/ /don spyod pa ni/ chos thos kyang nyams su len mi spro ba rnams la thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas bsgom du 'jug pa'o/ don mthun pa ni/ gzhan dge ba la 'jug pa'i phyir rang dge ba'i bya ba la brtson 'grus byed par 'gyur ro/ /'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ ༈ nyi ma bco brgyad pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar gyi phyed tsam gyi lung bklag dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ gsum pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la gsum las/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bshad pa/ de rgyud la skye ba'i thabs dngos bstan pa/ thabs de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gnyug ma sems kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas spros pa dang bral bar rtag tu gnas pa ste/

de nyid 'khor 'das bde sdug thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de nyid brgyud la skye ba'i thabs ni/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gnyis te/ de yang zhi gnas ni/ sems gnas pa'i thabs la brten nas rnam rtog thams cad zhi te/ sems kyi rang mdangs la 'jog cing gnas pa yin la/ lhag mthong ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs bsal nas chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ma 'dres pa so sor 'byed cing gnyug ma sems kyi rang zhal mthong bar byed pa'o/ /gsum pa thabs ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gsum las/ zhi gnas bsgom pa/ lhag mthong bsgom pa/ zung 'brel bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la rgyab kyi phyogs nas/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshig drang por bsrang ba/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar rgyangs pa/ mgrin pa cung zad dgug pa/ mig sna rtse la dbab pa/ lce rkan la sbyar ba ste/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par bya'o/ /de ltar rkang pa skyil krung sogs lus gnad 'di rnams mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lus gnad yin pas/ 'di shin tu phan yon che ste/ sngon dka' thub kyis gdung ba'i phyi rol pa'i bsam gtan pa lnga brgya la/ rang sangs rgyas dang 'grogs pa'i spre'u lnga brgyas spyod lam 'di lta bu bstan pas/ de rnams kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ nang pa'i bsam gtan pa lnga brgyar gyur pa bzhin no/ /ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ dmigs rten mi g.yo ba/ lus mi 'gul ba/ rdzi ma mi 'phrab pa/ dmigs rten kyi rnam pa gsal ba ste bzhi dang ldan dgos pa la/ dang po ni/ me tog sngon po 'am/ gos dar gyi ras ma sngon po gang rung zhig rang gi mdun ngos nye ring 'tshams pa zhig tu mi g.yo ba 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ lus drang por bsrang zhing / phrag pa mnyam par bzhag cing / mgo bo mi mtho zhing mi dma' ba/ phyogs gcig ru mi g.yo ba/

sna nas lte bar drang por bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ mig gi yas lcibs kyis mig 'bras kyi phyed tsam bkab la/ dmigs rten gyi steng du mig zim gyis blta zhing / mchi ma la sogs pa byung na yang / lag pas mi reg par ci bder 'bab du 'jug pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ legs nyes la sogs pa'i rtog dpyod mthong ba ma yin par rnam pa gang yin pa de nyid rtog med kyi shes pa la gsal sing nge'i tshul du 'char du 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar bzhag pas sems dbyings na kha zas cha 'phri/ gos gdan srab par bya/ skyabs 'gro sogs skad gsangs mthon pos brjod/ lus sems hur byung la bsgom/ rgod na de las bzlog pa'i thabs kyis bsal lo/ /mdor na bying rgod gnyis kyi dbang du ma song ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar gnad du bsnun te bsgom pas/ dang po rnam rtog gcig rjes la gcig 'byung ste/ nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog ngo shes kyi nyams yin no/ /de ltar byung yang bsgom pas rnam rtog gcig sting la gcig 'phro la/ bar skabs su zhi mal 'byung ste/ nyams gnyis pa rong khung dog mo'i chu lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog ngo shes kyi nyams yin no/ /slar yang nan gyis bsgom pas/ rnam rtog log nas mi rtog pa la 'gro ba 'byung zhing / de'i 'phro la yang rnam rtog tho lo lo skye ba 'byung ste/ nyams gsum pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu zhes bya ba rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams yin no/ /slar yang de'i 'phro 'thud cing bsgom pas rnam rtog gi rgyu ba phal cher zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung / de'i ngang nas rnam rtog gcig 'thud gnyis 'thud re tsam 'byung yang / de ma thag zhi bar 'gyur te/ nyams bzhi pa mtsho brlabs dang bcas pa lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog brlabs bcas kyi nyams yin no/ /slar yang rgyun de la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du thams cad zhi nas sems rtse gcig gnas pa gsal cha dang bcas pa zhig 'byung ste/

nyams lnga pa mtsho brlabs dang bral ba lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog zhi ba'i nyams yin no/ /sems gnas kyang dang cha ma rnyed na skyon yin pas/ gsal seng nge shar ba/ mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu zhig ma byung bar du bsgom dgos te/ sems kyi rang mdangs gsal ba snang ba de nyid la cher gyis gsal le/ sing nge / ye re/ hrig ge 'asbring nge / sems la sems kyis blta ba'i tshul du bsgom pa'o/ /'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ ༈ nyi ma bcu dgu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar gyi 'phros dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa/ snang gsum mdzes rgyan gyi phyed tsam bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa lhag mthong bsgom pa ni/ de ltar zhi gnas bsgom pa la brten nas sems gnas pa'i gang zag des/ lhag mthong bsgom pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos ste/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs la spyad pa de'i tshe/ yod med dam/ rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de lhag mthong yin no/ /de'i don gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ snang ba sems su bsgrub pa/ sems sgyu mar bsgrub pa/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol gyi ri ra ba khang khyim/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad gser dngul/ rta glang la sogs pa dngos por snang ba 'di dag thams cad kyang / phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pas byas pa yang ma yin/ 'byung ba bzhi dang rdul phran las grub pa yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa lta bu yang ma yin gyi/ 'di dag thams cad sus byas na/ rang gi sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas/ snang ba de dang de'i bag chags gom zhing 'thas pa'i stobs kyis rang gi sems kyis byas yin snyam du bsam mo/

/sems las logs zhig na byed pa po gzhan med snyam du nges shes bskyed par byas la/ nges shes de'i steng du gyis/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ /gnas lugs brjod du ma bstub pa/ /brjod bral gyi ngang la gang dgar bzhog /ces dang / sems thog mar skye ba med pa la/ /gnas pa dang 'gags pa ga la srid/ /skye 'gag med pa bsam pa yang / /rnam rtog yin gyi zhog la thong / /bzhag pa rang yang zhog la thong / /'jog pa rang yang rnam rtog yin/ /zhes gsung so/ /'di don bsgom pa thun gcig byed ces gsungs so/ /'di don bsgom la thun gcig byed/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ ༈ nyi ma nyi shu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung snang gsum mdzes rgyan ma rdzogs tsam bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa/ gsum pa zhi lhag zung 'brel bsgom pa dang / nyams kyi snang ba'i gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi dmigs pa gnyis kyi/ dang po zung 'brel bsgom pa ni/ zhi gnas kyi skabs su rnam rtog gi 'jug pa thams cad zhi ste/ ci yang yid la mi bya ba de dang / lhag mthong gi skabs su yang dag pa'i shes rab kyi sgro 'dogs thams cad chod de ci yang yid la bya rgyu ma rnyed pa gnyis/ ci yang mi bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor du ro gcig tu bsres nas zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'o/ /de yang bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor dang / bsgom byed kyi thabs dang / sgom pa sngar gyi zhi nas de'i rtsis zin par bya'o/ /de yang rje btsun gyi nyams mgur las/ chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin/ /phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma 'tshol bar/ /sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /ces gsung pas so/ /gnyis pa sems sgyu ma bsgrub pa ni/ 'o na ri ra ba khang khyim sogs yul snang sna tshogs su snang ba 'di dag sems kyi byas par 'dug kyang 'di rang bden par grub bo snyam na/

snang ba 'di dag sgyu ma'i rmi lam dang khyad par skad cig kyang med do/ /don la bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du nges shes skyes par byas te/ de'i steng du sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi rtsis zin par bya'o/ /de yang rje btsun gyi/ snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa ni/ de ltar sgyu ma lta bu sna tshogs su snang ba de yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba tsam yin gyi/ don dam par brtags shing dpyad na/ bden par grub pa skra'i rtse mo brgyar bshags pa'i cha shas tsam yang med de/ de yang / sems dang po skye ba'i rgyu med/ bar du gnas pa'i ngo bo med/ mthar 'gag pa'i 'bras bu med/ de ltar na sems skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bur nges shes bskyed par byas te/ de'i steng du sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi rtsis zin par byas nas rtse gcig tu bsgom mo/ /de yang rje btsun chen po'i gang zag gsum ka rang bzhin gyi ma grub par shes pa'i shes rab dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas rig pa gsal la ma 'gags par rtse gcig tu lhan gyis gnas pa'i zhi gnas dang / snang tsam skye med du lhag gi rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis ngo bo dbyer med gyi tshul du gsal hrig ge bzhag gnas cha che na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab ngar bskyed/ shes rab rtsal drag te sems mi gnas na lhod kyi bzhag de lta bu re 'jog tu byas pa'i zung du chud nas gol sa thams cad chod par 'gyur ro/ /gnad 'di dag ma shes na zhi gnas kyi gnas cha ji tsam che yang 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan bzhi gang rung dang / lhag mthong ni spyod yul ji ltar bzang yang gzugs med gang rung du gol bar 'gyur bas/ ting nge 'dzin gol sa thams cad bcad nas nyams su len pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa skye 'gyur gyi nyams la nges shes bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la brten nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba rnams rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len pa po'i gang zag go /thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'og nas 'byung gyur gyi smin grol gyi lam 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba ni/ de dag la brten nas slar skye 'gyur gyi nyams re/ de yang rgyas par na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / bsdu na/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam/ chags pa spyod pa'i lam/ byang chub chen po'i lam ste lam gsum/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ dmigs nyams te nyams gsum/ rnam rtog sngon song gi drod/ khams dgu 'dus pa'i drod/ thig le 'bar zhing 'dus pa'i drod ste drod gsum/ rlung log gi rten 'brel/ mthong snang gi rten 'brel/ rmi lam gyi rten 'brel ste rten 'brel gsum/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang bzhin stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ ngo bo zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gsum rnams su 'du la/ bco lnga po'ang bsdu na ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig tu 'du ba yin no/ /de la nges shes bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i thun mtshams su/ /mdo bklags dkon mchog mchod la brtsod par bya/ /zhes gsung pa ltar yin no/ /des na rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam de lta bu dang mjal nas nyams su blangs na/ bdag la nyams kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig skye bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyi mthun pa'i phyogs la dga' ba skye rgyu yang med/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs la mi dga' ba skye rgyu yang med do/ /rang gi rtsa dang / rtsa yig ge dang / khams bdud rtsi dang / snying po ye shes rlung gi rten 'brel sems gyis dbang byas pa la brten nas 'khor 'das kyi nyams sna tshogs su 'byung bar 'dug pas so/

nyams de dag kyang bsdu na/ gong bzhin lnga gsum bco lngar 'du zhing / de yang bsdu na rig 'dzin gsum du 'du la/ de dag bdag la ni skyes pa'i tshe/ 'di ni lus nyams so/ 'di ni sems nyams so/ /zhes sogs so sor ngo shes par byas la/ byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyang bar bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /bsdu na pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la brten nas/ sangs rgyas ji ltar myur na yang bskal pa grangs med gsum du 'gor bar 'dug pas/ de lta bu ma yin par/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring 'chi kha'am/ bar do/ tha ma skye ba bcu drug nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i lam zab mo nyams su len dgos te/ de yang bdag gi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhugs nas kyang so so'i nyams rnams rgyud la skyes skyes gyi bar du nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ /slangs nas kyang nyams ci skyes thams cad chos dang mthun par bskyang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsam mo/ /'di don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs 'gre/ ༈ nyi ma nyer gcig pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung snang gsum mdzes rgyan rdzogs par bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro ba sogs 'gre/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba ste/ 'di la gsum las/ dang po dag pa'i snang ba 'char ba'i gzhi 'amabarten ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /gnyis pa brgyan ni/ gzhung ni dngos su ma zin kyang tshogs gnyis kyi bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams yin no/ /gsum pa snang ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ dag pa'i ngo bo de la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa ni/ gaṅga klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i lce sprul nas brjod kyang brjod par ga la nus/ rags pa tsam zhig brjod na/ bde bar gshegs pa ni/ lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa'o/

/sku mi zad pa ni/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa la sogs pa dang / sku thams cad ni/ gdul bya dag pa rnams la longs sku dang / tha mal pa rnams la sprul sku mchog 'bring tha ma gsum gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /gsung mi zad pa ni/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ste/ nye ring med pa thos pa dang / gsung thams cad pa 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi skad dang mthun par ston pa'o/ /thugs mi zad pa ni/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ting nge 'dzin sus kyang rtogs par mi nus pa dang / thugs thams cad pa shes bya ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'o/ /rgyan ni rang gi sku bzhi thob pas rang mdzes par byed pa dang / gzhan yang sku bzhi'i go 'phang la 'god par byed pas gzhan mdzes par byed pa'o/ /'khor lo ni/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /des na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas de/ bdag gis ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo'i nyams su blang snyam du bsam mo/ /de yang ma dag pa'i snang ba ni lam la 'jug pa'i rgyu yin la/ nyams kyi snang ba ni lam gyi dngos gzhi yin cing / dag pa'i snang ba 'di lam de bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/ 'di yan chad kyi phar phyin theg pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan pa yin no/ /des na chos rje sa paṇa gyi zhal nas/ skabs 'dir yang lam 'bras tshar gcig song zhes gsung pa yang / don 'di nyid la dgongs pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid kyi yang snying bsdus pa rdzogs so/ ༈ /nyi ma nyer gnyis pa la/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed 'bog dgos pas/ de la thog mar rten bris 'bur byin rlabs can bzhugs pa'i g.yas su bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa bkod/ g.yon du zlum gtor 'dab bzhi pa gcig bshams/ de dag gi mdun la ting bdun tshar nas kyis bkang pa/

de'i mdun la spos khra/ de'i mdun la dkar me nyer gcig las mi nyung ba/ de'i mdun la ting bdun tshar du yon chab/ de'i mdun la lha bshos nyer gcig las mi nyung ba 'byor ba dang bstun pa bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ 'byor pa che zhing bsod nams gsog pa'i ched yin pas bzang ngo / /de'i mdun la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ sems bskyed la thog mar ltung bshags tshar gsum la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rtag par sangs rgyas la sogs dpon slob tshang mas bzhengs te/ rten la phyag 'tshal mdzad/ phyag 'tshal rdzogs nas/ de man la tsog pur bzhugs nas mdzad/ de'i rjes kyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs/ bla ma'i sku ni sogs/ bla ma'i gsung sogs/ bla ma'i thugs sogs/ bla ma sangs rgyas sogs/ mgon po thugs rje sogs/ dag pas 'dod chags sogs/ grol nas grol ba'i sogs/ ston pa bla med sogs/ sku 'gyur ba ni sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ phyag 'tshal bsdu na 'di bzhin bya'o/ /de rnams la bla ma mi bzhengs/ slob ma rnams kyis bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /maṇ+ḍal thog mtha' gnyis/ rol chen ni/ mchod pa'i rol mo phal cher dang / de la gzhan yang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes dang / yan lag bdun pa'i sil snyan rnams dang sogs ste theng gsum dgos so/ /sems bskyed kyi yig cha ni/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas bya'o/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin la/ zlum gtor 'dab bzhi pa gcig dang / mchod pa chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ maṇ+ḍal bdun ma gnyis/ so bdun ma gcig gang gi mchod rdzas ma rnams dgos/ zlum gtor la dpon slob tshang mas gtor bsngo bsdus pa byed/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi yig cha yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas bya'o/ /de nas bla mas bsags sbyang gyi dmigs pa rnams 'bog dgos pas/ de la 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas/

mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i snying po kyai rdo rje yab yum gsal btab/ de nyid kyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsams la/ ngag tu skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor ma ji ltar rigs pa byas rjes/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sogs bskyed chog lam dus bzhin byas la/ yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs bya'o/ /de nas bla ma bdag ni mi shes sogs nas/ 'ja' mtshon lta bur gyur gyi bar brjod/ der rjes/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs brjod do/ /gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor la/ thog mar bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bskyed chog ni/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā bas sbyangs/ mdun gyi bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshem bu dbus ma mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje 'chang dang rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer ma mchis pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ shar gyi tshom bu mi dmigs ste stong pa'i ngang las/ snying po kyai rdo rje lha dgu la sogs pa'i yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ lho'i tshom bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ nub kyi tshom bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/

sangs rgyas kyi thugs brgyud la mnga' ba'i lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid/ chos po ti brag re brtsegs pa lta bur gyur/ byang gi tshom bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ de ltar bskyed la/ de nas/ maṇ+ḍal bdun ma bcu tsam gyi bseg tu so bdun ma re phul la/ brgya rtsa stong rtsa la sogs pa'abul ba'o/ /de lta bu'i dmigs pa rnams 'bog par byas nas/ so sor gyes slob ma rnams kyis bsags sbyangs gnyis la nan tan du bya zhing / bla ma de nub nas mtshams dam par bsdams te/ bsnyen pa kha gso zhag bdun bya/ de nas slob ma sta gon bya zhing / lam 'bras kyi skabs su rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor nges par bzhengs dgos pas/ rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te dbang gi dngos gzhi la khyad chos ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su spog chog dang / brtul zhugs kyi dbang dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi mtshams su/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung dang / aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung byed tshul pod dmar gyi nang na yod/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs brjod aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung byed tshul pod dmar gyi nang na yod/ kyi skabs su rtogs brjod dbye na bcu drug dang / bsdu na bco lnga bco lnga rnams bya dgos so/ /'di'i mtshams su slob ma mang nyung la dpag pa'i zhag du 'gor kyang dbang rnams rdzogs par bya/ 'di'i dbang gi skabs su dpon slob nyung shing rgyu 'byor pa dang bstun byung na phyag len la tshogs 'khor yang mdzad do/ ༈ /de nas sngags lam tshugs pa'i chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ tshogs 'phral bla mas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang de ltar brjod cing / de nas yi ge brgya pa nyer gcig las mi nyung ba mdzad/ bla ma bdag ni sogs nas/ byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa'i bar dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs srung 'khor rgyas pa/ uṣ+ḍi ṣa ci mang gi mthar bha ya na tshar gsum/ su gang dag sogs nas/ rak+ṣa tshar gsum gyi bar mdzad/ de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs nas yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum sogs/ snang gsum bzhin/ de nas bla mas mchod gtor byed/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal bdun ma gnyis dang / so bdun ma gcig ste gsum gtud nas phul rjes/ mchod g.yog pas lang ste thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nas bzung la gang gi mchod rdzas ma bskul te/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i bar byed/ de nyid nyi ma dang po la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig sogs/ snang gsum bzhin brjod la/ de la 'dir lung gi skabs su babs par gyur pa la/ bstan bcos tshad ma'i lung rnams bklag dgos pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ lam 'bras glegs bam nas rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i sa bcad/ gzhung bshad snyag ma'i shog bu kha yar bklags la/ de rnams kyi lung gi skabs su babs par gyur pa yin/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i skabs su bab par gyur pa la/ sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid gong du bstan zin nas/ dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bkri ba la gsum ste/ rgyu chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul/ lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ /dang po ni sngon du bstan zin/ gnyis pa la yang gsum ste/ gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba/ gang zag dkri ba'i tshul gang yin pa/ nges shes khyad par can bskyed la ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir/ lam gyi sa 'tshams rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /dang po la/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba mchog tu gyur pa dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / thob pa mi nyams par srung ba dam tshig gi tshogs rjes su bskyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang las/

'dir ni bla med kho na'i dbang du byas te/ smin byed bum dbang la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /phyi rdul mtshon dang / rtsa yig ge bdud rtsi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams su/ phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la sogs pa bzhi'i slob ma'i phung kham skyed mched la/ sku bzhi'i sa bon btabs te/ mthar 'bras bu de bzhi'ang 'grub nges pa zhig la rten 'brel thams cad kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid par 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsrung rgyu'i dam tshig dbang bzhi so so la/ mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' ba mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig lnga lnga ste nyi shu dang / gzhan yang phra rags kyi dam tshig bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang / bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i sgo nas dam tshig la srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa gang zag bkri ba'i tshul gang yin pa la gsum ste/ lta ba spros pa spyad pa'i phyir kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba bsgom pa/ lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa/ 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis sam/ dang po tshogs gsog par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor/ sdig pa sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems pa'i bsgom bzlas/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsum mo/ /dngos gzhi ni dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bshams/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang bcas pa/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa gong bsag sbyang gi skabs bzhin/ skyabs 'gro ci nus byas la skyabs yul stim/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs nas/ bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la dmigs nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod cing /

stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang bsdus pa bskyed pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa gong bsag sbyang gi skabs bzhin las/ cung zad mi 'dra ba/ zhal 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang / rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pas zhal nang du phyogs pa'o/ /shar du gong dang 'dra/ lhor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pa can du ma/ nub tu 'dra/ byang du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i cha lugs can du ma/ mtha' skor du chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /de rnams kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong / nor lha dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ so so la thim par bsam pa'o/ /de rnams la mos gus drag po bskyed la/ spro na bla ma'i bstod pa/ mchod pa yang tshig ji ltar rigs pas phul la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni gong bsag sbyang gi skabs bzhin ci nus 'bul ba'o/ /skabs skabs su bzhes nas bdag gi brgyud la bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par࿁ rim gnyis ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar࿁ sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par࿁ zhes brjod/ mchod yul rnams mtha' nas 'od zer gyi rnam pas zhu ste rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam/ de yang spyi bo nas thim pas snying khar bzhugs te/ dus rtag tu byin gyis brlab cing mgon skyabs mdzad par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa sdig pa sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ gong bsag sbyang gi skabs bzhin no/ /gsum pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'o na ji ltar bsgom na/

chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid yin zhes/ /bya ba dbang bskur thob nas yin/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ rang gi spyi bor seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la rgyu dus su dbang bskur ba po'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de nyid/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i rnam pa sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag nyid ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa sgom la/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ dkon mchog gsum/ chos srung gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ bla ma rje btsun gyi sku ma thim par bsams la/ de nyid skyabs gnas gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos gus drag po yang dang yang du bskyed la/ ngag tu/ gang drin ma'am/ spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /zhes pa nas/ dbyer med lhan skyes rtogs par byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gsol ba 'debs pa snying gi dkyil/ rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba yang dang yang du btab la/ blo snying brang gsum/ spyi bo'i mthil bzhi/ bla ma la ling gyis gtod/ de ltar byas pa la brten nas/ mthar bla ma de bdag la mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi thugs rjes bskyong bzhin pa'i sgo nas 'od zer 'dza' mtshon lta bu'i rnam par zhu ste/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsum thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lus sku rdo rje sprul sku/ ngag gsung rdo rje longs sku/ yid thugs rdo rje chos skur gyur/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag

sgo gsum snying po kyai rdo rje nge bo nyid kyi skur gyur pa yin zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /de ltar thun du bcad nas sgom pa'o/ thun 'tshams rnams su yang bla ma mnyes thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas sogs dang / bsod nams 'di yi sogs smon lam ci shes btab bo/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma gnyis pa la/ sems bskyed zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig lung gi mtshams sbyor sogs gong bzhin/ lung gzhung bshad snyag ma'i 'phros byin/ gong gi lung ma rdzogs tsam bklags do nub kyi dmigs pa ni/ gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi la/ lta ba dbang rjes su bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rim pa gnyis kyi thog mar bsgom pa'i dgos pa/ gzhi gang gi steng du bsgom pa/ bsgom bya lta ba'i ngo bo/ tshul ji ltar du bsgom pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ lta ba dbang rjes su bsgom dgos te/ dbang dus su skyes pa'i ye shes la/ gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa dang / ye shes de'i rgyun gom par bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /ces pas mdor bstan nas/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang / /'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la/ /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs kyi rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lta ba rim gnyis kyi thog mar bsgom dgos te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam thams cad snang tsam de dang der snang yang / rang gi ngo bo go yul du sems nyid lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes las ma 'das par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / sam+pu ṭa las/ dang po stong nyid bsam nas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ /lus sogs stong pa'i zhing sa la/ /blo dang ldan pas sa bon btab/ /ces sogs kyi bstan no/ /gsum pa ni/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng du sgom dgos te/

gzhung las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces gsung ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'khor 'das dbyer med la byed dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi la/ sbyor ba'i chos gsum/ rjes kyi chos gsum/ dngos gzhi'i chos gsum mo/ /dang po la byang chub kyi sems sgom pa/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa/ rang yi dam du bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro bas byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar bzhin spyi bor bla ma bsgom la mos gus drag po byed pa'i rkyen gyis rang la thim par bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ hūm̐ng zhes brjod pas gnas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de'i nang du gzhal yas khang / hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /lnga pa tshul ji ltar bsgom pa la gsum/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ nyams su blangs pa'i gnad gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung las/ ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsung ste/ de'i don sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed/ rgyu gcig ngang cig ro cig so so ma yin/ tha mi dad pa/ de nyid la 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/

/de skad du yang / rtsa rgyud las/ lhan cig skyes pas gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bstan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ rgyu lhan skyes pa'i chos gsum/ lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum mo/ do nub kyi dngos gzhi'i chos gsum gyi dang po ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rang bzhin gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug las/ /nyon mongs rlung dang yi ge rtsa dang khams/ /nad gdon rags pa re re'ang gsum gsum ste/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyu yi lhan skyes yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don ni/ phyi nang gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i chos phyi rol na gang yang med do/ /de yang ji ltar yin zhe na/ sems kyi gsal ba mi dor ba yin te/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces bya/ gsal ba de legs par brtags na/ rigs/ gnas/ phyogs/ kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa/ gang ltar brtsal kyang mi brnyed cing ma grub ste/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bya/ de ltar na gsal ba rtsal bas ma brnyed pa la stong pa dang / stong pa 'tshol mkhan de la gsal ba zhes bya/ des na gsal dus na stong / stong dus na gsal ba ste gsal steng dbyer med dam/ zung 'jug gam/ brjod bral lam/ lhan skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang la sems gnas pa'o/ /de yang dang po gsal bar thag bcad/ bar du stong pas rgyas gdab/ mthar zung 'jug tu mda' ba'o/ /rgyu'i chos gsum po hril gyis bsdu na/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo'o/ /gnyis pa lam gyi chos gsum ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ smin byed sngon du song nas sgrub pa'i lam/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang ye shes rnam gsum las/ /rang bzhin gsum ste de dag re re yang /

/gsum du dbye ste lam gyi lhan skyes yin/ /zhes gsung pas de'i don ni/ bskyed rdzogs ye shes gsum yang rang sems kyi cho 'phrul las ma 'das te/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid bskyed rim/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin rdzogs rim/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ye shes ste/ gsum po re re nas kyang gsal stong zung 'jug ya ma bral ba'i ngang du bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i chos gsum ni/ rje btsun gyis/ gsal ba sprul sku stong pa chos kyi sku/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin yang / /re re'ang gsum gsum lhun grub gnas 'gyur du/ /rtsi ba 'di ni 'bras bu lhan skyes yin/ /zhes gsung pas de'i don ni/ sku gsum yang rang sems dag pa'i rnam rol las ma 'das te/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba sprul sku/ rang bzhin stong pa chos sku/ ngo bo zung 'jug longs sku ste/ de re re'ang gsal ba snying rje chon po/ stong pa shes rab chen po zung 'jug mnyam nyid chen po rnams mi 'bral bas na gsal stong zung 'jug ya ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ rang sems las logs na rang 'bras kyi sku gsum med par thag bcad cing sgom mo/ /de ltar rgyu ma las 'bras gsum gyi don hril gyis bsdu na/ rgyu sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba de nyid ma 'khrul par bsgom pa la brten nas/ lam bskyed rim mthar phyin par gyur ste+e/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'o/ /rgyu rang bzhin stong pa de nyid ma 'khrul bar bsgom pa la brten nas/ lam rdzogs rim mthar phyin par gyur ste/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'o/ /rgyu ngo bo zung 'jug ma 'khrul par bsgom pa la brten nas/ lam ye shes mthar phyin par gyur te/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'o/ /de ltar bsgom nas/ gsum pa rjes kyi chos gsum la/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam btab pa/ de ltar ma gtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bsgom pa/ nyams len gyi rgyun rtag tu dran pa'o/

dang po ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs sngar bzhin/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs so/ gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid gsal stong phyogs med ris med du 'dug pa la/ de ma shes pa sems can bdag tu 'dzin pa dam pos bcing pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad rang gi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug las ma 'das pas na/ dgra gnyen la chags sdang byar med/ nad gdon dang sdug bsngal spang du med/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan med/ thams cad kyang sems gsal stong gnyis med yin no snyam du dran par bya'o/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma gsum pa la/ sems bskyed zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig sogs gong bzhin/ lung gzhung bshad snyag ma'i 'phros rdzogs par byed/ dmigs pa ni/ sbyor ba'i chos gsum sngon du song nas/ nyams len gyi dngos gzhi la/ spyi don gnyis pa/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum zhes bya ba/ sems dang sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa bdun dpe yin te/ /kun la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyis so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i don bstan pa la gsum las/ yul snang sems su bsgrub pa/ sems snang sgyu mar bsgrub/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po la rje btsun gyis/ sems la gnyid rdzas nad dang gdon gyis bslad/ /mig yor rab rib 'gal me myur 'khor ba/ /zhes dpe brgyad gsung pa'i dngos gzhi la/ dpe dran pa/ dpe don bsre ba/ de'i ngang la bzhag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rmi lam shin tu gsal ba zhig dran du bzhug la/ 'di lta bu bden par ma grub par thag bcad pa de/ dpe dran pa/ gnyis pa de dang bsre ba ni/ de ltar rmi lam gyi snang ba de dang / da ltar gyi sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba/ snod bcud sna tshogs/ 'dod yon sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rnams kyang bden par grub pa skad gcig kyang med pas rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med par bsre ba'o/

/gsum pa de'i ngang la bzhag pa ni/ sngon chad bdag gi de ltar ma shes par gang snang bden par bzung ste/ 'khrul pa 'ba' zhig tu spyad 'dug pa de ma legs/ da ni bdag gi 'khrul snang la 'khrul snang du ngo shes par byas la/ sems 'khrul snang gi dbang du ma shor ba zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du bsam la/ sems kha nang du ldog ste/ yul gyi rjes mi 'brang bar rang gi sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor 'das bde sdug sna tshogs su snang ba de las ldog ste/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug du sal le/ hrig ge'i ngang nas 'dzin bya ma zhugs pa byas la/ shes pa lhod kyis slod la bzhag go /de gsum po kun la dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzas kyis bslad pa ni/ chang gis gzir bas gang la yang 'jig pa med pa la sogs pa dang / ka shwa kan+ta zos pas snang ba g.yur mthong ba dang / da du ra zos pas snang ba gser du mthong ba mi bden bzhin du snang ba'o/ /gsum pa nad kyis bslad pa ni/ tshad nad drag po byung ba'i tshe 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'char ba de yang mi bden bzhin du snang ba'o/ /bzhi pa gdon gyis bslad pa ni/ sems sor mi gnas par/ yod pa la med pa dang / med pa la yod pa sogs snang ba phyin ci log byed pa'o/ /lnga pa mig yor ni/ mig btsir ba na/ mar me sogs dngos po gcig gnyis su mthong ba'o/ /drug pa rab rib ni/ mig rab rib kyis sgrib pa'i gang zag gis nam mkha' dang sa la bltas pa de'i tshe/ skra bshad dam/ sbrang bu'i tshogs du ma snang la/ mig skyon med zhig gis bltas na med pa'o/ /bdun pa 'gal me ni/ reng bu phra mo zhig sbar te myur du bskor ba na dmar kho re ba zhig tu mthong kyang / brtag na me de gcig na yod pa'i dus gcig na med do/ /brgyad pa myur 'khor ba ni/ lang ste phyogs kun la blta zhing lus myur du bskor ba na/ mthar ri dang ljon shing la sogs pa thams cad 'khor ba'o/ /spyi+i don nyis pa sems snang sgyu mar bsgrub pa ni/

rje btsun gyis/ gnyis pa sgyu ma smi+ig sgyu chu zla klo+og /'phrog pa dri za'i grong khyer sprin dang 'ja'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ sgyu ma mkhan dag gis/ rdzas kyi dngos po gyo mo dang / spre'u'i mjug ma la sogs pa la sgyu ma'i sngags kyis btabs te lta ba po'i mig bslad pa la brten nas/ grong khyer rta glang sogs sna tshogs/ snang yang bden par ma grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa smig rgyu ni/ sos ka nyi ma phyed tsam gyi dus/ smig sgyu mthong ba de la chu'i phung por mthong ba'o/ /gsum pa chu zla ni/ nam mkha' dang pa'i zla ba de/ snod du ma chus bkang nas thams cad du zla ba re re 'byung yang / chu rnams pho na mi 'byung ste/ zla ba chu'i nang du 'phos pa yang ma yin no/ /bzhi pa glog ni/ sprin dang chu'i 'od zer tshogs pa la glog ces bya ba'i snang ba yud tsam pa zhig snang la/ de rnams ma tshogs na mi snang ngo / /lnga pa 'phrog pa ni/ shar lho ha ri ke la bya ba na mtsho chen po zhig yod pa la/ mtshan mo char chen po 'babs pa dang / nang par nam mkha' la sprin med pa 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la ci yang mi snang mod/ nam mkha'i gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul gyis/ mtsho nang du grong khyer rta glang sogs du ma snang la/ rgyu rkyen gang rung zhig ma tshang na mi 'byung ngo / /dpe 'di rgyal po seng ge zla ba zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba yin gsung la/ 'phrog pa'i skad dod ha ri zhes pa seng ger yang 'gyur du rung bas shin tu 'grig pa yin no/ /drug pa dri za'i grong khyer ni/ 'ga' zhig gi yul thag ring por bltas pa na mi ma yin gyi grong khyer rta glang sogs ma nges pa du ma mthong la/ der phyin pa na de bas kyang rgyang ring ba zhig tu snang ngo / /bdun pa sprin ni/ nam mkha' dang pa la/ sprin glo bur du snang ba de/ dang por gang nang nas 'ong mi rnyed/ mthar gang du song ba mi rnyed pa'o/

brgyad pa 'ja' ni sprin gyi sgrib pa'i mtshams su char babs pa na 'ja' mtshon zhes bya ba kha dog sna tshogs snang ba de/ drung du phyin na ci yang mi snang ngo / /spyi don gsum pa rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa la/ rje btsun rin po che/ gsum pa gnyis kyi dang po rten 'brel ste/ kha ton mar me me long rgya dang ni/ /me shel sa bon skyur dang brag cha 'o/ /zhes gsung pa'i dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi slob ma la slob par byed pa'i kha ton zhig lan gcig brjod pa na/ slob ma'i blo la yang kha ton de 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang snga ma phyi mar mi 'phos pa yang med/ snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma mi 'byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin rigs 'gre ste/ gnyis pa mar me ni/ mar me snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma mi 'byung / snga ma phyi mar 'phos pa yang med do/ gsum pa me long ni/ me long dang pa zhig la bltas na rang gi byad bzhin zhig snang / de yang snga ma sogs 'gre/ bzhi pa rgya ni/ rwa 'am shing la byas pa'i rgya de/ la lca 'am 'jim pa la btab pa ni rgya dang 'dra ba'i re mo zhig 'byung / de yang snga ma sogs 'gre/ lnga pa me shel ni/ nyi ma dang shing sgrib g.yog med pa me shel gas grum med pa/ spra ba brlan med pa rnams las me 'byung ba'o/ /drug pa sa bon ni/ zhing sa gshin pa/ drod gsher chu lud 'dzoms pa la sa bon skyon med btab pa la brten nas myu gu sogs 'byung ba'o/ /bdun pa skyur ni/ se 'bru la sogs pa'i shing tog skyur po mthong ma thag 'gram chu ldang zhing khar chu 'byung yang / shing 'bras de mthong ba'i rkyen byas pa ma gtogs de'i chu khar byung pa yang ma yin no/ /brgyad pa brag cha ni/ khang pa thod pangs mthon po'i nang ngam/ brag gsangs po'i drung du/ skad sang pa gcig ston na/ de 'dra ba zhig grags par 'gyur ro/ /dpe 'di thams cad snga ma la ma brten par phyi ma mi 'byung / snga ma phyi mar 'phos pa yang med do/

/brjod bral du bsgrub pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ gsum pa'i gnyis pa brjod bral brten par bya/ /gzhon nu rgod dang lkugs pa'i rmi lam bzhin/ /gnad la 'khrugs dang dbang po'i bde ba dang / /gsum pa'i ye shes gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug dang / /longs spyod rlabs dang dkyil 'khor lo'o/ /zhes gsung pa'i dang po ni/ byis pa chung ngu smra mi shes pa rgod pa na/ rgod pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig gsal bar yod na'ang smra mi nus pa'o/ /gnyis pa lkugs pa'i rmi lam ni/ lkugs pa'i rmi lam gsal po nyams su myong yang / smra mi nus so/ /gsum pa gnad la 'khrugs pa ni/ mchan khung la sogs pa g.ya' ba'i gnas rnams su gzhan gyi lag pa rag pa brten nas/ rgod bro ba'i rang bzhin myong bzhin du brjod mi nus so/ /bzhi pa dbang po'i bde ba ni/ gsang ba'i dbang po tha dad pa gnyis sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba dang / myong bzhin du brjod mi nus so/ /lnga pa gsum pa'i ye shes ni/ dbang gsum pa'i skabs su phyag rgya'i bde ba myong bzhin du brjod mi nus so/ /drug pa gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug ni/ gang zag rab rlung la dbang thob pas gsang dbang gi snyoms 'jug la brten nas sgom pa'i nyams myong ste/ de myong bzhin du brjod mi nus so/ /bdun pa longs spyod rlabs ni/ de lag len shes pas dben pa'i gnas rnams su bsgrub ste/ nyams myong skyes pa na myong bzhin du brjod mi nus so/ /brgyad pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong ste/ de nyams su myong bzhin du brjod mi nus pa'o/ /sngar gyi dpe brgyad tshan bzhi'i nang nas dpe'i gtso bo/ dang po'i nang nas rmi lam/ gnyis pa'i nang nas chu zla/ gsum pa'i nang nas sa bon/ bzhi pa'i nang nas gnad la 'khrug pa/ thams cad kyi nang nas longs spyod rlabs te de lnga yang / sems dang / sgyu ma dang / rten 'brel dang / brjod bral bzhi ldan du gtan la 'beb pa'o/

/dmigs pa mang po dus gcig la byed dgos pa 'di rnams dmigs pa'i lung tsam 'khrid tsam yin pas/ phyis dmigs pa sgom rung gi ched yin zhes bla ma dam pa rnams gsung pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi don bsgom pa la thun gcig byed/ rjes kyi chos gsum 'gre'o/ ༈ /nyi ma bzhi pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ zab pa'i tshul sogs 'gre/ lung lam 'bras glegs bam las/ yig chung nyer gnyis kyi chos sna kha yar bklags la/ dmigs pa ni sbyor ba'i chos gsum sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi nyams su len pa la/ spyi don gsum pa/ rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rgyas bshad thog mar kun gzhi'i rang bzhin dang / /rten dang brten tshul rgyu dang rtsa ba dang / /'brel tshul snang ba rnam gsum dran pa yi/ /lus dang sems la 'khor 'das tshang tshul lo/ /zhes gsung pas/ de la kun gzhi'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo ni/ rang gi sems gsal rig ste/ de rtogs na myang 'das kyi rgyu/ ma rtogs na 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin zhing / de'i rten ni lus yin la/ khams gsum ni yul yin zhing / snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag longs spyod yin no/ /rten lus de la brten pa kun gzhi me tog dang me tog gi dri'i tshul du gnas so/ /kun gzhi de nyid khor 'das gnyis ka'i rgyu yin te/ de yang tshang rtsi na/ lus la rtsi stangs dang / sems la rtsi ba'o/ /dang po ni/ snang ba gsum gyi don dran par byas te/ de yang ma dag pa'i snang ba dang / nyams kyi snang ba dang / dag pa'i snang ba'o/ de gsum gyi rgyu ni/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang / dge ba bcu/ byams snying rje la sogs pa'o/ /des na rigs drug gi sa bon 'khor ba/ rigs lnga'i sa bon myang 'das rnams/ lus la rtsa yi ge dang / sems la bag chags kyi tshul gyi tshang zhing /

bag chags gang rags pa'i dbang gis rigs drug so so'i lus su grub pa yin no/ /des na de thams cad la bag chags kyi dbang gis sems dge mi dge sna tshogs su 'byung zhing / mi dge ba spyad pa la brten nas ma dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis lam bsgom pa la brten nas 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad nyams kyi snang ba lnga gsum bco lnga la sogs par skye bas na nyams kyi snang ba/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu dag pa'i snang ba 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sems la rtsi ba ni/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad sems kyi mtshan nyid/ lam gyi chos thams cad sems kyi yon tan/ 'bras bu'i chos thams cad sems kyi nus mthu/ sems kyi rang bzhin gsal ba/ sems kyi mtshan nyid stong / sems kyi ngo bo zung 'jug go /de ltar nges shes skyes ba ni/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi 'khrid do/ /de skad du yang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ ces pas bstan no/ /gnyis pa lus thabs rgyud ni/ rje btsun gyis/ thabs la smin byed lam dang nyams myong ste/ /zhes pas bstan te/ 'di la yang gsum ste/ smin par byed pa'i dbang 'khor 'das dbyer med/ grol bar byed pa'i lam 'khor 'das dbyer med/ lam nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i nyams myong 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun gyis/ dang po dkyil 'khor dbang dang dbang rdzas sogs/ /re re'ang gdan gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med du/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal las slang bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / dbang rang gi ngo bo dang / dbang rdzas bum pa/ dbu rgyan sogs rang gi sems kyi steng du gdan gsum tshang ba la/ der shes par bya ba yin no/ /gnyis grol bar byed pa lam 'khor 'das dbyer med la gnyis ste/ bskyed rim 'khor 'das dbyer med dang / rdzogs rim 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /dang po ni/

rje btsun gyi/ bskyed pa sngon 'gro rten dang bskyed chog dang / /kha dog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur yan lag bcas/ /re re'ang 'khor 'das dbyer med rang bzhin du/ /legs par brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de yang sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa/ dngos gzhi rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha'i bskyed chog de'i kha dog de'i phyag mtshan/ phyag dang zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag bzlas pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa rnams sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod par bya zhing / de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed myang 'das/ de gnyis dbyer med 'khor 'das dbyer med do zhes pas bstan no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ rje btsun gyi/ rdzogs pa lus dang ngag yid 'khor ba la/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas ye shes legs rdzogs par/ /phan tshun rgyu dang 'bras bu rgyas btab cing / /rtogs pa de yi ye shes ngo sprod bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de yang rten dkyil 'khor bzhi/ ngag rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum/ yid rtogs pa'i 'phro 'du du ma dang bcas pa'o/ /de dag gi sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs nyams su blang ba la brten nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas rigs lnga dang / ye shes lnga legs par rdzogs pa ste/ de thob par shes nas/ phan tshun rgyu 'khor ba la 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang ye shes kyang rgyu nyon mongs pa sbyang pa las 'byung ngo / /zhes ngo sprad cing / sgom pa la brten nas rtogs pa dpe yi ye shes skye ba yin no/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i rjes su 'brel ba la/ rje btsun rin po ches/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong chos drug dran bya zhing / /rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel 'dod na/ /dam tshig brda' sogs la yang legs sbyar ste/ /dri ma med pa'i blo yis dpyad par bya/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ de yang rim gnyis kyi ngo bo/

dbye ba/ nges tshig grangs nges/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ go rim nges pa ste/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi chos drug legs par rtogs par byas la/ rgyas par sgom par 'dod na/ bza' ba'i dam tshig srung ba'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang / brda lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa sogs la'ang legs par sbyar te/ rang gi rtogs ngan gyi dri mas ma bslad par/ bla ma brgyud pa las byung ba'i thos byung dang / nyams su blang pa'isgom byung gi blo gros kyis dpyad de/ de yang kun rdzob chos can 'khor ba/ don dam chos nyid myang 'das/ de gnyis dbyer med 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /de yang snang ba thams cad gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa thams cad stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ zung 'jug thams cad bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ste/ mdor na tshig rgyas bsdus ci ltar yang sems kyi spros pa chod pa'i ched yin gyi/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi steng du bsgril nas bsgom pa'i dmigs pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /de ltar snang ba sna tshogs su snang yang / rang gi ngo bo/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum du bsdus nas/ de'i steng du sems 'jog ma shes na dmigs pa 'thor nas nyams myong rnam dag mi skye'o/ /gsum pa lam nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i nyams myong 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ rje btsun gyis/ 'khor ba'i nyams la brten nas log lta spong / /lam gyi nyams kyis theg pa gcig tu bsgrub/ /'bras bu'i nyams kyis spro ba mchog tu gyur/ /chos kun tshad ma bzhi yis bstan la dbab/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de yang mi dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pas log lta spong ba dang / lam gyi nyams bsgom pa la brten nas/ grub mtha' tha dad du snang ba'i theg pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang /
