yang dag par na theg pa gcig tu bsgrub pa dang / de yang sgom pa la brten nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pho brang du rlung sems 'dus pas chos sku'i nyams/ snying kha'i rigs lnga'i yi ge la brten nas longs sku dang sprul sku'i nyams skye ste/ de nyid sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi rang bzhin yin snyam pa byung ba'i tshe/ 'di sangs rgyas dngos ma yin gyi nyams kyi snang ba yin no/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam du dga' spro mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de yang tshad ma bzhi bstan la dbab pa'o/ gsum pa phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ rje btsun gyi/ rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste/ /mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas gyur yin/ /des na lhun grub gnas gyur mi 'gal ste/ /'di ni 'bras bu 'khor 'das dbyer med yin/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rang sems de rgyu 'khor ba'i dus na/ spros bral du khyad par med par lhun grub tu grol la/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems kyi glo bur gyi dri ma sbyangs nas sku dang ye shes sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa sems steng du gsal bar gyur pa gnas gyur yin zhing / de gnyis mi 'gal ba'o/ de ltar rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi 'khor 'das dbyer med kyang / rgyas bshad de thams cad hril gyis bsgril nas nyams su len na/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi steng du bsgril nas sgom pa de nyid ka dmigs pa'i ngo bo yin pas de ltar shes par bya'o/ /de yang zhib tu phye na/ lhan gcig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi skabs su/ mtshan nyid gsal bar 'khor ba/ rang bzhin stong pa myang 'das/ ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum gyi skabs su/ chos can gsal ba 'khor ba/ chos nyid stong pa myang 'das/ de nyid zung 'jug dbyer med/ rgyud gsum gyi rgyu rgyud kyi skabs su gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid 'khor ba/

stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin myang 'das/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo dbyer med/ thabs rgyud kyi skabs su/ sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed myang 'das/ sbyang gzhi de sbyong byed de'i ngo bo dag pa dbyer med yin/ 'bras rgyud kyi skabs su lhun grub 'khor ba/ gnas gyur myang 'das/ de gnyis mi 'gal ba dbyer med do/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ rjes kyi chos gsum 'gre ba'o/ ༈ /nyi ma lnga pa la/ sems bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ lung yig chung nyer gnyis pa'i 'phros dang / gzhung bshad a seng ma/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa ba dang / 'grel pa nas shog bu kha yar gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ sngon 'gro gsum 'gre/ dngos gzhi ni/ spyi don gnyis pa lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir du lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam sgom pa la dbang bzhi'i dang po bum dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba la/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa/ lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ mda' kha ma gong du 'pho ba/ bar do rang sems dang yi dam ro gcig pa/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de ltar sa bcad drug gi dang po/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang / bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsag sbyang 'jug gsum gong bzhin byas rjes/ man ngag gi bsnyen pa ni/ 'dir bsnyen pa yongs rdzogs dmigs rim gyis stabs byed long mi yong bas/ des na man ngag gi bsnyen pa zhes brjod pa yang / dmigs pa'i khyad par yin pas de la mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa blangs la/ rang kyai rdo rje gsal ba'i phyag bcu drug gi thod pa'i nang gi glang po che sogs brgyad dang / sa'i lha sogs brgyad kyang kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par bsam pa sogs spro gang thub spros te/ de thams cad kyis bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad par bsam la/

aṣ+ṭa lan gcig brjod pas kyang / sa ya bye ba dung phyur tsam song bar bsam pa'o/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ rjes kyi chos gsum 'gre/ ༈ nyi ma drug pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'grel pa rdzogs pa dang / glegs bam las rgyu dbang bskur ba'i gnad sogs chos sna mang du bzhugs pa'i chos sna kha yar gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ gnyis pa sems 'dzin la gnyis te/ phyi bskyed rim dang / nang bskyed rim mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'jug pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa'i rim pa/ ldang ba'i rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar/ mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnas pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ nga rgyal la bslab pa dang / rnam pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje dngos yin snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnam pa la bslab pa la gsum ste/ lha dgu la sems 'dzin pa/ gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin pa/ phyi rol gyi snod bcud la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gtso bo yab yum la sems 'dzin pa dang / 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la sems 'dzin pa'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ yab la sems 'dzin pa dang / yum la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams tshar ba'i rjes su/ rang la nga rgyal bzung la/ de nas rang nyid kyai rdo rjer bsgom pa'i rtsa zhal gyi spyan dbus ma la sems 'dzin pa yin no/ /de la gsum ste/ sgom pas gsal gdab pa/ brjod pas/ bris pas gsal gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi smin mtshams su spyan dbu ma dbus gnag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba/ gze ma dang smin ma g.yas phyogs su se khyug ge ba gcig bsam pa/ shes pa ma yengs par bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgom pas gsal ma theb na/ gnyis pa ngag tu brjod pas gsal gdab par bya ste/

de'ang rang gi ngag tu spyan dbu ma sogs gong bzhin gsal bar brjod cing / gsal gdab bo/ /des kyang mi gsal na/ gsum pa bris pas gsal gdab pa ni/ lha ris pa mkhas pos spyan dbu ma gong bzhin legs par bris la/ rang gi smin mtshams su sbyar la me long dkyil mi 'bur ba g.ya' dang bral ba nye ring ran par bzhag ste/ de'i nang du 'char du bcug la/ de la lta zhing bsgom pa'o/ /de yang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad ces pa 'phro bzang mu la ngal gso zhing / bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad ces pa bsgom pa dang zhe ma 'gras par bzang gyes byas la ngal gso zhing bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / 'phro bcad kyang rnam pa wal wal byed pa dang / bsgom pa'i dus mi gsal na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas/ shes pa gzhan la g.yeng du bcug nas ngal gso zhing yang yang bsgom mo/ /de ltar byas pas gsal bar byung na lha so so'i dag pa/ med par nus pa de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ zhi gnas kyi nyams skyes na rang rig pa'i dag pa gsum mthar sleb pa yin no/ /de yang rje btsun gyis/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba/ /bskyed pa'i rim la gnad du gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas par bya ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis smon lam/ yig ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang ba/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa rnams byas nas/ thun mtshams rnams su lha'i nga rgyal gyi spyod lam gyis rnal 'byor rnams bya'o/ /'di yang thun bzhir bcad de bsgom mo/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bdun pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung rgyun du bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul nas brtsams te yig sna kha yar bklags la dmigs pa ni/ 'jug pa'i rim pa sngon du song nas/ gnas pa'i rim pa'i dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ thun bzhi'i dang po/ spyan dbu ma la sngar bzhin/

thun gnyis pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la spyan gzhan gnyis/ dbus gnag pa/ mtha' skya ba sogs gong spyan dbu ma bzhin gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ shangs kyi khro gnyer sgom pa'o/ ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ shangs gzengs mtho bar gsal btabs te bsgom pa'o/ /ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ dag pa dran pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma brgyad pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung lam 'bring po nas chos sna rnams rdzogs pa dang / glegs bam gyi dkar chag dang / gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i 'khrid/ rlung sbyor bsdus pa rnams kyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim sngon du song nas/ gnas pa'i rim pa dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ spyan dbu ma nas shangs gzengs mtho ba yan shar bsgom gyi tshul du byas la/ thun dang po la/ zhal gyi mchu sgros gtsang zhing / cung zad brdzes pa/ mche ba'i myu gu zla tshes lta bu bzhi cung zad gtsigs shing / tshem bzhi bcu tshang bar gsal btab ste sgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ snyan zhal shin tu ring ba gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ rtsa zhal yongs su rdzogs par mgrin pa sor bzhi pa dang bcas pa dang bcas gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ g.yas zhal dkar po 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ spyan dbu ma nas brtsams te/ snyan zhal ring ba mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i bar g.yas zhal yongs rdzogs sgom pa'o/ /ldang ba'i rim pa gong bzhin/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma dgu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung ni lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba ste/ glegs bam yongs rdzogs kyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ thun bzhi'i dang po la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/

gong gi dmigs pa rnams shar sgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi ni/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan dbu ma nas brtsams mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i bar gsal btab ste yongs rdzogs bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ zhal g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis/ dang po g.yas zhal las cung che ba/ gnyis pa cung chung ba cung zad khro bo'i rnam pa can/ spyan dbu ma nas brtsams mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i bar yongs rdzogs gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ g.yon zhal lhag ma gnyis/ gong gi g.yas zhal lhag ma gnyis dang mtshungs par gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ skra mtshams nas sor bzhi gzhal ba 'tshogs ma/ de nas sor bzhi gzhal ba spyi bo yin/ de'i steng du steng zhal dud kha zhes pa shin tu sngo zhing dang pa/ g.yu gru dkar gyi mdog lta bu cung zad khro bo'i rnam pa can/ spyan dbu ma nas mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i bar gsal btab cing bsgom pa'o/ /de'i dbu'i rgyab ngos su dbu'i gtsug tor lta bas mi mngon par gsal btab ste sgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lam dus nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gong gi dmigs pa ni/ shar bsgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa thun bzhi'i dang po gnas rim la dbu'i gtsug tor dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa dang / 'tshogs ma'i steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa'am/ bcu gnyis pa gang bde nyal stabs su yod pa/ shar dkar po rtsa zhal ngos la bstan pa/ de'i lte bar bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/

spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon byed grwa mig sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dbus kyi lte ba sgor mo de/ steng zhal gyi mgrin pa la rgyus pa'i rnam pas/ grwa mig gsum cu rtsa gnyis po phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ste brgyad du bkab pa'i tshul gyi sne rnams thod skam rnams kyi srub nas lhug tsam mthong ba gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu la brgyan pa ni/ thod pa'i dum bu sgor mo la/ mtshon gyis kha mig gtod pa'i/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu la brgyan zhing / de'i steng du rgyus pa'i rtse bran la rigs lngas mtshan pa lnga lngas brgyan pa'o/ /snyan rgyan ni/ dung long lta bu rus pa'i rgyan sgor mos brgyan pa gsal btab cing bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ mgul par mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa mtshon byed/ rus pa'i 'phreng ba grwa mig bcu drug pa dang / khro bo'i sku stod sbom zhing rgyas par gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu gcig pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdor gyi brgyud 'debs dang / rnam bshad nas/ lus dkyil tshugs tsam gyis lung bklag dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gong gi dmigs pa rnams shar sgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa/ thun bzhi'i dang po gnas rim la/ mgrin pa dang 'brel ba'i sog pa gcig de dang 'brel ba'i dpung pa brgyad/ de dang 'brel ba'i bar lhu brgyad/ de dang 'brel ba'i phyag ngar brgyad/ de phyag mtshan thod pa brgyad kyi nang du/ glang po che sogs brgyad po kha nang du bltas pa/ srog chags gzhan rnams rtogs sla la/ sha raṃ bha ni che chung lug tsam/ rkang lag bzhi po'i steng du gshog pa re re yod pa/ khyung gi mchu dang rwa co yod pa'o/

/srog chags brgyad po kha nang du bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sems can rnams la nad brgyad mi gtong bar nang du bsdud pa'o/ /nad brgyad ni/ gur las/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skam 'dze dang bir 'dzi ka /mchin pa mcher pa'i nad rnams la/ /glang po la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes gsung pa ltar ro/ /de ltar gsal btab la bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa la 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ phyag g.yon brgyad gong bzhin sgom la/ phyag mtshan gyi lha sogs brgyad po zhal phyir gzigs pa'o/ /de'i dgos pa ni/ sems can rnams la dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad brtsol ba'o/ /lha 'di rnams kyi phyag stabs lugs mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam bshad kyang / g.yas rnams mchog sbyin dang / g.yon rnams skyabs sbyin mdzad pa 'di 'thad do/ /dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ni/ 'grel pa sgron gsal du/ rgyud kyi lung drangs pa la/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro yi dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod 'phrin las yon tan brgyad pa 'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ phyag lhag la rnams 'khor phyag gi tshul du yod pa'o/ /phyag re re la rus pa'i rgyan phyag gdub gnyis gnyis kyisasha brgyan pa'o/ /se ral kha ni/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa mtshon byed rkang gnyis gnyis te brgyad yod pas sku stod la brgyan pa'o/ /de ltar gsal btab cing bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ khro bo'i sku smad sgeg pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i g.yas g.yon du/ spyi re re la mdun rgyab tu gyes pa'i zhabs gnyis gnyis te/ de yang g.yas gnyis brkyang pa'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis brkums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de yang zhabs bzhi'i brla gnyis/

zhabs ngar gnyis/ zhabs mgo gnyis rnams rim gyis gsal btab cing / zhabs re re la rus pa'i rgyan zhabs gdub re res brgyan cing sku la mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis brgyan cing / gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i lte ba'i thad nas tsam ste sked par/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi mtshon byed/ rus pa'i smad rgyan grwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi pa rnams gsal btab cing bsgom pa'o/ /des gtso bo yab la sems 'dzin pa song nas/ ldang rim bya/ gnyis pa yum la sems 'dzin pa ni/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma/ sku mdog sngo skya shin tu dngas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhes pa'i rgyan lnga ni se ral kha 'jog pa'o/ /zhabs g.yon rkyang zhing g.yas bskums yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /'di yang spyan dbus ma nas brtsams te zhal phyag rgyan sogs rim pas gsal btab cing bsgom mo/ /des gtso bo yab yum la sems 'dzin pa song nas ldang rim bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu gnyis pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ /lung rnam bshad 'phros rdzogs par bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ rnam pa la slab pa la gsum gyi dang po lha dgu la sems 'dzin pa la/ gnyis kyi dang po bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la sems 'dzin pa ni/ thun bzhi'i dang po la 'jug rim bya/ gong gis dmigs pa rnams shar sgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi gnas rim la/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mdun du/ lha mo gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug

g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ nub tu baita lī ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskums pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ de bzhi yang re re nas spyan dbus ma nas brtsams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan/ bzhugs stangs sogs rim pa bzhin gsal 'debs pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu gsum pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung pod dmar ma'i dkar chag nas brtsams te/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal yan gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ thun bzhi'i dang po 'jug rim bya/ gong gi dmigs pa rnams shar sgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi'i gnas rim la/ byang shar du puk+ka si sngon po g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa sgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong shol 'dzin pa bsgom/ ldang rim bya/ thun bzhi pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa sgom/ ldang rim bya/ 'di bzhi'ang / rgyan cha lugs sogs gong gi phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhin gsal 'debs pa'o/

/lha mo brgyad ni gtso bo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad 'dab brgyad la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po sogs nas/ thags bzang ris dud kha rnams kyi gdan steng du bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yung mo ni sku mdog ljang khu'am/ yang na/ rkang pa rlung mtshon byed sngon po/ gsum mdo me mtshon byed dmar po/ lte ba chu mtshon byed dkar po/ snying kha sa mtshon byed ser po/ mgrin pa me mtshon byed dmar po/ spyi bo rlung mtshon byed sngon po'am/ ljang gur bsgom mo/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di rnams kyis 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la sems 'dzin pa bstan to/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu bzhi pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung lus gnad kyi gdams ngag nas/ gegs sel gleng gzhi ma rdzogs kyi bar de'i yig sna rnams bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ thun bzhi'i dang po la 'jug rim bya/ gong gi dmigs pa rnams shar sgom du bsgom la/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ rnam pa la bslab pa'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin pa ni/ gnas rim la/ dang po rten gzhal yas khang pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi'i steng du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing / steng thog rim par phug cing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsig dpangs la cha chen bcu drug rgyar cha chen bcu gnyis/ pha gu'i dpangs la cha phran gcig dra ba dra phyed la cha phran gnyis/ gser gyi gdung leb la cha phran gyi lnga cha/ 'da' yab dang / pu shu la cha phran re re/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod snam gyi rgya dpangs la cha chen gnyis pa'i steng du lha mo bcu drug sgo bzhi'i mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra rnams dang / khyam ljang nyi dkyil ljang khu/ de'i phyi rol du sna tshogs pad rwa/ nyi dkyil ljang gur yong ba ni/

nyi dkyil la sna tshogs pad+ma'i mdangs phog pa la brten nas ljang gur yong ba'o/ de rnams rim pas gsal 'debs pa'o/ ldang rim bya/ thun gnyis pa la/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ de'i phyi rol dur khrod brgyad po la/ shing / me/ sprin/ mchod rten/ phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / klu/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa re re la rim pas gsal 'debs pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ thun gsum pa la 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ de'i phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas gsal 'debs pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ des gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin pa bstan zin to/ /'di rnams kyi rgyas bshad spro bar 'dod na rnam bshad rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /rnam pa la bslab pa'i gsum pa phyi rol gyi snod bcud la sems 'dzin pa ni/ thun bzhi pa la 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par gsal btab pa'o/ /de yang gzhal yas khang sogs/ dang po stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kheng par sgom pa dang / de nas stong gsum yungs 'brur tshud par sgom pa'o/ /de yang gzhal yas khang sogs chung du ma song ba dang / yungs 'bru cher ma song bar sgom zhing gsal 'debs pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ de rnams kyis phyi bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ 'di'i mtshams su la dbang bskur te/ de nas brtsams te slob ma rnams kyis/ lam dus rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ mtha' mas kyang thun gnyis ma chag pa byed dgos so/ /'di skabs su byung na tshogs 'khor yang mdzad do/ /lam dbang bskur tshul gyi yig cha ni/ rgyal tshab dam pas mdzad pa sogs kyi steng nas bya'o/ /bir wa pa'i byin rlabs ni nyer dgu nges par bya dgos so/

/lam zab/ rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyang skabs su gang bab la bya'o/ /'di rnams kyi byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i steng nas byed/ lam zab byed gong zhag bdun tsam gyi gong du lam zab kyi bsags sbyang 'bog bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyang skabs su gang bab la bya zhing yig cha pod dmar ma'i nang gi rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa sogs kyi steng nas byed/ ༈ nyi ma bco lnga pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sel thabs nas spyir zhen pa zlog pa brgyal ba slang ba/ 'thor ba bsdu pa'o/ /zhes pa'i yig sna rdzogs pa'i bar gyi yig sna rnams bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ nang bskyed rim la/ phyi dkyil las nang dkyil zab tshul/ de rgyud las gsung tshul/ de nyams su len tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyi rdul mtshon nam/ ras bris dkyil 'khor ma gtogs par/ 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sgrub gzhi rang gi lus la yod pas zab/ lha yang phyi dkyil gyi dbang ni phyi'i lha kho na las len pa las med la/ lus dkyil kyi dbang ni phyi nang gi lha thams cad la len pa'i phyir/ phyi dkyil las nang dkyil zab pa'o/ /nyams len yang / gzhung las lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgom pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya zhes gsung ste/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang yin par gsung pas na zab pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ ā lī kā li ni/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / shes rab dang thabs so/ /zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes sogs kyi bar gyis bstan no/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par byed pa spro na/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan du blta'o/ /gsum pa nyams su len tshul la gnyis las/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang blang ba dang / lus dkyil la sems 'dzin tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma'i rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du lam dbang len pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig tu lugs gnyis tsam bshad kyang 'di 'jug pa bde bas/ nang lus dkyil gyi srung 'khor zhal yas khang dang sems 'dzin tshul/ pho brang lnga'i bar rnams la sems 'dzin tshul/ zhar chung yan lag gi lha rnams la sems 'dzin tshul lo/ /de la dang po ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ de yang spyi bo nas rkang rnams ka ba brgyad kyi bar gyi/ de dang de'i sha rus chu rgyus dang bcas pa/ sbyang gzhi rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje sogs ni spyi bo'i sha lpags mtshams su sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar po dpral ba ngos su bstan pa/ lte ba mthing nag tu bsgom pa'o/ /rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi ni/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi sha lpags mtshams su rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam go mtshams med par 'dab chags su yod par bsgom pa'o/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i rwa ba ni/ rtsib ma rnams rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rwa bar bsgom pa'o/ /lpags pa ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa sbrel ba'i gur dang / bla brer sgom pa'o/ /ba spu rnams ni mda'i dra ba ste/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i mde'u phyir bstan par bsgom pa'o/ /skra sen rnams ni ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar bsgom pa ste bsrung 'khor la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /des srung 'khor song nas/ lus dkyil gyi gzhal yas khang ni/ rkang mthil rlung ni rkang pa'i long mor gyi mtshams su/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa bsgom pa'o/ /gsum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rtse yar bstan pa bsgom pa'o/ /lto ba chu ni/ lto ba chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkyil 'bur tsam phyogs bzhir bum pa phyed pas mtshan pa bsgom/ snying khar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po bsgom pa'o/

/sgal tshig ri rab ni/ sgal tshig nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang re re ri rab shar shel/ lho baiḍur ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa re re bsgom pa'o/ /'khrid yig 'ga' zhig tu kha dog dkar por/ zhe gcig tu sgom par bshad pas gang bde byas pas chog go /mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi+i cha ni/ mig 'bor gnyis/ mkhur rtse gnyis/ rna ltag gi rus 'bur gnyis rnams su ri rab kyi spe lcog dkar po shin tu mtshar ba re re sgom pa'o/ /lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi ni/ spyi bo dang rkang mthil lag mthil gnyis rnams su rtsig pa khra 'khyug ge ba zur bzhi sgom pa'o/ /snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni/ snying gi phyogs bzhi'i rtsa bzhi'i nang du sgo chung bzhi bsgom pa'o/ /mig pan+tsa re kha ni/ mig gnyis su rtsig pa khra 'khyug pa re bsgom pa'o/ /sna rin chen pha gu ni/ sna bug gnyis 'dzom pa'i yas sner pha gu ser po shing ris dang bcas pa bsgom pa'o/ /so ni dra ba dra phyed du sgom pa'o/ /lce mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu ni/ lce'i rtse dang yas mar gyi mchu gnyis kyi dbus su 'dod snam dmar po/ lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog dang bcas pa sgom pa'o/ /rna ba rta babs ni/ rna ba'i nang dro kha'i 'dzer pa lta bu'i mdun du/ rta babs kyi rnam pa bang rim bzhi pa cung zad re bsgom/ rkang brgyad ni/ lag pa la bzhi dang / rkang pa la bzhi ste brgyad ka ba zhu dang bcas par sgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di don bsam zhing sems 'dzin pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu drug pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung spyir gdon gyi bar chad bsrung ba/ zhes pa nas/ brda' don gsal ba rdzogs pa yan gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ gnyis pa pho brang lnga'i lha rnams la sems 'dzin tshul ni/ thog mar lus lte ba nas chags pa yin kyang / sems 'dzin pa la/ sems gnas pa snying kha yin pas/

pho brang lnga'i dang po/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo gsal 'debs pa ni/ pho brang lnga ka la/ rgyu'i nges pa/ rnams pa'i nges pa/ tshad kyi nges pa/ gnas kyi nges pa/ ngo bo'i nges pa/ yon tan gyi nges pa ste/ khyad chos drug drug gi bstan la 'bebs pa yin la/ de yang snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu'i nges pa ni/ snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad gru gu sgril ba lta bu'i dbus na rtsa yi mdud pa yi ge hūm̐ gi dbyibs can/ nang gi khams dang ma dang bcas pa'o/ /rnam pa'i nges pa ni/ mi bskyod pa sngon po/ phyi shun gyi rtsa yum chu rnam par dag pa la ma mā kī sngon mo phyag mtshan sogs yab yum gnyis ka ngag 'don ltar/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan zhes pa gnyis ka dgos pa ma yin/ rus rgyan gyi bkag rnams rin po che'i phra tshom gyis byas pa la rin po che'i rgyan zhes btags pa yin no/ /yab yum gnyis bzhugs stangs zhabs skyil krung kyang bshad kyang / 'dir ni/ yab zhabs g.yas brkyang dang / yum g.yon brkyang du mdzad do/ /'khor gyi lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang g.yas bskums du bzhugs pa'o/ /tshad kyi nges pa ni/ gtso bo mthe'u chung gi sor tshig tsam/ 'khor rnams de'i phyed tsam mo/ /gnas kyi nges pa ni/ snying kha ste nu ma gnyis kyi bar ro/ /ngo bo'i nges pa ni/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa yab yum 'khor bcas so/ /yon tan gyi nges pa ni/ dbu'i gtsug tor lta bas mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan dang dpe byed kyis brgyan pa 'ja' lus sam 'od kyi phung po'i rang bzhin no/ /'khor rnams thugs rdo rje la gus pa'i tshul gyis spyan gzigs pa'o/ /'di man bzhi ka la gtso 'khor sogs ngag 'don bzhin dang / gong gi khyad chos drug po rigs 'gre shes par byas te/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu nges ni/ mgrin pa na rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus na rtsa mdud pa'i dbyibs thal mo gyen du bkan pa lta bu yi ge oṃ gyi rnam pa sogs 'gre/

rnam nges/ 'od dpag med sogs 'gre/ tshad nges/ gtso bo nas tsam/ 'khor de'i phyed tsam/ gnas kyi nges pa/ mgrin pa'i ol stong gi nang / ngo bo'i nges pa/ gsung rdo rje sogs/ yon tan gyi nges pa 'gre/ gtso 'khor rnams kyang spyan thugs rdo rje la gzigs pa'o/ /spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i rgyu nges ni/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa gdugs phub pa ltar gyi dbus nas rtsa mdud pa'i dbyibs can yi ge haṃ yig gi rnam pa sogs 'gre/ rnam nges/ rnam par snang mdzad sogs 'gre/ tshad nges/ gtso bo mthe chung gi sor tshigs tsam/ 'khor de'i phyed tsam/ gnas nges/ spyi bo'i nang thad du/ ngo bo'i nges pa/ sku rdo rje sogs/ yon tan gyi nges pa 'gre/ gtso 'khor rnams spyan thugs rdo rje la gzigs pa'o/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rgyu nges ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa thags rgyangs pa lta bu'i dbus na yi ge aṃ gi dbyibs can sogs 'dra/ rnam nges/ rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ tshad nges/ gtso bo mthe bong gi sor tshigs tsam/ 'khor phyed tsam/ gnas nges/ lte ba'i dbus/ ngo bo'i nges pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ yon tan gyi nges pa 'gre/ gtso bor rnams kyi spyan gus pa'i tshul gyi thugs rdo rje la gzigs pa'o/ /gsang gnas bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyu nges/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i sked par rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dbus na yi ge ha yi rnam pa can sogs 'gre/ rnam nges/ don yod grub pa sogs/ tshad nges/ gtso bo dpal 'bru tsam/ 'khor de'i phyed/ gnas nges/ rdo rje'i sked pa/ ngo bo'i nges pa/ 'phrin las don yod grub pa sogs/ yon tan gyi nges pa 'gre/ gtso 'khor rnams kyang thugs rdo rje la gzigs pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di rnams la sems 'dzin pa la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu bdun pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/

lung lam 'bras lho pa'i zin bris nas sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i lam zab li chu tsher khab ma rdzogs pa yan bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la/ zhar byung yan lag gi lha rnams la sems 'dzin tshul ni/ mig tu gzugs rig par byed pa'i rtsa'am/ dbang po/ zer me'i me tog kha bye ba lta bu/ rna ba gnyis na rtsa'i dbang po bro kha'i 'dzer pa phyi la bcus pa lta bu/ snar rtsa'am dbang po/ zangs kyi mo khab thur du bshib pa lta bu/ lce rtsa'am dbang po lce'i dbus su sran ma phyed kas pa lta bu/ lus dbang ngam rtsa ni smin mtshams te/ dpral bar pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po/ snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i stod kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang du yid dbang ngam rtsa thig le sngon po de rnams las/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma'i bar thams cad skug mdog rgyan/ phyag mtshan sogs lus dkyil gyi ngag 'don bzhin no/ /de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis/ dbang po de dag gi rlung las grub pa'i/ mig tu gzugs gau rī nas/ chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste/ thams cad sku mdog rgyan phyag mtshan sogs lus dkyil gyi ngag 'don bzhin no/ /gti mug rdo rje ma sogs dang zhal sprod kyi tshul du bsgom pa'o/ /khro bo bcu ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi 'khrig ma ste tshigs/ lce'i phug lce chung gi thad/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa ba ste nor bu'i dbus sam/ bha ga'i rtsa ba/ dpung mgo'i tshigs gnyis/ rkang pa gnyis kyi long bu'i tshigs gnyis/ spyi gtsug gi rnam snang gi steng rnams su/ rtsa 'dab ma bcu pa re gnas pa'i dbus na rtsa yi ge hūm̐ ring po re re gyur pa las/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed sngon po nas/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes sngon po'i bar sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs stangs sogs lus dkyil kyi ngag 'don bzhin/ thams cad phyag g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/

/de ltar sgom pa'i lha rnams sku'i dbyibs rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong / ngo bor zung 'jug tu bsam/ gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi skur sgom pa'o/ /ldang rim bya/ 'di rnams la sems 'dzin pa la thun gcig byed/ 'di yan gyi nang bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs par bstan zin to/ ༈ /nyi ma bco brgyad pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung rgyas pa'i lam bsgrub pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas/ tshar gsum khug pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs pa yan gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ 'jug rim bya/ gnas rim la// //spyi don gnyis pa lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum ni/ snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid do/ /dang po snang phyogs ni/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim gyi lha la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa stong phyogs ni/ lha rnams mi dmigs par byas nas/ lta ba stong nyid la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa zung 'jug ni stong nyid kyi ngang las/ chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyi lha'i skur langs nas/ slar yang lha la sems 'dzin pa'o// //spyi don gsum la grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin te/ de thams cad rang sems dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang dbyer med du rtogs pa'o// //spyi don bzhi pa mda' kha ma gong du 'pho ba ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma snyogs na/ 'chi khar snyogs pa'i thabs gang zag 'bring gi lam mda' kha ma nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang nges par 'chi ba'i tshe/ mda' kha ma'i sbyor ba bya dgos pa yin no/ /gzhan du na lha bsad pa'i nyes par 'gyur bas mi bya'o/ /de la 'chi ltas rtag par gal che ste/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar na/ rang gi lus kyi grib ma la bltas pas/

mgo dang yan lag ma tshang ba dang / ro sgong pa lta bu mthong ba dang / rgyu med par skyes pa la dmar cha dang / bud med la dkar cha 'dzags pa dang / has btab na grang ba/ phus btab na dro ba/ kha ba dang / bye thang la phyin pas rang gi rkang rjes tshang ma mi mngon pa dang / nam mkha'i me tog yal ba/ mkha' 'gro'i sgra yal ba/ gnam sa'i 'brel thag chad pa ste 'di rnams shar na phal cher zla ba drug nas 'chi bar gsung so/ /rgyas par ni/ rgyu gsum mdzes rgyan du blta'o/ /'chi ltas de rnams byung ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' zas su za ba sogs kyi 'chi bslu rnams bya/ de rnams kyis ma bslus na/ gong du 'pho ba la/ snang ba sgyur ba'i mda' kha ma/ 'od kyi gong bu'i mda' kha ma/ sgras 'pho ba'i mda' kha ma'o/ /dang po ni 'chi ba la 'jig pa dang / skrag pa med par bag gro hu re/ shes pa spro sing nge bya'o/ /de nas lus skyil krung ngam/ tsogapu gang bde byas la/ bdag nyid lhar bsgom pa btang snyoms byas te/ snang ba sna tshogs za zi gang byung ba'i tshe/ de nyid bla ma dang / lhag pa'i lha dbyer med yin snyams pa'i dran 'dun drag po rgyun ma chad par btang la de'i thugs kar rang nyid skar mda' 'phang pa bzhin yang dang yang du byas pa la brten nas/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med kyi thugs dang rang gi shes pa ro gcig gyur te/ grub mtha' snyogs pa'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ lus lhag pa lha'i gzugs can/ sprul sku las chos nyan zhing / tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub cing / longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'od kyi gong bu'i mda' kha ma ni/ lus tsog pur bya pa'i rting pas 'og sgo bkag lag pa gnyis kyis ltag pa nas bskyor/ rang lhar bsgom pa'i snying kha'i nang du 'od kyi gong bu mthe bong tsam dkar hril leb zhig bsam/ de las de 'dra ba'i 'od kyi gong bu re re chad de/ dang po dmyal bar skye ba'i sgo bshang lam/

dur 'gro'i sgo gci lam/ 'dod khams kyi lha'i sgo lte ba/ yi dwags kyi sgo kha/ gnod sbyin gyi sgo sna bug gnyis/ mi'i rgyal po dang / mi phal pa'i sgo g.yas g.yon/ mi'am ci'i sgo rna ba gnyis/ gzugs khams kyi lha'i sgo mdzod spu/ gzugs med kyi lha'i sgo spyi bo rnams bgag par byas te/ de nas lte ba'i nang du rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sems kyi rten/ hūm̐ mthing nag rnams che chung ci rigs par bsam la/ lus gnad lag pa mkhyud pa dam du bsdam/ lus sgrim ste/ 'og sgo 'then la mig gyen du bzlog ste/ ngag gi gnad hūm̐ drag la ring bar drangs/ sems kyi gnad rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ rnams bya spu rlung gis btegs pa bzhin/ yar yar song ste/ hūm̐ nyi shus mgrin par drang / nyer gcig pa la tshang sgo gsal te/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor myur du shig hūṃ nyer gcig pa la drag la ring bar brjod/ sems kyi rten dang brten pa gsum ka skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad pa'i thugs khar 'phang par bsam pa'o/ /lan gcig la ma 'phos na yang yang bskyar la bya'o/ /gsum pa sgras 'pho ba'i mda' kha ma ni/ gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra la/ sgo rnams dbang bzhi pa'i mda' ka ma bzhin yi ges bkag la/ rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ rnams gong gi hūm̐ gi tshab/ hika nyer gcig gi lha dang bla ma dbyer med kyi thugs khar 'pho ba gong dang 'dra/ de ltar byas byas pas grub thabs snyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro// //spyi don lnga pa bar do yi dam gyi lha dang rang sems ro gcig pa ni/ bar dor yid kyi lus blangs pa'i tshe/ skad gcig tsam yang sdod dbang med par/ skye gnas don du gnyer bas phyogs kun tu rgyugs pa la brten nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung 'khrugs te/ sa rlung 'khrugs pas ri chen po grum pa lta bu'i sgra/ chu rlung 'khrugs pas rgya mtsho mchol ba lta bu'i sgra/

me rlung 'khrugs pas bskal pa 'jigs pa'i me lta bu'i sgra/ rlung gis rlung 'khrugs pas dus mtha'i rlung lta bu'i sgra ste/ 'jigs pa'i sgra chen po bzhi thos shing / nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rang gzugs/ nyams nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste/ 'khrul snang bdun po shar ba na/ de dang rjes mtshungs par do'i longs spyod/ gnam bya dri lnga/ 'od kyi lam kha dog lngar 'char la/ dri lnga ni/ rtsa ba/ snying po/ lo ma/ me tog 'bras bu lta bu'i dri lngar gsungs shing / 'od lam ni/ nag po dmyal ba/ ser po yi dwags/ dkar po dud 'gro/ dmar po lha/ ljang khu lha ma yin/ sna tshogs su snang na mi'o/ /de rnams ni ma nges pa'i rtags drug go /de'i tshe/ 'jig pa'i dbang gi skyabs 'tshol te/ lam ma sgom pa'i tha mal pa rnams/ gang du skye ba'i skye gnas de/ rin po che'i khang bzang la sogs par mthong ste/ der 'bros ba'i snang ba shar ba la brten nas skye gnas der 'jug pa yin yang / rnal 'byor pa bar do'i gdams ngag lhongs su gyur pa rnams la/ sngar gyi rkyen bdun po shar ba na/ dang por phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod pa'i bla ma dran pa dang / des bstan pa'i thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dran cing / bdag nyid kyang lhag pa'i lhar dran pa 'byung la de ma thag gnam bya yang lhag pa'i lhar shar ste/ rten 'brel des gsang mtshan nas lung ston pa 'byung zhing / de la brten nas rang sems bla ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa la brten nas grub mtha' snyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /de tsam na bdud kyis lung ston pa srid pas/ de la dbang bzhi'i brda la gom pa dang / gsang mtshan gsang ba shin tu gces so// //spyi don drug pa 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa ni/ 'og 'bras bu'i skabs nyid du 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir ma spros so/ /'di yan gyi bum dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/

/ldang rim bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma bcu dgu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung mkhas pa sgo drug la/ rje 'brog mis chos 'brel du zhus pa'i gdams ngag tu zhes pa nas/ rje bir wa pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel rdzogs pa yan bklags la/ de nas rdzogs rim gyi bsag sbyang zhu ba'iyon du mchod g.yog pas 'bul mkhan byas la/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal bdun ma gnyis dang / so bdun ma gcig ste gsum gtud nas phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyi rjes bzlos kyang byed/ bsag sbyang ni yi ge brgya pa dang maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs pa sogs gong bzhin/ khyad chos phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul lugs ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nas cung zad bzung la/ tshig rnams btud nas brjod cing / 'jug tu sngags 'don/ de lta bu lan grangs mang du 'bul ba'o/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyi shu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung bir wa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris nas/ pod dmar ma rdzogs pa'i lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ gnyis pa ni/ gsang dbang la/ lam bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ mda' kha ma 'od gsal ba/ bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la rtog med/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste drug go /dang po la gnyis las/ sngon 'gro bsag sbyang gi rnal 'byor dang / dngos gzhi 'khrid kyi rim pa gnyis so/ dang po la 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kha sang gi gnas skabs su song nas/ gnyis pa thun gyi sngon 'gro la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu ni/ sbyang ba rnam pa gsum/ gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum/ sgom pa rnam pa gsum dang dgu las/ dang po gsum ni/ lus sbyang ba/ ngag sbyang ba/ yid sbyang ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ lus thog mar chus dkrus/

de nas chang gis dkrus/ de nas rang gi dri chu bar pas dkrus la/ lo snum sogs kyis sku mnyed bya zhing / de nas/ mgo bo mjing pa sgyur bya zhing / /lag pa gnyis ni so sor g.yab/ /rkang pa gnyis ni drag tu krugs/ /yan lag lnga yi sbyang ba 'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi bsdus pa'am/ shes shing spro na/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ngag sbyang ba ni/ lce mi bskyod par ngag gi las thams cad spang ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyis bsdus pa'am/ gsum pa sems sbyang ba ni/ rnam rtog thams cad spangs la yid skyo sang nge bzhag te/ de yang / skyo ba'i gnas su bsam gtan 'khor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum ni/ lus gnad la dbab pa/ ngag gnad la dbab pa/ sems gnad la dbab pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ lus skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshig drang por bsrang ba/ mgrin pa bya ngang pa'i mgrin pa bzhin dgug pa/ mig sna rtser dbab pa/ lce rkan la sbyar ba/ dpung mgo gnyis rgod gshog ltar rgyangs pa ste/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ngag gnad la dbab pa ni/ rlung drag tu lan gsum phyir 'bud pa ste/ khang pa'i nang gi mi gtsang ba phyag dar byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa sems gnad la dbab pa ni/ shes pa khong lhod kyis glong la bzo med lhug par dar gcig 'jog pa'o/ /de nas rta rgyug khar dbugs ngal gso ba dang 'dra'o/ /bsgom pa rnam pa gsum ni/ rgyas par ni/ mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi drug gang rigs skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rdzogs par nyams su len pa'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ sngar 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi skabs su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum las/ khyab byed man ngag gi gnad rlung gi rnal 'byor/ khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i dmigs pa/ de dag gi skabs su dgos pa'i man ngag gi gnad dang gsum mo/ de'i dang po rlung sgom pa gal che ste/ rlung gi rnal 'byor yang /

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs kyang / man ngag nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'du la/ de yang man ngag gi gnad dgur brgyar 'du zhing / de yang nyi brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar 'du la/ de yang bcur 'du zhing / de yang ldang ba/ 'jug pa/ gnas pa/ thams cad sdom pa dang bzhir 'du ba yin no/ de la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi 'di'i lam/ 'jug gnas/ ldang ba/ bsdom bzhi ka sangs rgyas kyi lam du byed pa la/ srol rtsol lam/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa gcig dang / phyir 'gro ba lam du byed pa phyir btang gi man ngag gsum/ nang du 'jug pa lam du byed pa nang du dgangs ba'i man ngag gnyis/ gnas pa lam du rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po kha sbyar dang bdun du bzhed de/ rje btsun rin po ches/ sbyor ba rnam bdun gtso bo'i bum pa can/ /zhes gsung so/ /de yang dang po srog rtsol nyams su blang ba ni/ thog mar rtsol ba nas mgo gzung la rlung phyir rgyu ba'i tshe phyir rgyu/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe nang du rgyus/ gnas pa'i tshe nang du gnas/ zhes nan gtan du bsgom/ de la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas/ rtsol ba la rngan brtags byin te/ phyir ring du rgyus/ nang du thung ngu rgyus/ nang du gnas zhes bsgom la/ de la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas/ srog nas mgo bzung ste/ rtsol ba bzhin 'gre/ de rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed na/ nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir 'gro ba hūm̐/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /de la ting 'dzin skyes nas/ srog la rngan btags byin ste/ nang du ring du rgyus/ nang du gnas/ phyir thung ngu rgyus/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /'di ni nang du ring du gnas pas/ tshe sgrub kyi mchog tu 'gyur zhing / ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas skyon gang sel na/ g.yang sa dang / sdib 'og dang / thog la sogs pa 'chi rkyen glo bur ba gang gis kyang bar chad bya bar mi nus te/ tshe la cung zad dbang thob pa yin no/

yon tan gang skye na mngon par shes pa 'char ba la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye'o/ /dag dran bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer gcig pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung lus sbyong nyi shu pa dang / 'phrin las so gnyis kyi rtsa tshig sogs kyi lung bklags shing / 'khrul 'khor shes pa rgyags shing brda ston par byed/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ phyir btang gi man ngag gsum gyi dang po ni/ rtsol ba bkag nas srog nas btang ba ni/ sems sna bug g.yon du gtad la rlung phyir 'bud pa'o/ /de'i yon tan lus bde bas khang ba dang / mi rtog pa myur du skye ba'o/ /skyon gang sel na/ stod gzer ba/ snying mi bde ba sogs sel lo/ /gnyis pa shugs bskyed de gnyis ka nas btang ba ni/ rang gi shes pa dang po mdzod pur gtad/ de nas nam mkhar 'khru gang tsam la/ mthar nam mkhas khyab tshad la shes pa gtod pa'am/ yang na shes pa gang la yang mi gtod par/ rlung sna gnyis ka nas shugs bskyed la btang ba'o/ /de'i yon tan ni gsal cha mthar thug skye ba'o/ /skyon gang sel na/ mgo nad/ mig nad/ rlung smad du 'khyams pa dang / rtsa log tu rlung log zhugs pa sogs sel lo/ /gsum pa kha nas sgra bcas su btang ba ni/ sems sing sgra la gtad cing / rlung so bar nas gzhur te/ sing sgra dang bcas te btang ba'o/ /de'i yon tan ni/ lus ldang ba yang ba/ zo mdog bde ba 'byung ba'o/ /skyon gang sel na/ khrag ro dang / rims nad thams cad dang / rlung stod du 'khyams pa/ rtsa log tu rlung log zhugs pa rnams sel lo/ /phyir gtong 'di gsum la nang du rlung 'ong du mi 'jug pa dang / phyin thub tshad mnon pa man ngag yin no/ /'di gsum la lus gnad tsog pu/ nang du dgang ba'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po rtsol ba bkag te srog nas dgang ba ni/ lte bar btum mo me'i nyal sa zhes bya ba chos 'byung sgong nga'i ko lpags lta bu/

phyi dkar la nang ser ba zhig gi nang na mar rlung sems rnams sib sib song bar bsam zhing / gung mdzub rtsegs pas sna g.yas bkag la sna g.yon nas rlung dal bus rngub ste/ rlung gi rta mchil ma mid pa thub tshad mnan pa'i rkyen gyis chos 'byung de'i nang du 'od dkar po skya ril pa zhig gi dbus su/ a dmar po tshal gyi bshad lta bu gcig byung ba la sems gtad pas/ chos 'byung de rgya je cher song ste/ sa gzhi ltar rgya che/ nam mkha' ltar dpangs stod/ rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa de'i nang na mar rlung thams cad song bar bsam pa'o/ /de'i yon tan ni drod dang sdong nas bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye'o/ /skyon gang sel na/ grang ba dang / skran dang / ma zhu ba'i nad sel lo/ /gnyis pa kha nas sgra med du dgang ba ni/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum/ phyi sngo la nang ser ba'am/ dmar ba zhig bsam la/ de'i nang na mar rlung thams cad sib sib 'gro ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas kha nas sgra med du dal bus dgang ba la brten nas/ chos 'byung gi nang du a dmar po tshal gyi bshad lta bu zhig bsam la de la rlung sib sib phog pas me so+or gnyis nas sor bzhi'i bar du 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad pas chos 'byung rgya je cher song bar bsam pa sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /de'i yon tan ni/ drod dang sdong nas bde gsal mi rtog pa skye ba'o/ /skyon gang sel na/ dmu chu la sogs pa'i nad dang / 'byung ba lus 'khrugs thams cad sel lo/ /'di gnyis kyi lus gnad rdo rje skyil krung ngo / /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer gnyis pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang chu chen mo'i phyed tsam gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ rlung sbyor bdun pa/ gnas pa lam du byed pa rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po kha sbyor gyi man ngagal/

lus rdo rje skyil krung bcas la/ lte bar a shad kyi rnam pa ring thung sor bzhi la/ sbom phra rta rnga tsam dmar po gcig bsam la/ de la shes pa drag tu gtad/ steng 'og gi rlung thams cad de la thim par bsams te/ 'og rlung dal bus bskums/ de nas steng rlung sna g.yon nas dal bus drangs te/ rdzogs pa dang mchil ma sgra med par mid la lhan gyis mnan/ de nas 'og rlung drag tu bskum/ de nas 'og rlung gnyis kyi gseb tu steng rlung bzhugs la kha sbyar/ rlung thams cad lte ba'i a shad la thim par bsam la/ de la shes pa drag tu gtad la bsgom mo/ /yang sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun la/ 'og rlung 'then pas rlung rgyab ngos nas khyu ru ru song bar bsams te rlung mnan pas/ de gnyis rtse 'phrad pa dang / 'og rlung mdun na mar steng rlung gi sgo ro ror gnan te/ a nang du bcug la dga' ba bakhyil pa'i tshul du kha sbyar te sgom zhes gsungs so/ /kha sbyar de'i ring la/ lag g.yas pus mo gnyis la skor ba dang / se gol re gtog pa yang rab kyi rgyun mi chad par 'ong / rab 'og gi drug cu rtsa bzhi/ 'bring gi sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tha mas nges pa med par 'byung la/ de yang nyin re bzhin spar bas tha ma'ang yang rab tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /de'i yon tan ni/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye zhing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /de'ang rje btsun rin po ches/ sangs rgyas lam ni kha sbyor dag la gnas/ /'di ni 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len te/ /'di ni rgas pa med pa'i sman gyi mchog /mthu stobs du ma bskyed par byed pa 'di/ /rim gnyis rten 'brel brtan par byed pa'ang 'di/ /zhes gsung pa ltar ro/ /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer gsum pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung dbang chu chen mo'i lung rdzogs par bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/

bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas dngos gzhi la/ spyi don gnyis pa khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i dmigs pa ni/ 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga dang / brten pa gsum/ man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba ste dgu'o/ /de'i dang po la/ mar me gso ba/ tshangs pa'i thog rtsi'i rnal 'byor/ srub shing gi 'khor lo/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /'di dag gi dang po ni/ lus tsog pu gnad la dbab la/ lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi tsam na/ k+ṣa yig dmar nag me'i rang bzhin mgo mthur du bstan pa dang / lte bar aṃ dmar skya mgo gyen du bstan pa gsal lam te btab la/ de nas rlung me ma dang gnyid ma rtse sprad pa zhes bya ba 'og sgo a long 'byed btsum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la cung zad 'then/ sum mdor me 'bar te/ lte ba'i k+ṣa yig me 'bar te/ aṃ la bsnun pas/ aṃ las byang chub sems kyi thig le k+ṣa yig la phog pas k+ṣa yig gi me gsos par bsam la/ steng rlung rim gyis bcug ste/ rlung kha sbyar te 'bar 'dzag la sems drag tu gtad cing bsgom mo/ /de yang / gsal la drag la yun thung ba/ /gtum mo'i sbyor ba dag la gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa tshangs pa'i thog ni/ man ngag gi tshig bcad las/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'/ /byang sems haṃ gi 'ben la rdog /myur du ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /bskyar ba'i sbyor ba med pa 'o/ /bla ma'i drung du bdag la bsgom/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de nyams su len pa la/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ lte ba rlung ni gzhu sngon po dang / sum mdor me'i mda' dmar po mda' stong 'byar ba/ 'chang zung dang mde'u bshang sgor 'dzom pa zhig bsams te lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma zangs dung lta bu 'phel kha 'thur la bltas pa'i yas sna spyi bor thug pa ste de'i dbus su haṃ dkar po mgo 'thur du blta ba rnams gsal btab la/ 'og rlung drag tu bskum pa dang bstun lto ba tshigs pa la sbyar/

mig steng du bgrad pas steng rlung rang khegs su 'gro/ 'og rlung gi nus pas/ mda' gzhu rgyab ngos nas khyu ru ru 'gyur te/ mde'u'i rtse lte bar sleb par bsam/ de nas ro stod gyen du 'then pas mda' gzhu mer gyis 'gang ste mda' rtse dbu ma'i mar snar tshud par bsams la/ lus kyi stod sdigs kyis skyur bas mda' stong bral te/ me'i mda' de dbu ma'i nang na yar thal te song ba dang / spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyud 'o ma lta bu skya nar gyis babs pas lte bar slebs te/ 'bar 'dzag gnyis la shes pa gtad de/ lus sems khong glod nas mnyam par bzhag go /'di la ni thun re la lan re las sgom du mi rung ngo / /gsum pa rtsa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad tsog pu/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ gsang gnas kyi g.yas ngos nas lte ba/ lte ba nas snying kha/ snying kha nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i bar du g.yas ro ma nyi ma me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po sbom phra gro+o sog 'bring po tsam gsal btab/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas snying kha/ snying kha nas lte ba/ lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar du g.yon rkyang ma zla ba chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po sbom phra gong bzhin gsal btab/ rlung gnas pa'i tshe de gnyis kyi bar du dbu ma pad+ma'i snal ma ltar te/ rta rnga brgyar gshags pa tsam/ chu shing sdong po ltar drangs te ya yo med pa/ rgya skye+eg gi me tog ltar dmar zhing snum pa/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal zhing 'od gsal ba/ de ltar chos bzhi ldan te rtsa gsum po de nyid gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar du bzhibs nas gnas pa la sems yang yang du gtad cing / sems gang gnas bar 'jog pa yin no/ /bzhi pa srub shing gi 'khor lo ni/ lus gnad skyil krung / lus kyi lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar skya/ sbom phra smyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi g.yas g.yon du/

ro rkyang gnyis gong bzhin te rtsa gsum 'dzoms pa'i mas snar ngo bo me la/ rnam pa khrag gi thig le sran ma tsam zhig gsal btab la/ rlung kha sbyar du bzung bas g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis dbu ma la gcer te sor bsgril ba bzhin hril hril byas pas dbu ma'i mas sner khrag gi thig le de har har btang bar bsam mo/ /lnga pa thig le'i rnal 'byor la bzhi ste/ snying kha'i nyi zla kha sbyor/ lte ba'i dpa' bo 'ba' zhig gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le/ mdzod spu skra dkar gyi sa bon no/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'og tu zla ba dang / steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed skas pa tsam/ steng 'og tu rtsigs pa'i bar du/ thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa yungs 'bru tsam zhig rnam pa gsal ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pa/ ngo bo bde stong ste chos gsum ldan du bsam/ 'og rlung bskums te/ rlung kha nas sgra med du dgang bas nyi zla las sing zer ba'i sgra zhig byung ba'i rkyen byas te steng gi nyi ma la bug pa rta rnga shong ba tsam gcig byung bar bsam/ de na mar yid kyis bltas pas/ thig le las 'od kyi srad bu shin tu phra ba zhig byung nas/ nyi zla la dkris phyed dang bdun gyi bar du dkris shing / slar skud pa rim gyis bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa lte ba'i dpa' bo 'ba' zhig ni/ lus gnad skyil krung / rang gi lte bar thig le dkar po sran ma tsam/ chos gsum ldan bsams la/ 'og rlung rang sar bzhag steng rlung kha nas sgra med du dgang ste/ thig le la thim par bsam ste mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsgom mo/ /gsum pa gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le ni/ rang gi gsang gnas kyi sked pa'am/ nor bu'i nang / shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i rtse mor thig le pad+ma ra ga ltar dmar ba sran ma tsam zhig chos gsum ldan du bsams la 'og rlung yang yang bskum zhing / thig le la thim pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pas bde ba skye zhing khams brtan par 'gyur ba'o/

/dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer bzhi pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi sum cha tsam bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu ldan sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ bzhi pa mdzod spu skra dkar gyi sa bon ni/ lus gnad skyil krung / sems kyi gnad mdzod spur byang sems kyi gang ba'i haṃ dkar po 'khyog po lce chung gi rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin suṃ dkar po gnyis ka mgo 'thur du blta ba/ snying khar sems kyi rten hūm̐ sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa mgo 'thur du bstan pa gcig bsams la/ de gsum rtsa dbu mas zung sbrel du sbrel bar bsams la/ rlung srog rtsol dang bstun la phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ lce chung rgyab nas dkris te yar song ba/ mdzod spu'i haṃ yig la phog pas de byang sems su mer te zhu bar bsam/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ haṃ yig de la byang sems dkar nar gyis babs pa lce chung gi suṃ yig la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nang du gnas pa'i tshe/ de las kyang bdud rtsi'i babs pa snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim pas hūm̐ yig tshim par bsam/ de'i stobs kyis lus thams cad kyang bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar bsgom pas thog mar mchi la ka ru 'gro/ de nas zho tsam/ de nas mar tsam du song ste/ kha zas la 'dod chags dang bral bar 'byung / phan yon ni lus zungs rgyas pa dang / lus rta ltar mgyogs shing / skra dkar dang gnyer ma mi 'byung ba'o/ /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer lnga pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung 'khrul spongs kyi sum cha tsam gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ spyi don gnyis pa 'khor lo la brten pa la gsum te/ gcig la brten pa rno/

gnyis la brten pa myur/ gsum la brten pa brtan zhes pa ltar/ dang po ni/ lus gnad tsog pu bya/ rang gi bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu gdung pa lta bu/ sum mdo me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po gnyis gsal btab/ de nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi dbus su/ nang ltar bshad pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma'i rang bzhin/ aṃ shin tu cha phra ba spu shad lta bu mgo gyen du bstan pa/ dmar shad pa gcig bsam pa ni/ gtum mo'i nyal sa zhes bya ba yin no/ /nang bskor 'dab ma brgyad la/ a/ ka tsa/ ṭa/ ta/ pa ya/ sha brgyad mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du gnas pa kha dog dmar ba mgo gyen du bstan pa/de'i phyi skor 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la yi ge 'god pa dang bral ba gsal lam gyis btab/ de nas 'og sgo a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum gyis mtha' ma la 'then pas/ sum mdo'i me sbar te/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ de las me kha dog dmar ba/ ngo bo tsha ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pa ste/ chos gsum ldan de nyid dang por sor gcig tsam/ de nas sor gnyis/ de nas sor gsum/ de nas sor bzhi tsam rno ba/ myur ba/ 'bar ba la sems gtad cing rlung kha sbyar la rtse gcig tu bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar sgom pas lte ba'i 'og tu drod tsha hur gyis 'ong ba la sogs pa'i nyams skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nyams myong skye sla ba'i dmigs pa yin pas rno ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa ni/ de'i steng du snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar/ hūm̐ sngo skya dngul chu'i mdog lta bu mgo 'thur la blta ba/ byang sems thig la mkhas pa zhig bsam/ 'dab ma brgyad la yi ge 'god pa dang bral ba/ snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / lte ba'i am̐ gnyis rtsa dbu ma shin tu cha phra bas zung sbrel bar bsam pa de nyid/ nang gi he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bor mos la/

'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas sum mdo'i me sbar ste lte ba'i am̐ la phog pas shin tu cha phra ba glog gi zer lta bu zhig dbu ma'i nang na yar dmar khyug ste song / snying kha'i hūm̐ la phog pas de las byang chub kyi sems shin tu cha phra ba 'dzags nas am̐ la thim pas/ am̐ drag tu 'bar ste/ 'bar 'dzag dkar dmar 'dres pa la sems gtad cing rlung kha sbyar 'dzin pa'o/ /de la drod kyi bsdus pa'i mthong snang 'byung ba ni/ rtags lnga dang / rtags kyi rtags lnga dang bcu'o/ /dang po ni/ g.yas nas rgyu ba'i 'byung ba lnga'i rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ sa rlung zin pas lus kyi nang ngam/ phyi rol tu du ba lta bu dang / chu rlung la smig rgyu/ me rlung la srin bu me khyer/ rlung gi rlung la mar me 'bar ba/ nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha' che chung ci rigs mthong ba 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa rtags kyi rtags lnga ni/ g.yon nas rgyu ba'i 'byung ba lnga'i rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pa'i rtags su mun nag lta bu/ rlung gi rlung la 'ja' mtshon/ me rlung gi glog chu rlung gi zla ba'i 'od zer/ sa rlung gi nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu 'byung ngo / /nyams rtags de rnams gang byung yang kha zas bcud can brten pa gces so/ /rtags 'di rnams rlung dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa gzhan la brten nas 'byung ba yang srid do/ /'khor lo gnyis la brten pa nyams rtags myur ba la dgongs nas 'dir bshad pa yin no/ /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer drug pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung 'khrul spong gi 'phros rdzogs par bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ gsum pa 'khor lo bzhi la brten/ zhes pa ni/ nyams skyes pa thams cad mi nyams zhing ye shes myur du skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang lus gnad tsog pu/ sems kyi gnad/ thog mar rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul ni/

gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo wa gshor lta bu/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud aṃ gi rnam pa de gru gu bcings pa lta bu/ rtsa 'dab rnams thags ka brkyang pa lta bu/ snying kha chos gyi 'khor lo pad+ma kha gyen tu bye ba lta bu/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo thal mo gyen du bkan pa lta bu/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo gdugs phub pa lta bur gnas shing / nyams su len pa'i tshe/ lte ba dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gyen du pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu yar sbug ge ba/ snying kha dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo gdugs phub pa lta bu mar sbug ge ba ste/ lte ba dang snying kha/ mgrin pa dang spyi bo kha sprod kyi tshul du bsgom pa'o/ /de la thog mar/ rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar la/ rtsa ro ma dmar mo me'i rang bzhin dmar po kha gyen la lta ba/ g.yon rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin dkar po kha 'thur la lta ba/ de gnyis kyi dbus su kun 'dar ma'am/ dbu ma chos bzhi ldan kha dog dmar ser shin tu dang pa de gsum srog shing gi tshul du gnas pa'i rtsa gsum yas sna spyi bo dang / mas snang lte bar zugs pa/ sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam/ lte ba'i am̐ gi klad skor dang / spyi bo'i haṃ gi klad skor gnyis dbu ma'i yas mar gyi nang du zug nas yod par bsams la/ de nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dbu ma nas phyogs bzhir gyes/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas brgyad/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas bcu drug de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba'o/ /de'i lte bar aṃ dmar ser/ nang skor rtsa 'dab brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa sogs gong bzhin/ phyi skor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ mdun nas brtsams te ā li bcu drug g.yon bskor ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa'i kā li so gnyis g.yas bskor/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar ser/ mgo gyen du bstan pa/ de nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo yang rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi tshul lte ba dang rigs 'gre/

de'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag 'dab ma brgyad la phyogs bzhir/ bh+rum̐/ am̐/ dz+rim̐/ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir/ lam̐/ mam̐/ pam̐/ tam̐/ ste yig 'bru thams cad kha dog sngon po/ mgo 'thur la bstan pa/ de gnyis kha sbyor gyi tshul du'o/ /de nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gyes tshul rigs 'gre/ de'i lte bar oṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma bcu drug la/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yon bskor du ā li bcu drug kha dog dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ de nas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa gyes lugs gong dang 'dra/ de'i dbus su haṃ dkar po mgo 'thur la bstan pa/ 'dab ma so gnyis la mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du ā li bcu drug g.yas skor du kā li'i sde tshan bzhi pa'i dang po ta yan gyi gsal byed kyi yig ge bcu drug kha dog dkar po mgo 'thur du bstan pa/ de gnyis kha sbyor gyi tshul du'o/ /de nas bshang sgo rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsal btab ste/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas pa'i mtha' ma la cung zad bsdams la/ 'og rlung yar drangs pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ des sum mdo'i me sbar te/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ de nyid me sbar/ me lce g.yas ro ma nas zhugs te song bas/ lte ba'i yig 'bru rnams zhen thogs med par bcom/ yang ro ma nas yar song / snying kha'i yig ge rnams bcom/ yang ro ma nas yar song mgrin pa'i yig ge rnams bcom/ yang ro ma nas yar song / spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi yi ge rnams bsregs zhing bcom/ bsregs zhing bcom zhes pa 'di rnams/ yi ge med par stong par stong pa yang ma yin/ sred sred por song ba'o/ /de nas spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub sems kyi thig le g.yon rkyang ma nas babs pas spyi bo'i yig 'bru rnams sos btab/ yang rkyang ma nas mar song /

mgrin pa'i yi ge rnams sos btab/ yang rkyang ma nas babs/ snying kha'i yig 'bru rnams sos btab/ yang rkyang ma nas babs/ lte ba'i yig 'bru rnams sos btab/ 'di ni rtsa lam sbyong ba yin pas/ yang g.yas ro ma nas me 'bar/ yig 'bru rnams gong bzhin bsregs bcom/ g.yon rkyang ma nas byang sems babs/ yig 'bru rnams sos btab pa sogs theng gsum tsam bsgom/ de nas aṃ de nyid las me cher 'bar zhing shin tu tsha ba la rten nas/ dbu ma'i mas sna kha bye ste/ me lce dbu ma nas yar song / snying kha'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ gnyis zhen thogs med par bcom te spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun cha 'dra ba dbu ma nas babs te/ mgrin pa'i oṃ sos btab cing 'bar 'dzags la sems gtad/ yang rim gyi babs pas snying kha'i hūm̐ sos btab cing 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad/ yang rim gyi babs pas lte ba'i aṃ sos btab cing / lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam du 'bar 'dzag skra bshad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad de/ de yang 'bar ba drag na yar ded/ 'dzag pa drag na mar ded de/ 'bar 'dzag ces pa/ mas yar me 'bar ba dang / yas mar byang sems 'dzag pa yin pas/ me 'bar ba ni drod dang thabs kyi ngo bo/ byang sems 'dzag pa ni bde ba dang shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas/ bde drod 'dzom pa la brten nas thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i bde stong zung du tshud pa ste/ de bzhin bsam nas rlung ro gsal la/ bum can zhes pa rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas mgrin pa 'gags pa dang / dud pa'i rnam pa lta bu byung na/ g.yas ro mas mgrin pa lan gsum dkris nas yod pas/ de la mi sdug pa yin pas/ mgo bo mjing pa sgyur ba la sogs pa bya/ snying 'cho zhing 'khrug na/ g.yon rkyang mas snying kha lan gsum dkris nas yod pa la khams gdugs pa yin pas/ snying kha'i nang du byang sems zla ba shar ba lta bu sgom/ mgo na skam skam byed na/

dbu ma dog pas byang sems 'bab ma nus pa yin pas/ yig mgo bcad pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba/ smin mtshams yan chad kyi thod pa med par kha yed du song ste/ de nas yar nad thams cad rlangs pa'i tshul du bun bun song bar bsam pas sel lo/ /dag dran sogs 'dra/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer bdun pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag rnam bshad kyi gsum cha tsam gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ spyi don gsum pa man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba la/ maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ lus kyi gnad thab gal gyi phyag rgya bco brgyad bca' ste/ de yang lus tsog pur byas la sgom thag bcug rkang pa'i long bu gnyis bsnol la lag pa gnyis kyang bsnol te dpung pa la 'khyud pas/ gru gsum drug 'byung ste phyi dbyibs kyi thab gal drug de bzhin du rtsa yig dang / khams bdud rtsi la yang drug drug ste bco brgyad zhib tu rtsis na rlung yod do/ /de yang bdun te/ me dmar skya la bslab pa/ me 'bar ba/ thig le'i 'thab mo/ me'i 'khor lo/ me drag tu 'bar ba/ me cher 'bar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lus khong stong 'khru ma phus btab pa'am/ rkyal pa stong pa lta bur bsams la/ de'i nang du gang nas byung cha med par me dmar skya zhig lhab kyis byung ste/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsams zhing shes pa me la drag tu gtad/ rlung gi gnad 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ steng rlung ran tshod du mnan/ grangs bzung ste bcu gnyis dang / grangs ma bzung ba bcu gnyis spel te/ thun re la nyi shu rtsa bzhi re bar ma chad par bsgom pa/ mi thub na dal bus btang / thun bzhir sgom mo/ /nyams byung rgyal du bskyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa me 'bar ba ni/ gzhan thams cad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rkang mthil gnyis su raṃ dmar nag re bsam/

rkang pa'i sor mo rnams cung zad bskyod pas/ rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos te/ raṃ las me 'bar ba long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nang na yar song / brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug ste song bas/ sum mdo'i me dang 'khrug chil te 'dres pas/ me de nyid rno ba ste rgya khab kyi rtse lta bu/ myur ba ste mar me rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu/ drag pa ste me stag khrom khrom pa/ rtsub pa ste reg bya shin tu tsha ba ste chos bzhi ldan la dmigs pa gtad pa'o/ /gsum pa thig le'i 'thab mo ni/ me de'i rtse mor thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig dang / de'i steng sor bzhi tsam du thig le dmar po ril ma tsam zhig bsam ste rlung bzung bas thig le steng mas 'og ma la thug par rgyab ste/ thig le gnyis yang yang 'thab pa'i mtshams nas me stag khrom khrom 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang ba la sems gtad pa'o/ /bzhi pa me'i 'khor lo ni/ sngar gyi me de'i steng du thig le dkar dmar gnyis brtse+egs pa srog shing lta bu/ de'i steng du me'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'am/ yang na rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs re la ā li ring thung gnyis gnyis mgo nang du bstan pa ste phyi yig 'bru'i gnad/ bar 'khor lo'i gnad/ nang thig le dkar dmar srog shing gi gnad de/ gnad gsum ldan du gsal btab/ de lta bu'i 'khor lo de lus la ma reg par g.yas g.yon gang rung du/ 'khor bas lus kyi nang thams cad me stag dmar phrom phrom gang bar bsam pa'o/ /'di man chad la rlung kha sbyar du bya/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /lnga pa me drag tu 'bar ba ni/ me'i 'khor lo'i steng du me kha dog dmar nag ngo bo tsha ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pa ste chos gsum ldan/ me stag dmar phrom phrom pa dang ba spyi bo'i ya thod la thug gi bar du 'bar ba la sems gtad pa'o/ /drug pa me cher 'bar ba ni/ me de cher 'bar bas spyi bo nas thur du log te/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad mer 'bar ba la sems gtad pa'o/

/bdun pa thams cad mer 'bar ba ni/ me de je cher je cher song ste/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me cher 'bar bas/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad gtum mo'i me chos gsum ldan du 'bar ba bsams te sgom pa'o/ /'di rnams rang byung gi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gro dgos la/ drod tsam las mi skye na dgos pa med de/ drod tsam mu stegs pa la'ang skye'o/ /spyi don gsum pa de dag gi skabs su dgos pa'i man ngag gi gnad la/ bogs 'don dang / gegs sel lo/ dang po ni/ lus sems sgrim glod gnyis res 'jog thun 'bri bskyed gnyis re 'jog kha zas 'grang ltogs gnyis re 'jog spyod lam yang dog gnyis res 'jog sems kyi gnad ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs 'pho ba yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi brten pa rnams so/ /gdams ngag drug ni/ don bsdus ma las/ lta sgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi bsten/ /la dor man ngag drug tu shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ rje btsun rin po chen nas/ srung ba sum cu dang / gegs sel rnams kyang 'dir dgos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po srung ba sum cu ni/ don bsdus ma las/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis la bar chad 'byung gi gcig la min/ /srung ba brgyad brgyad bcu drug dag tu ste/ /thabs la dad pa la sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /shes rab bsad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung / /nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi brda yis bzlog /gnyis la thun mong srung ba bcu bzhi ste/ /dang po lam du 'jug dang zhugs pa dang / /sems 'dzin cung zad brtan dang cher brtan pa'i/ /bar chad rim gyis sel ba shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no// //spyi don gnyis pa lta ba rang byung gi ye shes la/ nyon mongs rang byung ni rnam rtog rang byung / snel gzhi rang 'byung / gsal zhing yang la rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi'o/ /dang po nyon mongs rang byung gi rnam rtog ni/

snying kha'i dug lnga'i rtsa'am bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dug lnga'i rtsa yig tu rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka la nyon mongs pa lnga rang byung ste/ dug lnga 'jom pa'i mthong snang dang rmis nyams du ma 'byung ngo / /'o na tha mal pa'i nyon mongs pa dang khyad par ci yod snyam na/ tha mal pa la yul rkyen gyis kun nas slang nas skye la/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin las rang byung du skye ba yin no/ /de nyid kyang ngo shes par byas nas byung rgyal du bskyang ba nyid kyi mthar stong gsal skyon med skye'o/ /gnyis pa rnam rtog rang byung ni/ rtsa ro rkyang gi mas snar rlung sems dang po 'dus pas/ rlung spu gri'i stobs 'phel te/ de byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gsal stong skyon med du skye'o/ /gsum pa snel gzhi rang byung ni/ sngar rlung sems kyi 'du 'phro byed ma myong ba'i rtsa dbu ma khang stong lta bur rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis shes pa gsal cha shas chung shing / mi rtog pa shas che ba ste/ gnyid bro ba ma log pa lta bu 'byung ste/ 'di'i ming la zhi nas steng po zer te de yang byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pas gsal stong skyon med du 'gro ba'o/ /bzhi pa gsal zhing yang la rang byung gi ye shes ni/ zung 'jug gi hūm̐ du rlung sems 'dus pas shes pa gsal/ lus yang ba chos kyi sku'i ye shes lta bu'i nyams skye ba'o// //spyi don gsum pa grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bsgom pa la brten nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ sa bdun nas bcu pa'i bar la rigs drug gi skad shes/ de dag gi skad du chos ston/ ā li kā li la dbang thob/ tshig gi mchog 'grub pa la sogs pa/ mdor na don dang tha snyad sna tshogs ma 'dres pa so sor shes shing / ngag gis gzhan la ston nus pa'o//

//spyi don bzhi pa mda' kha la 'od gsal ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma snyogs na/ mda' kha ma'i gdams ngag dgos te/ dngos grub len pa'i dus bzhi ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus dang / rmi lam gyi dus dang / 'chi ba'i dus dang / bar do'i dus dang bzhi'o/ /de bzhi las 'di 'chi khar dngos grub len pa ste/ 'chi khar dbugs rtsegs pa'i rkyen byas te 'byung ba bsdus pa'i tshe/ rlung rag pa'i nus pa thams cad phra ba la thim/ rtsa rag pa thams cad kyang phra bal thim/ rtsa phran bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad rtsa ba bye ba phyed dang bzhi sogs la thim/ de dag kyang ro rkyang gnyis la thim pas/ dbugs drag tu rgod/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi stobs kyang dbu mas phrogs ste/ sa chu la thim pa'i rtags su dbang po'i sgo thams cad gsher ba ste/ mig chu/ kha chu/ sna chu sogs mi thub pa'o/ /chu me la thim pa'i rtags su kha sna skam zhing bad skya khal gyis 'gro ba'o/ /me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su dbang po'i sgo thams cad gsher ba/ bying nyams kyi kha kheb bsel ba dang / nga khyog dang zer ba sogs 'byung zhing zug gzer che/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su zug gzer zhi/ mig gyen la 'don/ shes pas yul mi zin/ mig gis ngo mi shes pa sogs 'byung ngo / /rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pas rlung dang byang chub kyi sems thams cad dbu mar 'jug pa yin te/ des na thim rim rnams rim gyis byung ba'i dus su lam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams ni/ bu pha khyim du 'gro ba ltar brod pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ 'chi ba la 'jig pa dang / skrag pa la sogs pa'i snang ba cung zad tsam yang med par byas la/ rlung dang byang chub kyi sems thams cad dbu mar zhugs pa'i dus su/ rlung gi nus pas stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skye la/ de la ka 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku zhes bya ste/ bdag gi de nyid ngo shes par byas la 'khrul snang gi dbang du ma shor ba zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du sgom pa'o/

/de ltar sgom pas bar do med par grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur ro// //spyi don lnga pa bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la rtog med ni/ gal te mda' kha ma theb na/ bar dor rkyen bdun shar ba'i dus/ bar do'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ de sbyang ba ni/ bdag la nang rang byung gi ye shes ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon/ gsung rdo rje longs sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam tsaṇ+ḍa li dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba rang byung gi ye shes dran pa/ dran pa rnam pa gsum po de/ rmi lam gyi rkyen gyis kyang de gsum dran pa ma byung gi bar du bslab pa'o/ /de ltar gom pa'i dbang gi bar dor yang sngar gyi dran pa gsum 'byung zhing / gnam bya lnga yang ā li kā li'i rnam par shar te/ rten 'brel des snang ba dang bdag gi sems ro gcig par gyur nas bar do nyid du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// //spyi don drug pa 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub ni/ 'og 'bras bu'i skabs su 'chad do/ /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ des gsang dbang gi lam 'khor dang bcas pa rdzogs par bstan zin to/ ༈ /nyi ma nyer brgyad pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung man ngag rnam bshad kyi sum gnyis tsam gyi lung bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ spyi don gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba la/ lam dkyil 'khor thabs kyi lam/ lta ba lhan gcig skyes pa yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ mda' kha ma nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ zhar chung bde ba bar do lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba/ 'bras bu chos sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste drug gi dang po ni/ khams byang sems la gnad du bsnun pas bde ba che ba chen po len zhing 'dzin par byed pa dang /

yul la sogs pa'i rnam rtog gcod pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /de nyams su blang ba'i tshul la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la 'phrid kyi sngon 'gro dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bsag sbyang gnyis sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lam rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ rig ma dag pa/ lus ngag mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa/ man ngag gi gnad kyis zin pa'o/ /dang po la dngos kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ ri dwags can ma/ dung can ma/ glang po can ma/ ri mo can ma/ sna tshogs can ma'o/ /de'ang ri dgas can ma ni/ ri dwags kyi ro stod de nu ma 'phrang ba/ de'i ros smad de smad sha rgyas shing zlum pa/ de'i sked pa ste phra ba/ de'i 'gros te dal ba/ de'i lta stangs te skyes pa mthong na mig mi 'dzum pa/ de'i dri ste dbugs dang nyer gnas la gla rtsi'i dri bro ba'o/ /dung can ma ni/ spyir rus pa rags pa/ sha 'jam pa/ lte ba na dung g.yas su 'khyil pa'i ri mo yod pa/ lus stobs che zhing myur la skad mdangs che zhing ring ba'o/ /glang po can ma ni/ spyir lus kyi sha che zhing / yan lag thung ba/ stobs che ba/ mig chung ba/ rna ba'i shal ring ba/ rngul byung tshe dri zhim pa/ khog shes che zhi 'dzang pa/ khyad par bung ba'i tshogs sdang ba'o/ /ri mo can ma ni/ sha rtsi cung zad dmar ba/ lte ba'i steng na ri mo 'greng bu gsum yod pa/ mdzod spu na ri mo 'greng bu gcig yod pa/ spyir tshigs kyi tshogs thams cad ring ba/ yan lag la bkra shis pa'i ri mo mang zhing / dpal che ba/ bu skye na yang khye'u btsa' ba'o/ /de lta bu ni khyad par du sngags so/ /sna tshogs can ma ni/ de bzhi ka'i yon tan dang ldan pa'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /bu mo pad+ma can gyi rigs ni/ slob dpon 'di'i dbang bzhi pa'i rten du bzhed la/

de yang gsum li ba/ mig mdzes pa/ smin mtshams bar ma chad pa/ kha dang dbugs la gla rtsi'i dri bro ba/ mdun so lhag po gcig yod pa/ nu ma 'phrang la lte ba'i steng na gnyer ma 'greng bu gsum yod pa/ dpral ba na gcig yod pa/ smad kyi zhang rgyas pa/ nyer gnas la spu med pa/ 'gram gnyis mtho ba/ me tog la ka puram̐ gyi dri 'byung ba/ spyod lam dal zhing byad sdug pa ste/ yon tan 'di rnams dang ldan na dngos grub kyi rten du rung ngo / /spyir phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid 'di rnams phal cher 'dug na bzang / gsum mam/ gnyis sam/ gcig tu 'dug kyang gzung du rung / gang med na mi gzung / de rnams kyis dngos kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bstan nas/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste/ 'dir phyi ma bzhed pas/ de la dang po rig ma dag pa ni/ rang sems la mngon par 'dod pa'i mi'i bu mo dbang dang dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa zhig yid yul du bya'o/ /gnyis pa lus ngag mnyam pa ni/ rang skas cig gi kyai rdo rje dang / rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba lus lhar mnyam pa/ gnyis ka so so'i snying po bzla ba ngag sngags su mnyam pa/ lus lhar bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes/ gsum pa byin rlabs mnyam pa ni/ mkha' gsang bsnol mar/ yab kyis yum gyi mkha'/ yum gyis yab kyi mkha'/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis rlabs/ gzhan 'dra ba las/ yab kyi rdo rje'i bu gar phaṭa mgo nang bstan/ rwa dbus ma'i rtse swā las rin po che'i tog tu byin gyi rlabs par bsam pa/ mkha' gsang sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ bzhi pa 'dod pa snyam pa ni/ bdag rig ma la brten nas dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed de rdzogs byang thob par 'dod la/ rig ma bdag la brten nas de ltar 'dod pas 'dod pa mnyam pa chos kyi 'du shes/ lnga pa man ngag gnad kyis zin pa la/ byang chub kyi sems dbab pa/ bzung ba/ bzlog pa/ khyab pa/ mi nyams pa bsrung ba dang lnga las/

dang po ni/ rig ma de'i gzugs la lta ba/ sgra la snyan pa/ dri la snom pa/ ro la myong ba/ ma mchus sbrang rtsi 'jibs pa/ lus kyi gnas ci rigs la reg pa/ 'khyud pa dang btsum ba la sogs pa/ 'du shes sum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma gnyis kha sbyor/ gsang rtsa gnyis kha sbyor/ thig le gnyis kha sbyor ste kha sbyor bzhi'i gdams ngag ces bya ba ste/ de yang srub cing srub pa'i sbyor ba la brten nas/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te/ thig le'i dang ma rnams zhu/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ yab kyi nor bu'i rtse mo dang / yum gyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor byon pas lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam pa ni dbab pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzung ba ni/ lto ba tshigs pa la sbyar/ rkang lag gi sor mo bskum/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig steng du bgrad de spyi gtsug gi nam mkha' la blta'o/ /gsum pa bzlog pa ni/ ngag gi stobs kyi hūm̐ drag la ring bas drangs te khu tshur snying khar bsnol te/ hūm̐ gi sgras rlung phyir drag tu drangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ phaṭa gyi mda' gzhu 'phang ste/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ gis phaṭa drangs/ phaṭa kyis hūm̐ yar la phul bar bsam la bzlog go /bzhi pa khyab par bya ba ni/ rlung gi ske rags zhes pa/ lag gnyis sked pa la bskor bar bya/ zhags pas 'phang pa ni/ lag gnyis brkyang bskum drag tu bya/ gtun shing gi 'khor lo ste/ lag gnyis sked par 'jus nas ro stod bsgur/ bu chung gi spyod lam ni/ lus phyogs bzhir 'phar 'gyel tshur 'gyel bya'o/ /lnga pa mi nyams par bsrung ba ni/ rgyas par gzhung bshad rnam las 'byung la/ bya rgyud thun mong pa'i srung ba ni/ gzhon nu ma'i skal ba'i skud pa leb rgan rtsi 'am/ gur gum btsos pa la/ mdun pa bdun byas ste/
