sngags ni/ oṃ ha ra ha ra/ ban+dha ni/ shu kra dha ra ni sar+ghā r+tha swāhā/ zhes pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas la srod la btab/ srod kyi dus su lus dang dbang po'i sgo thams cad gu gul gyis bdug la sked par bcing / lhag ma 'dom du drang la bzhag pas bsrung ngo / /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma nyer dgu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung man ngag rnam bshad nas 'phros phye+ed tsam bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ gnyis pa lam bsdus pa la/ lus kyi spyod lam bstan byas nas/ /lag g.yas nyi ma g.yon pa zla/ /pus mo gnyis la bsnol mar bkab/ /hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung mdun du dgu/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu gsum gsum ste/ /'bud pa gsum dang rngub pa gsum/ /'khor ba dag tu sbyang bar bya/ /nyi ma dag ni gsum pa la/ /lba ba sbubs su nub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsung / de'i don ni/ lus gnad skyil krung ngam tsog pur byas la/ rlung gi gnad mdun du gsum gtud nas 'bud/ yang gtud nas gsum rngub/ de nas g.yas su gtud nas gsum bus/ gtud nas gsum rngub/ yang mdun du de bzhin/ de nas g.yon du'ang de bzhin/ yang mdun du de bzhin te/ de ltar sum cu tham pa'i bar du rlung sbyang / sems kyi gnad khams dang ma rlung dang bcas pa thams cad dbu ma nas drangs par bsam/ de ltar sbyangs pas/ nyi ma gsum nas 'thur sel gyi rlung la dbang thob ste/ lba ba sbubs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /rjes bzlog cing khyab par bya ba ni/ glang chen hiṃ dang stag mo ngur/ /spyang zan skyug dang wa ltar snom/ /lte ba snying kha mgrin pa dang / /spyi gtsug dag tu rim bzhin bsrang / /rnam grol rgya yis lus la dgram/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de'i don yang snyoms 'jug byas pa'i rjes la/ lus skyil krung bcas te/ gsang gnas nas lte bar thig le 'dren par bsam zhing / shes pa lte bar gtad la/

ngag tu glang chen hiṃ te hī hiṃ zhes pas drang / lte ba nas snying khar shes pa gtad la/ ngag tu stag mo ngur ste/ ngu 'ur zhes pas drangs/ snying kha nas mgrin par shes par gtad la/ ngag tu wa ltar snom ste hi hi zhes pas drang ngo / /de nas seṅge+e rnam grol gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis lus thams cad la khyab par dgram par bya'o/ /lam rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i chos ni/ thig le'i man ngag gnad dang bral ba la mi mkhas pa bzhi 'byung ste/ dbab pa la mi mkhas na thig le myur du nyams/ bzung ba la mi mkhas na bde ba yun thung / bzlog pa la mi mkhas na chu dang sdong nas 'dzag dgram pa la mi mkhas na nad du 'gyur ro/ /de la gnyen po mkhas pa bzhi 'byung ste/ dbab pa la mkhas pa rus sbal gyi 'gros dga' ba bzhis go rim gyis so/ gzung ba la mkhas pa lus kyi 'gyur ba gsum dang / ngag gi 'gyur ba gcig las/ lus kyi gsum ni/ srin po'i lam bsdam/ gung mdzub gnyis drag tu 'jib/ mig gyen du bzlog pa dang gsum mo/ /ngag gi gcig ni/ ha hal drag tu brjod pa'o/ /bzlog pa la mkhas pa dud gro'i 'gyur ba ni/ glang chen hiṃ la sogs pa'o/ /khyab par bya ba la mkhas pa seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya'am/ rlung gi ske rags bcing pa la sogs pa'o// //spyi don gnyis pa lta ba lhan skyes pa'i ye shes bzhi ste/ phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba/ spang bya la ltos pa'i dga' ba/ rang gi ngo bo la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi bzhi'o/ /dang po ni rig ma'i gzugs la lta ba sogs so/ /gnyis pa la phyi nang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus kyi gnas khol bur bde ba skyes na dga' ba/ lus phal cher la skyes na mchog dga'/ lus thams cad khyab par skyes na dga' bral/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad khyab par skyes na lhan skyes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas snying kha/ de nas lte ba/ gsang gnas bzhir dga' ba bzhi skye'o/

/gsum pa spang bya la ltos pa ni/ chos brgyad la sogs pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags rim 'gog pa dga' ba/ bdag gi rnam rtog rags rim 'gog pa mchog dga'/ phyag rgya la zhen pa'i rnam rtog 'gog pa dga' bral/ dga' ba gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gog pa lhan skyes so/ /bzhi pa rang gi ngo bo la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi ni/ bde ba'i nyams myong chung ba dga' ba/ bde ba cher 'bar ba mchog dga'/ bde ba mi rtog pa dang ldan pa dga' bral/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa lhan skyes so/ /des na dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i dga' ba dang po gsum sred pas bsdus pa skyon can yin la/ bzhi pa lhan skyes kyi ye shes gom na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur bas skyon med de nyid skye ba'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// //spyi don gsum pa grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba ni/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes gom pa la brten nas/ 'das pa'i lam sa bcu gcig pa dang / bcu gnyis pa la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos ci rigs par bde stong du rtogs par 'byung ngo // //spyi don bzhi pa mda' kha ma nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma snyogs na/ mda' kha ma'i gdams ngag dgos te/ de ni rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi stobs dbu mas phrogs nas/ spyi bo'i dkar cha haṃ gi ngo bor gnas pa 'thur du gshegs shing / lte ba'i dmar cha a thung ngo bor gnas pa gyen du gshegs te/ snying khar rlung sems thig le thams cad kyi dang ma 'tshogs nas kha sbyor du gyur pas/ bde stong mchog tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye la/ de nyid rdo rje ni stong pa/ sems pa ni bde ba ste/ de nyid la gzhi dus kyi rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ thams cad la 'byung yang ngo mi shes/ ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

sngar 'dris pa'i mi dang 'phrad pa ltar ngo shes te/ dang ma lnga 'dus kyi bde stong gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres te/ bar do med par grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur ro// //spyi don lnga pa bar do lhan gcig skyes pa'i bde ba ni/ gal te mda' kha ma mtheb na/ bar do'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ de ni/ bdag la gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon thugs rdo rje chos sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam dkyil 'khor dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba lhan skyes kyi ye shes yas babs kyi dga' ba dran pa/ de gsum dus gcig dran par bya ste/ rmi lam gyi rkyen gyis kyang de gsum dran pa ma byung gi bar du bslab bo/ /de ltar goms pa'i dbang gi bar do'i rkyen bdun shar ba na yang / sngar gyi dran pa gsum 'byung zhing / gnam bya lnga yang byang sems dkar dmar gyi rnam par shar ste/ rten 'brel des snang ba dang bdag gi sems ro gcig tu gyur nas bar dor rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro// //spyi don drug par 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub ni/ 'og 'bras bu'i skabs su 'chad do/ /dag dran sogs bya/ 'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma sum cu pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung man ngag rnam bshad rdzogs par bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ spyi don bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa dang rjes su 'brel ba la/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs/ zhar byung bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ lta ba chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid/ mas bstan gyi dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba/ mda' kha ma lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba/ zhar byung bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub dang drug go /dang po la gsum las lus kyi rba rlabs/

ngag gi rba rlabs/ sems kyi rba rlabs dang gsum mo/ /dang po/ 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs te/ rlung kha sbyor du sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gi rba rlabs ni/ lus skyil krung ngam/ tsog pur gnad la dbab/ mgo mdun du sgur la/ rlung drang ba dang bstun nas/ ngag tu/ i 'aṃ/ ḍiṃ 'aṃ/ ṭiṃ/ gsum gang rigs kyi dang po zhi ba ste skad chung ngu'i drang / phyis drag po ste hūm̐ zhes skad chen por drangs pas/ mgrin rlung byang nas lung pa phar tshur la sogs pa thos pa'i skad 'byung / de'ang ngag 'dren pas lus 'dar/ des rtsa 'dar/ des byang chub kyi sems 'dar/ des bde ba skye zhing rlung dang bstun nas gyen la drangs pas lus zungs rgyas te gdong bkrag mdangs dang ldan zhing / 'thur sel gyi rlung la dbang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ting 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs ni/ dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas lam sbyang pa la gsum ste/ thabs/ shes rab/ gnyis ka'i rgyud so sor dag par bya'o/ /dang po ni/ 'du shes sum ldan la brten nas snyoms par zhugs pas/ yab yum gnyis ka'i khams dang ma gsang gnas gnyis ka'i rtser byon/ rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna na/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig skya hril gyis gnas pa de 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur/ rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum/ sngon la ro ma/ de nas rkyang ma/ de nas dbu ma rim pa bzhin du/ ro ma nas song lte bar byon/ lte ba'i 'khor lo 'od kyi nam lang pa bzhin yal yal/ de bas kyang 'od cher song ste nyi ma shar ba bzhin gsal gsal/ glo ba 'bus pa bzhin ltang ltang / yang yar song snying khar chos gsum ldan du dran/ yar song mgrin par chos gsum ldan du dran/ yar song rna ba g.yas nas 'od zer gyi rnam par spros/ 'od zer las lhag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor spros/ sems can thams cad la dbang bzhi bskur/ sems can thams cad lhar byas pa dang / phar spros pa'i 'od zer gnyis 'dres bdud rtsi'i bcud du gyur/

spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo chos gsum ldan du byas/ 'od zer dmar por gyur/ mgrin par byon/ nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid dang ldan cing / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams chos gsum ldan du byas/ snying khar byon pas bdag gi rgyud sku lngar gyur pa'i rtags su 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lngar gyur te/ snying kha'i rtsa 'khor rnams chos gsum ldan du byas/ rtsa dag pa'i lam lte ba nas byon/ yum gyi mkhar snga ma bzhin du thig le'i gzugs kyis gnas so/ /g.yas gzung ba'i rba rlabs rengs/ rtsa ro ma dbang du 'dus/ rtsol ba ste rlung phyir 'gro ba rnams la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo tshad ma med pa zhes bya ba ste 'bras bu dang po'o/ /de bzhin du g.yon du'ang gong bzhin byas pas g.yon 'dzin ma'i rba rlabs rengs/ rtsa rkyang ma dbang du 'dus/ srog ste/ rlung nang du 'jug pa la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa zhes bya ba 'bras bu gnyis so/ /de bzhin du dbu ma la'ang sbyar ste bsgom pas gzung 'dzin gnyis ka'i rba rlabs rengs/ rtsa dbu ma dbang du byas 'dus/ rlung gnas pa la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid de 'bras bu gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa shes rab kyi rgyud dag par bya ba ni/ rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum la sngar bzhin las/ rna ba nas phyi spro ba med cing / dbu ma nas song tshangs pa'i sgo nas spro ba/ bsdu ba byas kyang rung / ma byas kyang rung ste yum shes rab stong pa nyid yin pas bya byed kyi spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /rba rlabs gsum rangs pa nas 'bras bu gsum gyi bar gong dang 'dra/ gsum pa gnyis ka'i rgyud dag par bya ba ni/ yab yum gnyis ka'i khams dang ma gnyis rtsa dbu ma nas drangs 'od zer gyi rnam par song nas so so'i gtsug tor mchog tu thim/ de gnyis ka yang sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje ni bde ba mi rtog pas brgyan pa/

rba rlabs ni rtog pa'i 'phreng ba ste/ rdo rje mi rtog pa'i ngo bor thim pa la rengs pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de yang nyams gang du skye nges pa med/ gang du skyes kyang byung rgyal du bskyang ngo // //spyi don gnyis pa lam de sgom pa las byung ba'i lta ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid mas bstan gyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ rgyu mthun pas ni skra dkar 'jom/ /rnam par smin pas stobs ster byed/ /skyes bu byed pa rnam par 'phel/ /dri ma med pas 'chi med 'byung / /zhes pa ltar dang po 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ gnyis pas mngon par shes pa cung zad 'char/ gsum pas ro thams cad longs spyod par nus/ bzhi pas rdzu 'phrul cung zad ston nus so/ /deng dang po ni/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin chung / gnyis pa la 'bring / gsum pa la chen po/ bzhi pa la chen po'i yang chen por 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i phan yin ni/ lto ba'i ngos me long ltar 'jam/ lus stobs shin tu che/ lces mdzod spur sleb/ lce chung gi ba zho nus/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gyur ba'o// //spyi don gsum pa grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba ni/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba shin tu rnam par de kho na nyid goms pa la brten nas sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed man chad kyi chos thams cad 'khor 'das bde stong gi ye shes gcig gi ngang du ro gcig par rtogs te/ blang dor dang spang thob gnyis tha dad med par 'gyur ba'o// //spyi don bzhi pa mda' kha ma phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba ni/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma snyogs na mda' kha ma'i gdams ngag bya dgos pas/ de la lus tsog pur gnad la phab la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngon du 'gro bas/ hīka ces pa nyi shus mgrin par drang ba dang /

ka hika ces pa nyi shus ngal gso ba gnyis spel zhing bya/ nyer gcig pa las sbyor gyi dus su bya yi/ sbyang pa'i dus byas na tshe thung du 'gyur ro gsung / de ltar thun bzhi nges pas gnad zin zin sbyang ste/ gnad zin pa'i tshad ni/ de dran pa tsam gyis ba spu ldang ba dang / snying kha tsha lam me ba dang / mgo gas pa lta bu 'byung ba'o/ /phyi'i yi ge la gom par bya ba dang / nang gi yi ge la gom par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sgo rnams yi ges bgag par bya ste/ bshang lam du saṃmarayu dkar po mgo bo gyen du bstan/ gci lam du k+ṣamarayuṃ ser po mgo bo gyen du bstan/ lte bar k+ṣadu ཾ dmar po mgo sprod/ lce chung gi rtsa bar suṃ dkar po mgo sprod/ sna bug gnyis su yuṃ sngon po mgo bo sprod re re/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ sngon po khril ma re re/ rna ba gnyis su yum̐ dmar po 'khril ma re re/ mdzod spur somarayuṃ ser po mgo thur bstan/ tshangs sbug tu hamarayum̐ dkar po mgo 'thur bstan/ 'di thams cad la zla ba'i gdan dang / mgo gnyis kyi bar zla bas bcad par sgom/ mi gsal na sgo mi khegs so/ /'di rang bzhin du sgom pas bsrung bar yang 'gro gsung / nang gi yi ge la gom par bya ba ni/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni rtsa ro rkyang gnyis su ha dang k+ṣa spang pa'i kā li sum cu rtsa gnyis kha dog dkar po mgo 'thur bstan gnyis gnyis kyi bar du ā li bcu drug kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la blta ba re re spel mar bkod pas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gi lam bkag ste/ rlung rtsol ba'i dus su mas yar gsal btab/ srog gi dus su yas mar gsal btab ste/ yig 'bru rnams lag mthil gyi ri mo lta ba ltar gsal bar ma gyur gyi bar du gom par bya'o/ /nang gi sgo yi ges bkag pa 'di bzhi pa 'ba' zhig gi thun mong ma yin pa la dgos kyi/ 'pho ba gzhan rnams la mi dgos so/

/'chi ltas byung nas ma bslus na las la sbyar ba la/ bzhi pa 'ba' zhig gi thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngon du 'gro bas/ lus skyil krung du gnad la phab la/ dang po phyi'i sgo thams cad yi ges bkag de nas nang gi sgo thams cad kyang sngar bzhin yi ges bkag la/ rlung phyir 'byung ba'i dus su phyi dbyibs kyi a nas spyi bo'i haṃ gi bar du rlung dbu mar yid kyis 'gro bar bsam nang du 'jug pa'i dus su spyi bo'i haṃ nas phyi dbyibs kyi a'i bar du dbu ma nas 'gro bar bsam/ de ltar dngos su kha sna nas rgyu yang yid kyis de ltar bsam pas 'chi khar rang gi ngang gis dbu mar 'jug pa dang / bdag nyid kyis sgom pa gnyis mthun nas srol rtsol gyi rlung dbu mar zad de/ lam mchog der thim nas rlung gi 'gros rim gyis thim par 'gyur la/ de'i stobs kyis rtsa dang / yi ge dang / khams bdud rtsi rnams kyi stobs kyang dbu mar zhugs nas phyag rgya chen po bde stong shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid mngon du gyur te/ sngar gyi nyams myong dang 'dres ba'i tshul gyi grub mtha' snyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin la sogs par 'gyur ba yin no// //spyi don lnga pa bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes ni/ gal te mda' kha ma ma theb na/ bar do'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ de ni/ bdag la mthar thug de kho na nyid chos thams cad shin tu rnam dag ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon ngo bo nyid sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba shin tu rnam dag de kho na nyid mas bstan gyi dga' ba dran pa ste/ de gsum dus gcig la dran par bya ste/ rmi lam gyi rkyen gyis kyang de gsum dran pa ma byung gi bar du bslab bo/ /de ltar gom pa'i dbang gis bar do'i rkyen bdun shar ba na yang sngar gyi dran pa gsum 'byung zhing / gnam bya lnga yang rtsa gsum du rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum byed pa 'char zhing /

rtsa gnyis kyang dbu mar ro gcig rlung gnyis kyang gnas par ro gcig rten 'brel des/ snang ba dang rang gi sems kyang ro gcig par gyur nas bar do nyid du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro// //spyi don drug pa 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub ni/ 'bras bu'i skabs nyid du 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir ma spros so/ /rgyas pa dang 'brel na dag dran bya/ bsdus pa ltar na/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /'di la thun gcig byed/ ༈ nyi ma so gcig pa la/ sems bskyed sogs 'gre/ lung sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lam zab dang / bir srung gnyis kyi byin rlabs bya tshul dang / rgyun gyi nyams len byed tshul gnyis/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad pa'i lam zab kyi brgyud 'debs rnams bklags la/ dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa la/ ༈ spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur pa'i tshul ni/ bum dbang rtsa'i 'gros 'khor 'das kyi snang ba 'char ba'i rtsa thams cad dbu mar thim ste/ dbu ma'i rtsa mdud sum cu rtsa gnyis rim gyis grol ba las/ dbu ma nyid kyang gtsug tor mchog tu nā da'i dbyibs sbom phra rta rnga tsam ring thung sor bzhi tsam du gyur te/ de'i skad cig la/ sku thams cad mkhyen pa sprul pa'i skur 'gyur ro/ ༈ /gsang dbang gi 'gros ni/ ngag brjod pa'i gzhi yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa rnams/ ā li lā li/ e waṃ/ a sogs la rim gyis thim ste/ sa bcu nyis pa la āḥtsheg drag can du gyur pa de haṃ la thim ste/ dbyibs thim pas a haṃ mi thim/ kha dog thim pas dkar po/ stobs thim pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i hūm̐ gi stobs su gyur ste/ de'i skad cig la gsung thams cad mkhyen pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'gyur ro/ ༈ /shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi'i 'gros ni/ khams dgu'i dang ma thams cad stobs su khams dkar dmar la thim/

de gnyis kyi stobs kyang dbu ma'i mas sna na ma las thob pa'i rak+ta dmar ba/ yas sna pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po gnyis la thim/ de gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres nas dga' ba bcu drug gi 'gros kyi dang ma'i yang dang ma mchog tu gyur pa 'od zer sna lnga'i tshul gyi gtsug tor mchog tu thim ste/ de'i skad cig la thugs thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi skur 'gyur ro/ ༈ /dbang bzhi pa rlung gi 'gros ni/ rtog bcas skye ba'i rlung thams cad ldang 'jug gnyis la thim/ ldang 'jug gnyis gnas par thim/ gnas pa dbu mar thim/ de gtsug tor mchog tu thim pas ye shes kyi rlung du gyur te/ de'i skad cig la sku gsung thugs thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid kyi skur 'gyur ro/ ༈ /de ltar rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gnas gyur pa'i tshe brten pa kun gzhi nyid kyang gnas gyur te/ sngar gzhan gyis spongs ma nus pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa spangs te/ sgrib bral du gyur pa la brten nas shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i sku zhes bya ba mngon du byed do/ /de lta bu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad rang rig pa'i ye shes yongs su dag pa cig gi ngo bor ro gcig tu 'dres te/ dbyings dang ye shes ro nyams chen por gyur pa de las dus nam yang ma g.yos bzhin du/ sems can gyi don 'bad med du 'byung ba de la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ces bya ba yin no// //spyi don gsum pa nges shes khyad par can bskyed la ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya zhing lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par bzhag pa ni/ tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas nges shes bskyed dgos te/ gzhung las/ tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu bstan la phab nas zhes dang / gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs bzhi ma chad pa zhes gsung zhing / gzhan yang don bsdus ma las/ tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa bcad/

/zhes gsung pa ltar yin/ de'i don thog mar nyams myong tshad ma de yang khyod kyi lam sgom na nyams myong 'di lta bu zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin thog tu pheb pa la brten nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus skye bas bla ma tshad ma/ nyams myong de nyid kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshigs rkang dang ngo 'phrod pas dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lo rgyus kyi tshad ma/ de nyid kyang rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis sogs sangs rgyas kyis gsung pa'i lung gi don shes bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par lung gi tshad ma ste/ de bzhi'i sgo nas nges shes bskyed pa dang / snyan brgyud bzhi ni/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ gdams kyi bsam pas tshim pa ste/ de dag gi sgo nas nges shes bskyed pa'o/ /de ltar nges shes bskyed pa'i gang zag de la lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par bzhag dgos pa ni/ gzhung las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas lam yongs su rdzogs par bstan to/ /zhes gsung pa'i don rgyas par bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / hril gyis bsdu na lam la lnga ste tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /sa la bcu gsum ste/ bum dbang gi sa drug gsang dbang gi sa bzhi/ sher dbang gi sa gnyis/ dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed dang / 'bras bu'i sa phyed de/ sa bcu gsum gyi grangs su gnas pa'o// //spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyis bshad pa ni/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bras bu'i sa ste/ 'gros bzhi thim pa la brten nas che ba rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sku lnga rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par gyur pa ste/ gzhung las/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyi sgom nyams skyon yod med byed pas sa bcu gsum pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen to/

/bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa rten 'brel 'grig pa ltar snang / 'tshang rgya khar 'khor tshul bu gcig dang bcas te 'tshang rgya/ zhes gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang sgrub pa po bdag nyid/ rgyud yongs su dag pa'i phyag rgya gcig byin gyis brlob pa'i bla ma gcig bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro gcig /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i slob ma gcig ste/ nyung mtha' yang lnga dus gcig la grol bar bzhed do// //spyi don gsum pa nyams su blangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcu'i rgyas btab cing / skal ldan gyi slob ma la phan par gdams pa ni/ de ltar lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo thob pa rnams dam du bcang zhing dam du spel ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis gsung pa ltar yin la/ spyir gsang sngags zhes pa theg dman la gsang zhing / thig chen la bsngags pa'am/ skal dman la gsang zhing / skal ldan la gdams pa ste/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa la gsang nas/ dam tshig dang ldan pa la byin dgos pa las/ thog mar gsang ba bcu ni/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod/ man ngag gsang mtshan/ yi dam/ lung bstan/ bza' ba'i dam tshig nyams kyi rtags/ byin rlabs zhugs pa'i dus/ lhan skyes ye shes/ spyod pa rnams te/ de skad du/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i gsang ba bcu'i gdams pa las/ thog mar bla ma'i mdzad spyod gsang / /rjes gnang man ngag bskyed rdzogs gsang / /bla mas btags pa'i gsang mtshan gsang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam gsang / /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan mtshan ma gsang / /bdud rtsi lnga yi dam tshig gsang / /nyams las byung ba'i drod rtags gsang / /byin rlabs zhugs pa'i dus tshod gsang / /grol byed lhan skyes ye shes gsang / /rtog med spyod pa shugs 'byung gsang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gsang ba bcu po de rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang na/ bla ma dang yi dam lhas byin gyi brlab cing / bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gyur ba'i nyams dang rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin khyad par can gong nas gong du 'phel te bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa yin no/

/de rnams kyis gzhung shing rgyas par gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i 'khrid yongs su rdzogs par bstan zin to/ /des na de lta bu'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid zab mo bshad pa dang / nyan pa la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pas/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bas rgyas legs par 'debs par bgyid dgos pas zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ bla mas bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa rgyas par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig dang po'i blo can gyis rtogs par sla ba gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni/ shes rab rtsal che zhing rnam spyod blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la/ rje btsun 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i snang gsum mdzes rgyan dang / rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan sogs 'khrid yig rgyas pa rnams las lhag pa mi 'dug kyang / shes rab dman pa dang / dang po'i blo can rnams la phan pa'i phyir dang / lhag par dben gnas dam pa byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i drung gi gsung ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa gnang dus/ rang ngos kyi dmigs pa rnams gsal 'debs bskyar skabs/ rigs kyi bu spun gsum dang / chos rje kun dga' bkra shis sogs kyis/ 'di lta bu'i dmigs rim rnams nyams su blang bde ba zhig ces kyang 'bri dgos/ zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi rigs bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa'i bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug tu gus pas len pa/

chos med snyoms las can/ sa skya pa kirti grags pa/ ma ti/ blo gros/ dh+wa dza rgyal mtshan/ shrī dpal/ bha tra bzang po sa rang bzo'i skyon spangs te/ yig cha khung thub rnams gdan du btings shing / lhag par rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang chen po sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi phyag len gsung rgyun gyis brgyan te/ pra baṅgaḥzhes pa rgya gar lugs la spre'u zhes dang / rgya nag lugs la me mo lug lo/ bai shā kha la dha ba/ zhes pa sa ga sbrang dus/ me tog can zhes bya ba hor zla bzhi pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dus chen gsum 'dzom gyi dus bzang khyad par can tshes bco lnga'i nyin rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub phug byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi bla brang nub tu sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na/ sngags 'chang chen pos bzod par mdzad du gsol/ 'di bris pa las lus ngag yid gsum dag /ngal bar gyur pa'i dge ba dri med des/ /bdag gzhan ma gyur 'gro drug sems can kun/ /dges pa rdo rje'i go 'phang myur thob shog /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
